# @stofone/dsh-agent-roster

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

A **static member roster** plugin for multi-agent teams on DeepSeek Harness.

A roster is a file on disk: who is on the team, what each member owns, which model route they take, and which tools they may touch. This plugin defines that format, validates it, and translates it into `agent_teams_*` arguments — it does not run teams.

## What it is / what it is not

| It is | It is not |
|---|---|
| A definition and validation layer: versionable, reviewable, and loud on errors (file path + field path), never silently degrading | A team runtime: it never creates members, schedules work, or replaces a scheduler |
| A bridge to `dsh-agent-teams`: `roster_create` emits ready-to-use member arguments and labels every field with whether the runtime really carries it | A writer of `.agent-teams/` state: read-only, for verification |
| A verification path: `roster_verify` reads the values **actually persisted** in `team.json` | A rubber stamp: when the evidence source is absent it says “unverified” |

## Install

Requirements: DSH provides the `tools` service; Node.js ≥ 22.19. Runtime dependencies are declared (`yaml`, `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`); `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` is a peer (accepted range spans the 0.1, 0.2.0, 0.2.1, 0.2.2 and 0.3 prerelease lines; the suite and both smokes run against 0.2.2-rc.1).

```
@stofone/dsh-agent-roster
```

The package ships `cordis.patch.yml`, so installing it into a profile wires the plugin. After install you should see **eleven tools** (see “Tools”) and an **Agent Roster** panel in the left sidebar.

Plugin code is loaded when DSH starts: after upgrading, **restart `dsh web`**. Swapping `node_modules` alone leaves the running host on the old build.

## Quick start

The roster library is **global** by default: one per machine, independent of workspaces, at `$DSH_HOME/agent-roster` (`~/.dsh/agent-roster`; the mounted data volume under Docker). It is created on first save.

A v2 space looks like this:

```
~/.dsh/agent-roster/
├── space.yaml                     # optional: register the library as a space
├── roles/
│   └── core-review-lead/
│       └── AGENT.md               # a role = one directory + one AGENT.md
├── rosters/
│   └── core-review/
│       ├── roster.yaml            # a roster = members + orchestration
│       └── capabilities.yaml      # optional: what the deployment must provide
└── dist/
    └── core-review-1.0.0.json     # compiled artifact (self-contained)
```

```bash
npx dsh-agent-roster validate --dir examples     # validate the example space (v2)
npx dsh-agent-roster list --dir examples         # list rosters and members
npx dsh-agent-roster compile --roster examples/rosters/core-review   # print the compiled result
```

The repo ships two example libraries: [`examples/`](./examples) (v2) and [`examples-orchestration/`](./examples-orchestration) (v2, demonstrating gates and the task plan).

## Three on-disk shapes

| Shape | Layout | Produced by |
|---|---|---|
| **Flat library (v1)** | `<root>/<id>/roster.yaml` | hand-written, single installs, old libraries |
| **Space (v2)** | `<root>/roles/` + `<root>/rosters/` (+ optional `snippets/`, `space.yaml`) | hand-written, `migrate`, `clone` |
| **Pulled copy** | a space or flat library + `.dsh-roster-origin.json` (origin ledger) | `clone` / the panel’s “pull the whole space” |

`space.yaml` is an **optional** declaration layer: with it you get “declared vs on disk vs missing vs undeclared”; without it the library is still scanned, just without that reconciliation. Favourites live in `.dsh-roster-favorites.json` at the library root (a dotfile; the scanner skips it).

## Roster format (v1, flat libraries)

```yaml
kind: dsh-agent-roster/v1
roster: core-review          # must equal the directory name
version: 1.0.0               # exact SemVer
title: Core review
description: A fixed team for code review and release gating.
license: MIT
maintainers: [STofone]
tags: [review, release]

defaults:                    # shared route defaults
  provider: deepseek
  model: deepseek-v4.1-flash
  reasoningEffort: high

members:
  - name: reviewer           # kebab-case, unique in the team
    role: Code review
    systemPrompt: |
      Look for semantic errors first, style second.
    toolPolicy: readonly
  - name: release-manager
    role: Release gating
    systemPrompt: |
      Check the diff, the version bump, and the rollback plan.

captain:                     # optional: what the session that creates the team looks like
  name: lead
  provider: tsingmicro
  model: deepseek-v4.1-flash
  personaPrefix: |
    Restate the goal and the acceptance criteria before delegating.
```

| Key | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | yes | `dsh-agent-roster/v1` |
| `roster` | yes | kebab-case id; must equal the directory name (position is identity) |
| `version` | yes | exact SemVer, no ranges |
| `title` / `description` / `license` / `maintainers` / `tags` | no | display and discovery metadata |
| `defaults` | no | `provider` / `model` / `reasoningEffort` inherited by members |
| `members` | yes | 1–32 |
| `captain` | no | never creates a session and never writes team state; its persona is injected into the captain session's system prompt (a session-scoped section, same as members). `roster_verify` reports attached / not attached; a gap against the deployment preset persona is still `needs-config` |

Member keys: `name`, `role`, `systemPrompt` (required), plus `provider`, `model`, `reasoningEffort`, `toolPolicy`, `fallback`, `toolScope`, `maxTokens`, `title`, `tags`, `notes`, `description`, `aliases`, `skills`, `examples`.

A directory is probed as `roster.yaml` → `roster.yml` → `roster.json`; **exactly one** is accepted. A second file is an error, never a silent pick. Unknown keys are errors.

## Role → roster → artifact (v2)

### Roles: `roles/<name>/AGENT.md`

A role is “one directory plus a file named exactly `AGENT.md`”; directories may nest (up to 3 levels), but a directory holds at most one role. Identity comes from frontmatter `name`, not the directory name; duplicate names are an error.

```yaml
---
kind: "dsh-agent-roster/role@1"
name: "core-review-lead"
version: "1.0.0"
role: "Lead"
title: "Orchestration"
description: "Runs the review, splits work, merges conclusions"
tags: ["orchestration"]
route:
  provider: "deepseek"
  model: "deepseek-v4.1-flash"
  reasoningEffort: "high"
tools:
  policy: "read-only"
requires:
  skills: ["frontend-skill"]
---
```

The body is the persona. `prompt.parts` may add fragments after the body, in order; fragments must live inside the role directory (escaping is an error).

### Rosters: `rosters/<id>/roster.yaml`

```yaml
kind: dsh-agent-roster/roster@2
id: core-review
version: 1.0.0
title: Core review
description: A small team: the lead splits work, review gates it, a fixer closes it.
license: MIT
maintainers: [stofone]
tags: [review, example]

defaults:
  route:
    provider: deepseek
    model: deepseek-v4.1-flash
    reasoningEffort: high
targets: [agent-teams/members]

members:
  - as: reviewer            # name inside the team
    role: reviewer@1.0.0    # role reference with an exact version
  - as: fixer
    role: fixer@1.0.0
    prompt:
      append: overrides/fixer.md   # member-level append, joined at the end

captain:
  role: lead@1.0.0
  persona: captains/lead.md    # a file path (relative to the roster dir); its body is the persona

orchestration:
  shape: gate-pipeline
  stages:
    - id: build
      serial: [fixer]
    - id: audit
      parallel: [reviewer]
  gates:
    - id: tests-pass
      after: [audit]
      by: reviewer
      requires: [Existing tests pass]
      verify:
        - command: node --test
          expectExit: 0

requires:
  toolPolicies: [member-safe]
onMissing: refuse
```

Roster keys: `kind`, `id`, `version`, `title`, `description`, `license`, `maintainers`, `tags`, `defaults`, `targets`, `members`, `captain`, `orchestration`, `requires`, `onMissing`, `notes`.

There is exactly one way to assemble the execution prompt (`lib/frontmatter.js#assemblePrompt`):

```
executionPrompt = join("\n\n", [member prepend, body after references, ...prompt.parts, member append])
```

Budgets are **characters**: body 8000, one part 6000, 16 parts, 12000 after expansion, member append 6000.

### Orchestration and gates

`orchestration.stages` are stages (`serial` / `parallel` lists, optional `join`, `on`, `maxRounds`); `gates` are gates (`after`, `by`, `requires`, `verify`).

A gate without an executable check is an error (`gate-unverifiable`): each `verify` entry needs `command` and `expectExit` (1–8 entries). **Only what a machine can run counts as a gate**; prose criteria belong in `requires`.

A gate may also declare a **failure edge**: where control goes when the gate fails, and how many times it may retry.

```yaml
gates:
  - id: tests-pass
    after: [audit]
    onFail: { to: repair, maxRounds: 2 }
```

- `onFail.to` must be a declared stage and must **not** be in this gate's own `after` (that is a retry in place, with no repair step) — `onfail-immediate`.
- It must be covered by another gate's `after`; otherwise the repair never returns to a gate and the edge has no exit — `onfail-dangling`.
- `maxRounds` is required (1–5) — a retry without a bound is a loop with no stop condition.
- Two failure edges may point at each other; the product of the rounds around such a loop must stay ≤ 5 (`onfail-unbounded`). `after` declares order only and is not a machine-checkable cycle.

### Compiled artifacts

```bash
npx dsh-agent-roster compile --roster examples/rosters/core-review --write
```

- `dist/<id>-<version>.json` (`compiled@1`): self-contained; members carry `executionPrompt`, `promptStats` (character counts, per-part `{path, kind, line?, sha256}`, an overall sha256) and `provenance`; `source` carries discovery metadata (title, description, tags, license, maintainers).
- `dist/<id>-<version>.tasks.json` (`plan@1`): emitted when the roster has orchestration; `executor: "captain"`.
- `--run <receipt>` folds a failed `run@1` back into the retry card.

## References inside a persona

A persona body may place a shared block inline, **on a line of its own**:

```markdown
{{> snippets/report-shape.md}}
```

- `snippets/…` resolves against the **library root**; other paths resolve against the **role directory**; escaping is an error.
- Exactly one level: a `{{>` inside an included file is `include-nested`.
- Including the same file twice expands it twice; `prompt.parts` still rejects duplicates.
- Budgets apply **after** expansion: 6000 per file, 12000 total, at most 32 references.
- Errors carry line numbers of the whole file; `promptStats` records `{path, kind: "include", line, sha256}`.
- No conditionals, loops, or variables: a roster must be readable literally and statically checkable.

`snippets/` belongs to v2 libraries only; `dist/` is not cloned and must be rebuilt locally.

## Where each field actually lands

| Destination | Fields | Does the runtime receive it? |
|---|---|---|
| **direct** | `name`, `role`, `systemPrompt`, `provider`, `model`, `reasoningEffort`, `toolPolicy` | passed to `agent_teams_add_member` |
| **config** | library directories, team state directory, language, index sources | plugin configuration, not team state |
| **declaration** | `description`, `aliases`, `skills`, `examples`, `tags`, `notes`, `tools.scope` | documentation and validation only; `skills` never auto-loads |

`captain` is its own section: not a member field, never sent to `agent_teams_add_member`; the plugin registers a `deployment:persona-prefix` section on the captain session to inject it. The model still comes from the deployment.

`roster_create` labels every emitted field with its class; `roster_verify` compares only what the runtime persisted.

`tools.scope` is a declaration too: it is validated and surfaced by `roster_verify` under “declared fields (applied: false)”, but it never reaches `agent_teams_add_member` and does not change what a member may call. Runtime permissions come from `toolPolicy`.

## Capability requirements (`capabilities.yaml`)

A sibling file may declare what the deployment must provide before the team can be built:

```yaml
requires:
  skills: [frontend-skill]
  toolPolicies: [member-safe]
  documents:
    - path: docs/runbook.md
      sha256: 3f2a…            # optional: pin the content, not just the name
onMissing: refuse        # refuse (default) | degraded
```

- Three verifiable classes: whether a skill is installed, whether a toolPolicy id was declared by the deployment, and whether a document is present (and unchanged, if you pinned its sha256).
- Three states: `present` / `missing` / `unknown`; only `missing` triggers `onMissing`; `unknown` (no evidence source) is not a pass.
- `refuse` makes `roster_create` emit no arguments and name what is missing; `degraded` emits them with per-field labels.
- Document paths are relative to the **library root** (not the roster directory); `..` and absolute paths are rejected. A missing file is `missing`; an existing file whose content no longer matches the pinned sha256 is also `missing` (with `why: sha-mismatch`). Documents are never assembled into `executionPrompt` — they are evidence, not persona text.

## Spaces (`space.yaml`)

```yaml
kind: dsh-agent-roster/space@1
space: agent-roster            # must equal the directory name
title: Team roster collection
description: Many rosters living in one repository.
license: MIT
homepage: https://github.com/…
maintainers: [STofone]
layout: monorepo               # monorepo | flat
rosters:
  - id: core-review
  - id: research
    status: active             # active | archived
roles: [core-review-lead, reviewer]   # optional role declarations
```

- `layout` describes file placement, not counts: `monorepo` is `rosters/<id>/roster.yaml`, `flat` is `<id>/roster.yaml`.
- Declared vs disk: missing → error `space-roster-missing`; extra → warn `space-roster-undeclared`; archived but still present → info.
- **`origin` is an error inside a repository**: the source is the repository itself, and a second copy would be a second source of truth. Only pulled local copies may carry `origin: {repo, ref, path}`.

### Pulling a whole space

```bash
npx dsh-agent-roster clone --repo dsh-agent-roster/agent-teams --space agent-teams --dir /tmp/clone
```

It pulls rosters, roles, `parts/`, `snippets/` and `space.yaml` in their original layout, then writes an origin ledger `.dsh-roster-origin.json` (`origin`, `commit`, `pulledAt`, per-file `sha256` and blob id). `dist/` is deliberately not pulled.

### Keeping a pulled copy current

```bash
npx dsh-agent-roster update --dir /tmp/clone/agent-teams           # check only
npx dsh-agent-roster update --dir /tmp/clone/agent-teams --write   # fast-forward
npx dsh-agent-roster update --dir /tmp/clone/agent-teams --accept  # accept local as the new baseline
```

Three-way comparison per file (ledger / disk / remote at the ref), seven states:

| State | Meaning | `--write` |
|---|---|---|
| `clean` | neither side changed | nothing |
| `local-only` | local changed, remote did not | nothing |
| `remote-only` | remote changed, local did not | replace and update the ledger |
| `diverged` | both changed | **nothing**; print both shas and a diff |
| `remote-deleted` | gone on the remote | nothing; keep local and mark it |
| `missing` | gone locally | report only |
| `unverified` | remote did not answer | nothing; **not clean** |

There is deliberately **no auto-merge**: these files are YAML plus prose, with no merge base; a three-way merge would quietly invent duplicate roles or half-renamed members. Real merging belongs to `git clone` — which drags credentials and push access into the plugin, so it is not the default. `--accept` only accepts `local-only`; `diverged` is never accepted.

## Sidebar panel

The plugin adds one row, **Agent Roster**, to the global sidebar (`sidebar.panellist`) and registers the full page under the same id in `main`. Four tabs:

| Tab | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Rosters** | defaults to favourites (segmented control switches to all); create / edit / duplicate / delete / import / export; a “Create team” button per row; expand for members, apply-captain, copy member params; search and a tag pool |
| **Library** | find rosters across local libraries and subscribed sources: search, tag filtering, grouped by source or flat; open local ones, favourite the rest; “pull the whole space” per space; the local space header shows “check updates / apply N updates / N conflicts / N unverified / no baseline” |
| **Teams** | reads the state directory (default `.agent-teams`) and lists the teams actually built, member routes, per-member agreement with the roster, and tasks |
| **Health** | resolved directories, state directory, unconfirmed declarations, and which setting to change |

The design is a **ledger, not a card wall**: one row per roster — a 3px status edge (lit only for error/warn), a monospace id column, title and one-line description, counts on the right, quiet actions. Only the panel root scrolls; expanded content grows the page instead of creating a nested scroll box. Below 860px the tag pool moves above the list and the space header wraps to two lines.

Settings live only in the panel’s gear dialog (language, download region, mirror, library directories, read-only summary); the plugin **no longer registers a DSH settings section**.

### Creating a team

The row button and the `roster_team` tool share one `applyCaptain` path:

- **New session**: pick a workspace (dropdown; duplicates are disambiguated with one parent directory) and type a session name; the session is renamed after creation. The choice is sent as the host `workspaceId` (not just a directory), so the session is accounted in that workspace; a bare directory is resolved to a workspace id first.
- **Existing session**: shown as “workspace · session name”, never an id or a path.
- The captain persona takes two paths: verbatim in the kick-off prompt (one-shot), and a `deployment:persona-prefix` section registered on the session (every turn). See the next section. The model still comes from the deployment, and the plugin writes no runtime state.
- `roster_verify` compares the declared captain route with **the model the captain session actually selected** (`session.*`), not with the deployment default; if the session cannot be read, the check is `unknown` rather than a pass.
- Both the panel and the tool only **queue** the prompt; the model in that session calls `agent_teams_*` to build the team.

### Team engines

Creating a team starts by choosing **which team plugin builds it**; the dropdown lists what this machine actually has:

| Engine | Packages | What it can carry |
|---|---|---|
| Agent Teams | `@nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams` | per-member fields (provider/model/persona/toolPolicy all reach the runtime), a team record, `roster_verify` |
| Experimental Agent Team | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team` + `-tool-agent-team` | every session is already the Lead of an implicit team, so there is no create step; the prompt uses `spawn_teammate` + `list_agents`. It **cannot take member model/persona/toolPolicy**, and there is no team name (the session name is the identity) |

Engines that are not installed stay in the dropdown but are disabled and marked “not installed” — the dependency is never silent; when none is available the submit button is disabled. Detection means “this profile can resolve the package”, not “it is enabled”; whether it is mounted is the host's call. `POST /apply` takes a closed-set `target` (unknown → 400 `unknown-target`), and `roster_team` accepts `target` too.

### How the captain persona reaches the session

Member personas work because `dsh-agent-teams` registers a `systemPrompt.section` named `deployment:persona-prefix` on each **member child session**; a same-named section shadows the deployment persona. The captain is a top-level session, outside its remit, so this plugin adds the other half:

- It registers the **same section name** on the captain session's ctx, with the roster persona (v1 `captain.systemPrompt` / `captain.personaPrefix`, v2 `captain.persona` file body).
- `text` is a function, evaluated by the host on every model step, so edits take effect immediately and no restart or session rebuild is needed; on a read failure the last good text is kept — **never an empty string that would shadow the deployment persona**.
- Ownership is resolved, not guessed: read the team's `captainSessionId`, then the `roster:<id>@<ver>#<sha8>` provenance in the team description to find the roster. A new session creates the session first and the team second, so a short poll (up to 30 minutes) attaches as soon as the team lands.
- It is an in-process contribution, not a preset written to disk: disabling the plugin returns the session to the deployment persona. A restart re-resolves the team on `agent/created` and reattaches.
- `roster_verify` prints an extra line: `captain persona: attached <id> (N chars · #sha8 · file/inline) → session …`. Sessions created before the plugin was enabled show `not attached`, and keep working off the kick-off message.
- Set `injectCaptainPersona` to `false` to opt out; behaviour falls back to the kick-off message only.

### Favourites

Favourites live in `.dsh-roster-favorites.json` at the library root (`dsh-agent-roster/favorites@1`, at most 500 entries, atomic replace). Saving or importing auto-favourites the new roster; deleting unfavourites it; a broken file yields one warning and the panel still works. Favourites **affect the view only** and never move files.

## Tools (eleven: ten read-only, `roster_team` creates a session)

| Tool | Purpose | Key parameters |
|---|---|---|
| `roster_list` | list rosters and members | `path?` |
| `roster_show` | all fields, destinations and diagnostics for one roster | `ref`, `member?`, `path?` |
| `roster_create` | emit ready-to-use member arguments + provenance line `roster:<id>@<ver>#<sha8>` | `ref`, `path?` |
| `roster_verify` | compare against the values persisted in `team.json` | `ref`, `team?`, `path?` |
| `roster_diff` | semantic diff between two rosters | `from`, `to`, `path?` |
| `roster_index` | public index state; collections carry `pulled` / `space` / `layout` | `collection?`, `source?`, `refresh?` |
| `roster_space` | declared vs on-disk rosters, roles, origin and ledger commit | `path?` |
| `roster_search` | search across local and subscribed sources (words are ANDed; remote scans at most 8 sources and reports truncation) | `query`, `path?`, `remote?`, `limit?` |
| `roster_compile` | compilation preview (writes nothing) | `ref`, `path?` |
| `roster_changes` | per-file update check (seven states) | `path?`, `refresh?` |
| `roster_team` | create a team from a roster (new or existing session) | `id`, `teamName?`, `mode?`, `workspace?`, `sessionName?`, `sessionId?`, `target?`, `path?` |

Writing goes through the CLI and the panel’s HTTP routes only; the tool layer stays read-only.

## CLI

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `validate [--dir…] [--json]` | validate libraries; exit code 1 on errors |
| `list [--dir…] [--json]` | list rosters and members |
| `compile --roster <dir> [--write] [--run <receipt>] [--json]` | compile a v2 roster; `--write` writes `dist/` |
| `migrate --dir <dir> [--from <sub>] [--repo <owner/repo>] [--write]` | migrate v1 → v2 in place |
| `clone --repo <owner/repo> [--ref] [--path] [--space] [--dir]` | pull a whole space with a ledger |
| `update --dir <space> [--write] [--accept] [--json]` | check / fast-forward / accept |
| `registry validate --file <path>` | validate a public index |
| `registry fetch --file <path> [--local-only]` | confirm every collection really resolves |
| `registry sync --file <path> [--write]` | recompute roster lists and file maps from the repo |

## Routes (twelve)

| Route | Method | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `/plugins/dsh-agent-roster/library` | GET | panel snapshot: workspaces, libraries, rosters, teams, diagnostics, counts, `hostWorkspaces` |
| `/plugins/dsh-agent-roster/document` | GET | raw and parsed document for the editor |
| `/plugins/dsh-agent-roster/rosters` | POST | create / update / delete / import / export |
| `/plugins/dsh-agent-roster/apply` | POST | apply the captain: new session (workspace + name) or existing session |
| `/plugins/dsh-agent-roster/collection` | GET | read a collection without writing |
| `/plugins/dsh-agent-roster/install` | POST | write a collection into a local library (idempotent, no overwrite by default) |
| `/plugins/dsh-agent-roster/install-space` | POST | pull a whole space into a local directory |
| `/plugins/dsh-agent-roster/catalog` | GET | every roster visible locally or in subscribed sources |
| `/plugins/dsh-agent-roster/search` | GET | `?q=`, with match reasons |
| `/plugins/dsh-agent-roster/favorites` | POST | favourite / unfavourite |
| `/plugins/dsh-agent-roster/space-update` | POST | `check` / `apply` / `accept` |
| `/plugins/dsh-agent-roster/locale` | GET | panel dictionary (`zh` / `en`) |

All are exact routes behind the host `connection` fence; a wrong method is 405. Write routes also enforce a root-directory allow-list and request-body limits.

## Configuration

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `rosterDirs` | `[]` | library directories. Empty = global library `$DSH_HOME/agent-roster`; absolute or `~` paths are global too; only relative paths resolve per workspace. The first entry is the tools’ default |
| `knownToolPolicies` | `[]` | toolPolicy ids declared by the deployment; cross-checking only happens when set |
| `agentTeamsStateDir` | `.agent-teams` | read-only state directory for `roster_verify`, `roster_team`, and captain injection |
| `injectCaptainPersona` | `true` | inject the roster captain persona into the captain session's system prompt (same-named section shadows the deployment persona, re-read every step). Off: kick-off message only |
| `language` | `"auto"` | `auto` follows DSH, or pin `zh` / `en` |
| `indexes` | `[]` | public sources: an `https` `registry.json` or `npm:pkg`; empty = official source; `false` = local only |
| `region` | `"auto"` | download region: `china` uses the Tencent npm mirror; `auto` means `global` (no probing) |
| `registryMirror` | `""` | custom mirror URL (sub-paths allowed); empty uses the region preset |

All eight are volatile: changes apply without a restart, but the running host re-registers tools on its own schedule.

## Diagnostics

Every diagnostic is `{severity, code, path, message, file}`; `validate` exits 1 when there is an error. By family:

| Family | Examples |
|---|---|
| Format | `unknown-field`, `unknown-format`, `multiple-roster-files`, `duplicate-roster-id`, `duplicate-role` |
| Roles and assembly | `missing-part`, `prompt-part-too-long`, `include-syntax`, `missing-include`, `unsafe-include`, `include-nested` |
| Orchestration | `gate-unverifiable`, `gate-without-stage`, `empty-stage`, `onfail-unknown-stage`, `onfail-immediate`, `onfail-dangling`, `onfail-unbounded` |
| Capabilities | `capability-policy-missing`, `capability-skills-unverified`, `capability-cross-check-skipped`, `invalid-document-path`, `invalid-document-sha` |
| Policy | `tool-policy-cross-check-skipped` (a warning when `knownToolPolicies` is unset: a typo'd id passes too, because there is nothing to check it against) |
| Spaces | `space-roster-missing`, `space-roster-undeclared`, `space-roster-archived`, `multiple-space-files`, `space-origin-not-allowed` |
| Ledger | `no-origin-ledger`, `origin-ledger-broken`, `clone-unsafe-path`, `clone-snippet-missing` |
| Sessions | `session-controller-unavailable`, `session-create-failed`, `session-rename-failed`, `prompt-not-queued` |
| Favourites / writes | `favorites-unreadable`, `write-failed`, `delete-failed` |

## Relationship to `dsh-agent-teams`

- `roster_create` member arguments feed `agent_teams_add_member` directly; every field is labelled direct / config / declaration.
- The provenance line `roster:<id>@<version>#<sha8>` is meant for `agent_teams_create`’s `description`; `roster_verify` parses it and reports `match` / `differ` / `id-only` / `absent`.
- `roster_verify` reads persisted fields in `team.json`; the persona (`executionPrompt`) **is** persisted there (verified on DSH 0.2.2 — the bridge `stateKey` is exactly that). “Unverified” in the report means “no receipt was available”, not “designed not to persist”.
- **The captain persona is now actually in the session**: the plugin registers a `deployment:persona-prefix` section on the captain session (re-read per turn) and `roster_verify` reports attached / not attached instead of `differ`. It remains a different text from the deployment preset persona: if you also want it to survive with the plugin disabled, land it in a profile preset; `roster_verify` reports that gap as `needs-config` with `profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml` and the preset name.
- `toolFilter` is the materialised deny list and is not stored in `team.json`, so it is reported as “unverified”; check policy definitions on the deployment side.
- The plugin never writes team state and has no transfer operation.

```bash
node --test                 # 396 tests
npm run smoke               # host: 11 tools; client: two slots
npm run check:locale        # zh/en dictionary key parity
npx dsh-agent-roster validate --dir examples
npx dsh-agent-roster registry validate --file index/registry.json
```

# DSH plugin development

The process, standards, and templates for building DeepSeek Harness plugins in the `dsh-works` organization. It exists so that an idea becomes an agreed plan before it becomes code, and so that no plugin is called done before it was seen working in the live Web UI.

Plugin code does not live here. One plugin is one repository in `dsh-works`; this repository holds the shared process, the `dsh-plugin-development` skill, and a lessons ledger.

## Layout

```
skills/
  dsh-plugin-development/     the skill: SKILL.md, references/, assets/
    SKILL.md                  gates, ground rules, hard rules, routing
    references/               plan, surfaces, build, standards, verify, reference index
    assets/                   plan template and a copyable bundle scaffold
lessons/                      cross-plugin lessons, indexed
docs/decisions.md             why the process looks like this
install.ps1 / install.cmd / install.sh   links the skills into the DSH skills folder
```

## Install on a machine

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/dsh-works/dsh-plugin-development.git
cd dsh-plugin-development
.\install.cmd
```

The script creates a directory junction in `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\skills\`, so `git pull` in this repository updates the live skill without copying anything. Start a new DSH session afterwards; the skill catalog is discovered per session.

`install.cmd` only wraps `install.ps1` with `-ExecutionPolicy Bypass`, because a default Windows setup refuses to run `.ps1` files. Remove the links with `.\install.cmd -Uninstall`. Do not delete the skills folder recursively while the links exist; remove the links first.

On macOS or Linux use `./install.sh` and `./install.sh --uninstall`.

## How a plugin gets built

The skill runs five gates: **idea**, **plan** (the user approves it), **build**, **verify** in the running harness, and **lesson**. The full rules are in `skills/dsh-plugin-development/SKILL.md`; the practical detail lives in its `references/`:

Every plugin supports Windows, macOS and Linux: the gate runs on all three in CI (not only the author's OS), OS actions need a per-platform implementation with a typed fallback, and a test that describes another platform builds that platform's paths in its own flavour — `skills/dsh-plugin-development/references/standards.md` K1–K7, `references/build.md` "Cross-platform".

| Read | When |
|---|---|
| `references/plan.md` | turning an idea into an approvable plan |
| `references/surfaces.md` | picking the extension point (tool, hook, UI slot, chat row, MCP, adapter) |
| `references/build.md` | scaffolding, manifest, install, dev loop |
| `references/standards.md` | the MUST/SHOULD rules the code has to satisfy |
| `references/verify.md` | proving it works, and rolling back |
| `references/reference-index.md` | which harness document answers which question |

## Branches

Every plugin repository keeps `main` as the **stable line** and `dev` as the **integration line**. Work happens on `dev`, or on a `feature/<slug>` branch cut from it; a `hotfix/<slug>` is cut from `main`, merged into `main`, then merged back into `dev`. A release merges `dev` into `main` after the full `check`, tags `v<version>`, and merges `main` back into `dev`. Never force-push either long-lived branch; never develop directly on `main` after the initial scaffold. The rules are in `skills/dsh-plugin-development/SKILL.md`; the practical steps are in `references/build.md`.

## Where plugins live

| Artifact | Location |
|---|---|
| plugin repository | `github.com/dsh-works/<plugin-name>`, cloned to `Documents\deepseek-harness\<plugin-name>` |
| harness reference checkout | `Documents\harness-sc\deepseek-harness` — read only |
| process, skill, lessons | this repository |

## Compatibility

DeepSeek Harness is in developer preview and its plugin APIs are pre-stable. Every plugin declares `engines.dsh` in `package.json`; when the harness moves, re-audit `references/standards.md` against the new checkout rather than assuming the old rules still hold.

## Dependencies

Building a plugin needs Node.js 22 or newer and a `dsh` installation on `PATH` (or a harness checkout, where `pnpm dsh` runs the same launcher from source). This repository itself has no dependencies.

# Harness Anything **Every agent run should make your repository smarter.** Harness Anything is the self-evolving harness for self-evolving repositories. It turns decisions, failures, facts, and reviews into durable project memory — then gates *"done"* so progress compounds instead of evaporating into chat.

Get started | Why it compounds | How it works | Docs

English | 简体中文

--- ## Quickstart Choose the setup you need, then paste its prompt into your coding agent: | Harness Anything only | Harness Anything + DeepSeek Harness plugin | | --- | --- | | CLI, daemon, GUI and skills for your coding agents | The same Harness setup plus the plugin for an installed **DSH desktop App (macOS, Windows)** | | [harness-download](./skills/harness-download/SKILL.md) | [harness-dsh-install](./skills/harness-dsh-install/SKILL.md), reusing an existing Harness installation | ### Harness Anything only ```text Read skills/harness-download/SKILL.md from https://github.com/FairladyZ625/harness-anything and use it to guide me through first-time Harness Anything setup: check the environment, download the source to a persistent directory, link the full skill set into my selected agents’ user directories, then initialize this repository, set up the CEO knowledge locations, and complete one real task with harness-ceo. Read information available in the project and environment directly. When a choice or approval is needed, show me the concrete proposal first, and do not ask again about something I have already confirmed. ``` ### Harness Anything + DeepSeek Harness plugin (macOS, Windows) Copy this single paragraph to your agent: ```text Read skills/harness-dsh-install/SKILL.md from https://github.com/FairladyZ625/harness-anything and use it to install Harness Anything, its complete skill set, and the plugin for my DeepSeek Harness desktop App (macOS or Windows). Reuse my existing Harness installation and preserve customized skills; install only what is missing. Check the DSH version, list my profiles and let me confirm the desktop profile, then install the plugin and verify ha from DSH, the ha-ceo/ha-worker presets, the tutorial, and the Harness panel. Continue repository onboarding if this project needs it, and report any prerequisites or checks that remain incomplete. ``` The [installation skill](./skills/harness-dsh-install/SKILL.md) prepares the plugin from a persistent source checkout and links it into the chosen DSH profile. The plugin is currently private; do not use an unpublished npm install command. The checkout must contain `packages/dsh-plugin`. For manual installation after the agent prepares it, prefer DSH **Plugins → Add plugin** with the absolute `link:` path it provides; the profile-specific CLI command is the fallback. The skill installs all available usage skills and preserves existing custom versions.
Skills installation options and setup details Install the onboarding skill for the agents you use. This example selects Codex and Claude Code; omit an agent you do not use, or choose other supported agents interactively: ```bash bunx skills add FairladyZ625/harness-anything --skill harness-download -g -a codex claude-code ``` Without Bun, replace `bunx` with `npx`. Bun runs the Skills installer; Harness itself currently runs on Node 24+ from a persistent source checkout. The agent continues through each stage: | Skill | Responsibility | | --- | --- | | [harness-download](./skills/harness-download/SKILL.md) | Prepare the environment and persistent source checkout, link the skills, and coordinate the remaining setup | | [harness-install](./skills/harness-install/SKILL.md) | Adopt the available Harness installation in a target repository, preserving existing instructions and identity approvals | | [harness-issue](./skills/harness-issue/SKILL.md) | Turn a finding into a source-triaged public issue that survives review without a close-and-resubmit round trip | | [harness-ceo](./skills/harness-ceo/SKILL.md) | Initialize user-owned knowledge locations, select models, carry out real work, and verify delivery | Download the tools once. Use `harness-install` for another repository and `harness-ceo` for daily work. User model matrices, issue records, and feedback stay in the workspace; public skill updates do not overwrite them. You can also inspect or install the complete skill set: ```bash bunx skills add FairladyZ625/harness-anything --list bunx skills add FairladyZ625/harness-anything --skill '*' -g -a codex claude-code ``` The Skills CLI's installed copy is separate from the source installation. The onboarding flow then links the selected agents to the persistent source checkout. Existing customized skills with the same name are checked for conflicts, not automatically overwritten. Moving the source directory breaks those links, so do not keep it in a temporary location. An existing, usable current-generation ledger is reused. Only an identified older generation is routed to [harness-migration](./skills/harness-migration/SKILL.md); an existing directory alone does not authorize overwriting or migration. See the [official Skills CLI documentation](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills) for installation syntax and agent directory selection. Skills can be discovered directly from GitHub. Listing and indexing on [skills.sh](https://skills.sh/docs) are controlled by that service; adding repository documentation does not prove that the service has indexed it.
## Your agent can write code. Can your project learn? Most agent runs are disposable. The reasoning stays in a transcript, settled decisions get reopened, the same mistakes return, and *"done"* is whatever the agent says it is. Harness Anything makes the work accumulate: | Without a harness | With Harness Anything | | --- | --- | | Reasoning disappears with the session | Decisions and facts become durable project memory | | The next agent repeats old mistakes | Failures can become rules, checks, and better workflows | | Completion is a claim | Completion is a state earned through gates | This is not a better chat log. It is a compounding loop for how agents work in your repository. ## Why It Compounds ```text DECIDE → WORK → VERIFY → LEARN → THE NEXT RUN STARTS STRONGER ``` ### Memory that survives the session Every task leaves behind the context that matters: what was decided, what was tried, what was observed, and what remains unresolved. The next agent starts from project memory instead of reconstructing history from scratch. ### Mistakes that become infrastructure A failure should pay rent. Capture it as a fact, turn a recurring lesson into a decision, check, or preset, and the repository becomes harder to break in the same way twice. ### “Done” that means something Agents do not get to close work by confidence alone. A six-field Submission Packet gives the reviewer a traceable claim and inspection entry points; the reviewer records what was checked and why the round is or is not acceptable. Completion then applies the gates declared by the task's resolved preset/profile contract. Coding contracts can require CI, but the kernel requires neither CI nor any minimum number of Facts universally (dec_mrg3z1we/CH1, CH4; ADR-0027 D5-D7). ## Self-Involving By Design Harness Anything is developed through Harness Anything. Its own tasks, decisions, facts, reviews, and completion gates run through the same system it gives your repository. The harness observes its own failures, turns lessons into stronger constraints, and uses those constraints on the next round of development. That is what *self-evolving* means here: not magic, and not autonomous churn. Each completed loop leaves the system better equipped for the next one. Your repository gets the same compounding mechanism. ## Install and run Choose [Harness Anything only](#harness-anything-only) or [Harness + DSH](#harness-anything--deepseek-harness-plugin-macos-windows) above. Both setup skills use a persistent source checkout and require Node.js 24+. Find desktop App builds on the [GitHub Releases page](https://github.com/FairladyZ625/harness-anything/releases). macOS releases are Apple Silicon arm64 only (dmg/zip); Windows releases are x64 NSIS and may show SmartScreen; Linux releases include x64 AppImage (automatic updates) and deb (manual upgrades). For source installation (CLI, daemon, and GUI in one pass, including the Electron download), follow [harness-download](./skills/harness-download/SKILL.md); it is the only source-install recipe. The [contributor guide](./docs-release/contributing/en/01-local-setup.md) covers working on this repository. ## Breaking change: existing repositories must migrate The ledger format has changed by a generation and this project keeps no backward compatibility, so existing repositories cannot be upgraded in place. The old repository is archived read-only and replayed into a new one; it is never at risk. **You do not have to do this by hand, and you do not need the current version installed first.** Paste this to a coding agent working in the repository you want to migrate: > Read `skills/harness-migration/SKILL.md` from > https://github.com/FairladyZ625/harness-anything and > follow it to migrate this project's `harness/` ledger to the current format. > Ask me before each decision the skill says to ask about. The skill fetches the current source into a temporary directory and runs everything from there, so an older Harness installation on the same machine — including a running daemon — is left untouched. It stops and asks you at each point where a choice destroys something: file conflicts between your ledger and the freshly initialized one, records the strict format rejects, and presets that must be rebuilt rather than copied. Prefer to drive it yourself? The [migration guide](./docs-release/migration-genesis-replay.md) is the same procedure in reference form. ## How It Works Harness Anything gives agent work three durable primitives: - **Decision** — what was chosen, what was rejected, and why. - **Task** — what is being changed, its plan, progress, review, and closeout. - **Fact** — what was actually observed, with source and confidence. The runtime authority is a canonical event ledger: accepted commands commit as events to the local SQLite ledger, the content objects they reference are stored beside it, and a rebuildable projection makes those events queryable. The authored Markdown under `harness/` is the document surface derived from accepted events and published to Git; Git records that published history but is not the acceptance boundary. Gates control which state transitions are allowed. The result is a repository that remembers more than its code: - why its architecture looks the way it does; - which attempts failed and should not be repeated; - which work is truly complete and which claims remain open; - how its own development process should improve next. ## Documentation - [Start](./docs-release/start/en/00-what-is-this.md) — install it and run one real loop. ([中文](./docs-release/start/zh/00-what-is-this.md)) - [Learn](./docs-release/learn/en/00-overview.md) — understand the memory model, gates, and compounding loop. ([中文](./docs-release/learn/zh/00-overview.md)) - [Architecture](./docs-release/architecture/en/00-overview.md) — explore the kernel, storage model, write path, and projections. ([中文](./docs-release/architecture/zh/00-overview.md)) - [Release posture](./docs-release/release-posture.md) — see what is shipped, foundational, or planned. - [Harness CEO](./skills/harness-ceo/SKILL.md) — model-neutral delegation, evidence-based acceptance, and onboarding and improvement methods for user-owned model matrices. - [Migration](./docs-release/migration-genesis-replay.md) — replay an older-generation ledger into the current format. ([agent skill](./skills/harness-migration/SKILL.md)) - [Ledger recovery](./docs-release/migration-legacy-ledger-recovery.md) — repair a repository whose legacy ledger the current daemon refuses to attach. ([中文](./docs-release/migration-legacy-ledger-recovery.zh-CN.md)) - [Minimal example](./examples/minimal-project/) — inspect the smallest working project. ## Contributing Sharp bug reports, failing test cases, architecture questions, and focused documentation fixes are especially useful right now. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md) before opening a pull request. ## License [AGPL-3.0-or-later](./LICENSE). Harness Anything stays open, including when it is offered as a service.

# ACP 会员额度仪表盘

在 DeepSeek Harness 的模型选择器旁显示 Google AI Pro 会员额度。基于开源 ACP 适配器二次开发，适用于使用官方 Antigravity ACP 的个人开发场景。

## 功能

- 模型旁双圈仪表：外圈代表 Gemini 五小时额度，内圈代表周额度。
- 悬停或点击查看紧凑浮层：剩余比例、重置时间、登录邮箱、会员类型和读取时间。
- 手动刷新、短时缓存与并发合并；查询失败保留上次结果，不把未知值显示为零。
- 使用官方 CLI 状态行读取额度，不发送模型请求、不提取 OAuth 凭据、不聚合或自动轮换账号。
- 保留上游 ACP Agent 接入、模型选择和工具交互能力。

## 环境与兼容性

当前版本：`0.2.1-rc.4.1+quota.4`。需要 macOS／Linux、Python3 和已登录的官方 Antigravity CLI，当前实测 CLI 为 `1.5.2`。

上游插件声明的 Harness 目标为 `0.2.1-rc.4`；本地在 Desktop `0.2.2-rc.1` 上使用精确版本例外验证安装、对话和额度展示。该结果不代表所有版本与平台均兼容。

本插件独立安装在用户 profile，不修改 Harness Desktop 应用文件或更新机制。桌面端升级后需重新核对插件兼容性，精确版本例外不会自动继承。

## 开发与打包

从本目录执行：

```bash
corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
corepack pnpm typecheck
corepack pnpm exec vitest run test/quota.spec.ts test/quota-cache.spec.ts
corepack pnpm build
mkdir -p dist
npm pack --ignore-scripts --pack-destination dist
```

Node.js 开发固定版本见 `.nvmrc`，包管理器版本见 `package.json`。构建后 `dist/` 中的 tgz 可在 Harness 插件管理器中通过本地文件安装；安装前退出桌面应用，安装后重启。

安装后配置 Antigravity：可执行命令填写本机 `agy` 的绝对路径，参数填写 `acp`。选择对应 Gemini 模型即可看到额度仪表。账号来源为官方 CLI 当前登录账号。

更多开发、数据来源、权限及回退说明见 [会员额度二次开发](docs/会员额度二次开发.md)。

## 上游与许可

本插件不是从零实现：基于 [zaimokuza-yoshiteru/dsh-acp-adapter](https://github.com/zaimokuza-yoshiteru/dsh-acp-adapter)，基准提交 `28ccc6745ec82139c684c3642637e93e00d800f2`。原有 ACP 适配逻辑与历史文档保留，上游 README 见 [上游说明](docs/上游说明.md)。

使用 MIT 许可，原始版权声明见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。保留内部包名 `@zaimokuza/dsh-acp-adapter`，以兼容现有模块、配置及历史会话；`private: true` 用于防止误发布到上游同名 npm 包，不影响本地 tgz 打包和安装。

# Harness 插件集合

用于开发和维护 DeepSeek Harness 插件。每个插件拥有独立目录、依赖、构建与使用说明。

## 插件目录

| 插件 | 目录 | 功能 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ACP 会员额度仪表盘 | [acp-quota-dashboard](acp-quota-dashboard/) | 在模型旁显示 Google AI Pro 额度、重置时间和所属账号；保留 ACP Agent 适配能力 |
| 个人工作台 | [dsh-workbench](dsh-workbench/) | 在左侧主菜单提供工作台入口，支持多通道会话采集、事项待办、日报、周报与月报自动生成 |

## 开发约定

- 后续插件按 `插件目录/` 独立组织，在各自目录中安装依赖、开发和打包。
- 不提交 `node_modules`、构建产物、账号凭据、运行日志或个人环境配置。
- 上游派生插件保留来源说明与原有许可。每个插件的兼容性和验证范围以目录内 README 为准。

DSH 0.2.1-rc.4 is pinned and the documented 0.2.2 exception is not a compatibility certification. Exported lib host/client/remote artifacts are absent from this commit, while prepack builds them. Static source does not bind the proposed local release tarball to those generated outputs. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

# DeepSeek Harness 个人工作台插件 (`@mywork/dsh-workbench`)

原生集成至 **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** 左侧主导航栏的个人工作台插件，具备多通道会话采集、事项看板管理、工作日报增量整理、周报/月报自动归档等全流程功能。

---

## 🌟 核心功能

### 1. 🔌 多通道会话采集源 (Data Sources)
- **DeepSeek Harness 本机会话**：只读扫描 `~/.dsh/sessions` 下的 `session.v4.jsonl.zstd` 和旧版 `session.jsonl.zstd`，支持自定义会话目录。排除空会话、子代理、种子会话及环境/技能注入，仅统计有效用户会话；按会话与北京时间日期生成一句话中文概要，保留真实项目、时间和原话证据，不自动标记工作完成。正文未变时复用概要，模型失败保留已有记录并显示错误。旧版误指向 Antigravity brain 的默认路径会自动迁移，并移除两条内置 DSH 演示事项。
  - Harness 会话解压依赖 `zstd` 命令（macOS 可运行 `brew install zstd`）。自动查找 PATH 与 Homebrew 默认位置，完整读取多帧追加日志；缺少工具或日志损坏时明确报错。
- **Claude Code 会话**：监听并解析本机 Claude Code 日志（`~/.claude`）。
- **Codex 桌面端 / CLI 会话**：只读扫描 Codex 用户目录下的 `sessions` 和 `archived_sessions` 中的 JSONL 日志；默认 `~/.codex`，支持 `CODEX_HOME` 或采集源自定义路径。排除子代理及环境注入消息，按会话和北京时间日期合并，复用模型生成一句话概要，保留真实项目、时间和原话证据。首次同步会整理历史会话，后续正文未变化时复用概要缓存；模型不可用时明确报错并保留原记录。
- **Gemini CLI 会话**：接入 Gemini CLI 历史会话快照（`~/.gemini`）。
- **禅道 Zentao**：支持配置禅道系统地址、账号与 API 凭据，自动同步指派给本人的待办与 Bug 缺陷。
- **采集诊断与状态**：各渠道具备独立的可用性探测、就绪指示、会话统计与一键增量同步能力。

### 2. 📋 事项待办看板 (Tasks Kanban)
- **三态流转**：待办（Pending）、进行中（In Progress）、已完成（Completed）。
- **多维度筛选**：支持关键词搜索、按来源渠道过滤、按执行状态快速切换。
- **事项详情与元数据**：优先级（高/中/低）、置顶（Pin）、截止时间、归属工程项目路径。
- **采信证据溯源**：AI 自动抽取的事项保留原始会话消息、时间戳与原话引用（Quote）。
- **手工待办**：支持随时随地快捷新增日常研发待办。

### 3. 📅 工作日报 (Daily Report)
- **自动归集算法**：智能拉取指定日期内完成的事项与进行中的主线任务，按项目自动分组归类。
- **快速日期定位**：提供今日、昨日、前天快捷跳转及日历日期选择器。
- **双模查看与编辑**：结构化事项卡片与 Markdown 文本预览，支持随时手工微调。
- **一键复制**：提供“复制标准日报”快捷操作，一键生成符合企微、钉钉、Slack 规范的工作简报。
- **历史归档**：修改与保存自动持久化存储至本地仓库。

### 4. 📊 周报与月报 (Weekly & Monthly Reports)
- **智能周期边界计算**：
  - **周报**：按 ISO 标准周（周一至周日）聚合当周完成事项与推进中任务。
  - **月报**：按自然月度统计里程碑产出与阶段性交付。
- **三段式标准结构**：
  1. **核心工作产出与交付**（已达成成果）
  2. **重点攻坚与推进中事项**（在手重点工作）
  3. **下周期规划与风险预警**（后续排期与攻关点）
- **度量统计卡片**：自动统计周期完成事项总数、攻坚事项数、涉及工程项目数、活跃记录天数。
- **支持手工微调、归档保存与一键复制**。

### 5. 💾 本地持久化 (Zero-Config Persistence)
- 数据持久化存储于用户主目录 `~/.dsh-workbench/workbench-store.json`。
- 基于临时文件与原子重命名写入，保障并发与崩溃安全。
- 零外部数据库依赖，无需启动 Docker 或 PostgreSQL，即装即用。

---

## 🏗️ 技术架构

本插件遵循 DeepSeek Harness 原生的 **Cordis 插件规范** 与 **Slots 插槽架构**：

```
DeepSeek Harness 宿主
  ├── 左侧导航栏: @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar
  │     └── 插槽 'sidebar.panellist' -> 注册 WorkbenchIcon (id: 'workbench', order: 15)
  ├── 中央工作区: @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout
  │     └── 插槽 'main' -> 注册 WorkbenchApp (key: 'workbench')
  └── 宿主 HTTP 服务: @deepseek-ai/dsh-host-webserver
        └── 注册 '/api/workbench/*' 具名前缀路由 -> 驱动 Store、Collector 与 ReportEngine
```

---

## 模型设置

在工作日志顶部打开「模型设置」，选择主模型和可选的备用模型后保存。该设置用于新生成的会话概要和日报、周报、月报的「AI 重新整理」。历史概要仍按会话正文复用缓存。 日报、周报和月报的整理请求仅发送工作概要、项目、日期和报告模板。 报告整理的输出预算由所选模型的适配器决定。

模型列表来自 DSH 已启用的提供方。选择「使用 DSH 默认路由」时沿用旧版规则。若 DSH 默认模型来自 ACP，工作日志自动选用普通模型。要使用 Antigravity，请同时安装本仓库的 ACP 适配器 `0.2.1-rc.4.1+quota.4.2` 或更新版本，并在工作日志中明确选择 Antigravity 提供方下的具体模型。Antigravity 请求使用独立的短会话，会将待整理资料发送给所选服务。

主模型调用失败、返回空白或未通过输出检查时尝试备用模型。两者都失败时保留原报告或原有概要，并显示调用错误。

新整理的日报、周报和月报会在标题右侧显示实际使用的模型，切换时标明「备用模型」。历史报告缺少模型记录时显示「整理模型未记录」。 点击「AI 重新整理」时，工作项依次沿金色旋涡弯曲卷入中央，模型返回后按新顺序展开。开启系统的减弱动态效果设置时仅显示整理状态。

## 🛠️ 构建与打包

进入插件目录：

```bash
cd dsh-workbench

# 1. 编译 Host 端 TypeScript 与声明文件
npm run build:host

# 2. 通过 tsdown 打包客户端 Bundle (含 DSH __ModuleLoader__ 包裹层)
npm run build:client

# 3. 完整构建并打包为发布安装包 (.tgz)
npm run pack
```

打包产物位于 `dist/mywork-dsh-workbench-0.1.30.tgz`。

---

## 🚀 安装至 DeepSeek Harness

### 方式一：通过 Harness 界面安装（推荐）
1. 打开 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端 / Web 端。
2. 点击左侧主菜单的 **插件**（Plugins）图标。
3. 选择 **从本地文件安装**（Install from file...），选中 `dist/mywork-dsh-workbench-0.1.30.tgz`。
4. 重启或刷新页面，左侧主菜单将出现 **工作日志** 入口。

### 方式二：通过 DSH 命令行添加
```bash
dsh plugin add ./dist/mywork-dsh-workbench-0.1.30.tgz
```

用于开发和维护 DeepSeek Harness 插件。每个插件拥有独立目录、依赖、构建与使用说明。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# 禅道质量看板

DSH 原生插件，安装后从左侧「禅道质量看板」进入。无需独立服务器、Docker 或前端构建。

- 默认全局首页：自动遍历全部可见项目，只列未关闭冲刺（status != closed），包括已关闭项目下遗留冲刺，无需选择项目、产品或切换冲刺。
- 跨项目冲刺表：所有未关闭冲刺同时展示计划截止、需求关闭率、任务完成率、待解决/待验证缺陷及延期风险，不展示负责人列。
- 每行支持“忽略”；“已忽略”展开名称清单，可取消忽略。本机清单保存于插件目录 .local/ignored-sprints.json，受 Git 忽略保护，刷新与重启后保留。忽略只影响上方关注冲刺及其统计，不加载该冲刺的需求和任务；其缺陷仍读取，用于底部独立的线上问题汇总。轻量目录仍读取以发现新冲刺。
- 最近30天线上问题：独立覆盖全部未关闭冲刺（含已忽略项），保留最近30个自然日创建且 onlineIssue=1 的缺陷，含今天、上海时区；包含待解决、待验证、已关闭，按 Bug ID 去重，并显示状态数量与时间范围。不受忽略清单影响。
- 紧凑样式：页面边距12px、正文13px、表格单元格上下6px、卡片内边距10px。
- 缺陷跟进：未关闭、待验证、P1/P2 未关闭、超过7天未解决，创建人/状态/关键词筛选、分页及原单跳转。创建人使用 openedBy 关联禅道用户 realname，不使用当前指派人；姓名无法获取时明确显示“姓名未获取”，不冒充真实姓名。
- 需求按 closed / 全部计算；任务排除取消与父任务，done、closed 计入完成。关闭需求可能包含非交付关闭，请结合原单核实。
- 底部不再展示标题候选或普通测试缺陷，仅展示原生线上标记。顶部汇总指标仍为全部未关闭冲刺的整体范围。
- 问题龄期为创建时间至今（上海时区）的自然日，不代表 SLA 或实际处理中耗时。
- 全量分页只限当前账号权限范围。任何分项读取失败显示未评估，保留其他成功项。

## 本机依赖与认证

使用 Python3 运行已配置的 zentao-qa 脚本，通过其禅道 v1 接口读取数据及自动续期。插件不包含密码或 Token，不向浏览器返回凭据。当前机器已通过 doctor 验证账号与站点，可复用已有配置，无需重新保存用户密码。

默认脚本为 /Users/linjt/.agents/skills/zentao-qa/scripts/zentao_qa.py。其他机器可通过 ZENTAO_QA_SCRIPT 指定脚本，ZENTAO_QA_CONFIG 指定该工具的本地配置。按照 zentao-qa 登录流程配置认证；本机配置应放在被忽略的 .local 目录，权限0600。

只读 GET 查询使用60秒内存缓存；刷新全局会重新加载全局汇总，60秒内可能复用缓存。全局采集最多4个在途请求，共享进行中的采集，避免重复请求。每次脚本调用最多120秒；错误不返回脚本输出，避免泄漏敏感信息。不提供禅道写入动作。

## 安装

通过当前 DSH 的 plugin_manager install_bundle，target 指向此目录的绝对路径。本地目录安装由 DSH 管理；升级已加载版本可能需要重启 DSH，以安装结果为准。

## 验证

运行 node --check client.js、node --check index.js、node --test global.test.js；验证未关闭过滤、跨项目缺陷去重、分项失败和父子任务口径，并读取真实全局汇总。不启动浏览器，因此视觉布局与点击验收需用户在现有 DSH 页面确认。

evidence.readmeExcerpt: # dsh-review-hub · 明镜 **给 DSH 加一层审批大脑：能自动放的自动放，该问你的才问你，事后还能查、能撤回。** > AI 是灯下献策的幕僚，镜子只负责把每道审批照得清清楚楚。 中文 · [English](README-EN.md) ｜ 🤖 **你是 AI？先读 [README-AI.md](README-AI.md)；要自己改代码，动手前再读 [AGENT.md](AGENT.md)。** --- ## 它是什么 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）在工具需要提权时会停下来问人：`approval/request` 是一条瀑布链，链末端没人应答就等于拒绝。本插件注册成**唯一的裁决者**，在这一刻做三件事： 1. **L0 硬风险直接给你** —— 删目录、丢改动（`git reset --hard` 这类）、碰凭据、远程执行、改系统、批量破坏，一律不问 AI、不进记忆。 2. **重复操作学会放行** —— 同一条无害命令你亲手批满 3 次，之后它自己放（按会话隔离，换会话重新学）。 3. **其余交给 AI 预审** —— 一次小模型调用（≈300–500 tokens），只允许两个结论：`allow`（放）或 `ask`（拿不准，交给你）。**AI 没有否决权**。 因为裁决者唯一，每条记录的"谁放的"是事实而不是猜测：`ai` / `memory` / `human` / `external` / `fallback`。 > **AI 预审默认覆盖 ops 插件的命令**：[dsh-ops](https://github.com/T-Auto/dsh-ops) 发布的 `ops_bash` 与只读的 `ops_read_files` / `ops_grep` / `ops_glob` / `ops_inspect_local_file` / `ops_status`、以及它的后台任务工具 `job_output` / `job_list` 都在默认 AI 名单里——不用额外配置，装好就会预审它们。其它工具（`write` / `edit` 等）走记忆档，`plugin_manager` 这类默认直接问你；要增减都在插件页「高级设置 → 先交给 AI 的工具 / 不交给 AI 的工具」里改。 --- ## 决策链 一次 `approval/request` 进来，按**固定顺序**过四道关：谁先命中谁负责，后面的层不再参与。 ``` ① L0 硬风险（确定性，不花钱） ├ 命中 → 直接问你；不进 AI、不计入记忆、永不自动放行 └ 未命中 ↓ ② 记忆（确定性） ├ 本会话里这条操作你亲手批满阈值（默认 3 次）→ 自动放行 └ 未命中 ↓ ③ 文件级（确定性，需你显式开开关） ├ 这个文件的人工批准次数 ≥ 阈值 → 自动放行 └ 未命中 ↓ ④ AI 预审（一次小模型调用，≈300–500 tokens） ├ allow → 放行（decidedBy = ai） └ ask → 交给你；AI 没有否决权，只能放行或提问 ↓ ⑤ 人工 ``` 顺序不是随意的：**确定性在概率之前**。凡是规则能判的（硬风险、记忆、文件级）一律不交给模型；模型只处理"剩下那些无害、但还没见过"的请求。 每条记录都写明是哪一层做的决定：`ai` / `memory` / `human` / `external` / `fallback`，并附带 `agentKind`（请求方）、`tier`（档位）、`aiSource`（AI 是否真的审过）。事后想回答"这条为什么没让 AI 看"，看这三列就够了；被 AI 打回、再由你决定的那些，行内会标 **AI 打回 · 人工通过/拒绝**，日期左边写着真正做判断的评审模型。 --- ## 你会看到什么 - **输入框上方**一张淡色卡片：AI 通过（淡绿）/ 记忆通过（淡蓝）/ 待审批（淡黄），右侧有复制和关闭按钮；没有审批时整行不出现，不占地方。 - **别的会话**有审批时只出一张灰色聚合卡：`会话名 · AI通过 0 · 记忆通过 1`，不和当前对话混在一起，只能手动关。 - **对话顶部「审批」标签**：完整时间线（工具、归属、理由、参数、耗时、记忆进度），放大镜找历史；有新审批时标签出现 🔴 红点，列表用 `—— 以上为新增审批 ——` 把"看过的"和"新的"隔开。 - **右侧栏「改动」**：点某行的「改动」看那一次调用的 diff（双行号），一键撤销（连点两次确认，3 秒不点作废）。 - **需要你决策时**，提示卡和系统通知直接写着 AI 的意见：`AI 建议人工 · high · 理由说读文件但命令会删目录` —— 批之前你就知道 AI 看到了什么。 - **需要你决策时**还有一张**悬浮卡**（右上角），内容与输入框上方那张一致——宿主的人工审批面板会盖住输入框上方那条，这张浮在窗口层。 - **台账导出**：CSV / JSON，按会话或全部。 --- ## 和同类插件的关系 DSH 的审批生态里已经有不少插件，思路各不相同。本插件把这些思路里**能共存的那些**收进一个实现：确定性优先的硬风险层（不需要模型）、AI 预审层（只能放行或转人工）、按会话的学习层，以及完整的面板/diff/撤销。 如果只记四条差异，是这四条（其余都是实现细节）： 1. **AI 只有 `allow` / `ask`，没有否决权**——`deny` 被强制降级成「转人工」。多数同类插件让模型直接拒（fail-closed），一次误判就变成拒绝执行。 2. **记忆只数「人工批准」**——AI 或记忆自己放行的次数不推进计数器，所以「学满自动放行」的每一分证据都是人给的，可审计。 3. **模型只看脱敏摘要**——送审的是压缩后的参数摘要（路径/命令裁剪过），不是原文；凭据类路径连摘要都不给。 4. **有完整的审批 UI**——时间线、diff、撤销、CSV/JSON 台账导出，而不是「弹一下就没了」。 下表版本核对于 **2026-11-03 / 09**（`registry.npmjs.org/<包名>/latest` 与 GitHub 页面复核）。**本表只作历史参考**——这些包都在更新，读的时候以当天的 npm / GitHub 为准： | 插件 | 版本 | 它的做法 | 与本插件的关系 | |---|---|---|---| | [`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review) | 0.1.6-alpha.1（`next` = 0.2.2-rc.1） | 官方随宿主的实验性基线：用当前会话模型审每个调用，无确定性危险清单，风险/理由不落盘 | 本插件的对比基线：确定性层（不花钱、可预测）、记忆、审计 UI 是它没有的 | | [`dsh-auto-approve`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-auto-approve) | 0.7.1 | 保留沙箱、只裁 escalation；确定性危险清单先于分类器；会话记忆（同工具 + 同参数原文哈希，TTL 30 分钟、仅在内存）；分类器失败回落人工 | **功能面最接近的一个**。差异：本插件的记忆是持久 + 阈值 + 只计人工批准，且危险清单命中永不进记忆（这点两家一致） | | [`dsh-plugin-auto-review`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-auto-review) | 0.1.0 | 移植 Codex Guardian / Grok escalation 的审查提示，模型可拒绝，无人值守时直接拒 | 反面参照：机器可拒绝正是本项目的红线（人在环里才有最终决定权） | | `danger-full-access`** | 撤掉该预设 | | 规模 / 已知敞口 | 12 个服务端模块 + 约 4.3k 行客户端，97 条测试；凭据类路径落 L0 硬拦，快照不存其正文 | 单文件 617 行；顶层 `run_code` 调用豁免审查 | 11 文件约 180KB；README 自述默认会放行写 `~/.dsh/profiles/`（运行时自改供应链路径） | **怎么选**：三者不是零和，真要比就比三件事——① **否决权在谁手里**（官方能让 AI 拒你，明镜的 AI 只会说「建议放行」或「交给你」）；② **学习能不能审计**（30 分钟内存哈希 vs 跨重启、只计人工、逐条可删）；③ **数据边界**（全量历史与原始参数 vs ≤240 字符脱敏摘要）。 ## 安装 写进 profile（`~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`），而不是跑 `npm install`： 1. `package.json` 的 `dependencies` 加 `"dsh-review-hub": "link:<本仓库路径>"`； 2. `bundles` 数组加 `dsh-review-hub`，并移除**其它会作答 `approval/request`** 的审批插件（见上一节；纯通知类可留，但要确认不抢答）； 3. 用 DSH 自带的 pnpm 执行 `install --lockfile-only`（**不要**全量 install，会清掉原生模块构建）； 4. 建 junction：`node_modules/dsh-review-hub` → 本仓库目录； 5. **检查 `cordis.patch.yml`**：任何带 `name:` 的旧补丁行都会在 bundle 行删掉后继续把插件挂回来； 6. 重启宿主（服务端半身加载时绑定；客户端半身刷新页面即可）。 详细步骤与踩坑见 [README-AI.md](README-AI.md) 与 [AGENT.md](AGENT.md)。 --- ## 设置在哪 - **日常设置** → 对话顶部「审批」标签页里的「设置」：AI 审查、审查模型、记忆自动通过、放行阈值、提示卡、三档卡片时长、系统通知。开关是主机同款滑块，每项下面一句人话。 - **审查模型**是两级下拉（先选 provider、再选模型），名单来自宿主自己的模型目录（`llm.listProviders()` + 每个 provider 的 `listModels()`），默认 `跟随会话`；下面一行小字「实际使用」告诉你此刻真正在用哪个车道，尾部刷新图标可手动重拉目录。目录为空（宿主没接 llm）时才退回手填。 - **高级设置（不要乱改）** → 插件页的插件卡片：兜底轮询间隔、保留条数、审查超时、每轮上限、熔断次数、按请求方分档、**先交给 AI 的工具**（只填增量，内置基线写死在代码里）与**不交给 AI 的工具黑名单**（黑名单优先，能盖掉内置基线；write / edit 属记忆档，两边都动不了它）、**卡片预览**（常驻：就地渲染五种卡片 + 本会话实时 + 两个悬浮卡自测按钮），以及**启用「清空历史」**（默认关；开启后仍需连点三次，服务端也校验这个开关）。 --- ## 常见问题 **Q：为什么 AI 没出现就直接问我？** 硬风险（6 类）根本不进 AI；或者没有可用模型服务、请求超时、熔断中。记录会写明 `aiSource`。 **Q：AI 会不会把危险操作放过去？** **会——但具体要看对应模型的能力和你是否信任 TA，这也是这套设计唯一真正的风险点。** AI 判 `allow` 时，这一次审批就不再问你了，所以这个问题的答案取决于两件事：那条车道上的模型到底能不能看懂这段命令，以及你是否愿意把自己的一部分判断交出去。 但能约束的部分已经约束住了：① 6 类硬风险（删除、丢改动、凭据、远程执行、系统级、批量破坏）根本不送 AI，直接找你；② AI 只看到脱敏后的参数摘要与理由，判定标准写死为"可逆、范围明确、与理由一致"，拿不准就必须 `ask`；③ 你可以随时关掉 AI 审查，也可以在高级设置里把工具拉黑、或把某个请求方档位调严。剩下的那一小块——模型的判断力——不是这套设计能替你保证的；时间线就是给你复核用的。 **Q：为什么批了很多次它还没学会？** 记忆只统计**人工**批准（AI 通过、记忆通过都不计数，否则会自我强化），硬风险永不学习；进度显示为"记忆 n/3 次"。 **Q：AI 用哪条线路？花多少 token？** 默认跟随当前会话的模型，也可以在设置里钉一个便宜车道。它只看到脱敏后的参数摘要（≤240 字符）与理由，一次约 300–500 tokens；裁决结果落盘缓存，重启后不重复花钱。 **Q：推荐使用什么模型？** 够用就好，贵不等于好，但参数越小越容易出错。 **Q：能多开窗口吗？** 能，但两个窗口各自记"已看/基线"，红点可能不同步。 --- ## 安全边界 写清楚这里能防什么、不能防什么，比含糊其辞有用。 - **谁能读到这些数据**：插件的 HTTP 面（`/api/review-hub/*`）只监听宿主自己的 loopback 端口，并校验 `Host` 是回环地址、`Origin`/`Referer` 与之同源（桌面壳的 `dsh-app:` 协议单独放行）。**没有额外的 token**，也**没有**「请求必须来自浏览器」这层校验——实测桌面壳的请求既不发送 `Origin` 也不发送 `Sec-Fetch-Site`，加这层校验会把面板整个打成 403（2026-11-09 真机验证）。所以本机上的任何进程，只要能连到那个端口，就能读写台账与设置；宿主端口每次启动随机分配（`--port 0`）是目前唯一的实际屏障。想收紧有两条现成的路，都在插件配置（不是面板设置）里： - `strictOrigin: true` —— 要求 `Sec-Fetch-Site`。默认关，因为桌面壳不发这个头，开了面板会全 403。 - `writeProofCookie: ""` 或 `writeProofHeader: "<头名>"` —— **只拦写方法**（`POST`），读与 SSE 不受影响。默认空 = 关。这个值不该靠猜：先用 `debugHeaders: true` 把每个请求的 header 名与 cookie 名记到 `~/.dsh/storages/review-hub/http-probe.log`（只记名字，不记值；最多 400 行），对比面板与 `curl` 的差异，再把面板独有、`curl` 没有的那一个填进来。 - **磁盘上有什么**：`~/.dsh/storages/review-hub/` 下有台账（每条审批的工具名、参数、理由、判定者）、记忆表、设置、AI 裁决缓存，以及 `snapshots/` —— 后者保存 `write`/`edit` 目标的**改前全文**（单文件上限 256KB，每会话最多 64 条）。也就是说：**你批准过的文件内容，会以明文留在这台机器上**，包括你编辑过的 `.env`、配置文件。 - **怎么清掉**：删除整个 `~/.dsh/storages/review-hub/` 目录即可（插件下次启动会重建）。审批页的「清空历史」只清台账与记忆，**不动 `snapshots/`**。 - **AI 层看到了什么**：只送脱敏后的参数摘要（≤240 字符）与理由，不送完整文件内容；裁决结果落盘缓存，重启不重复计费。 - **AI 没有否决权**：它只能说 `allow` 或 `ask`。`deny` 会被降级成 `ask`——这条是硬约束，见 [README-AI.md](README-AI.md)。 --- ## 性能 空闲时**零请求**（一条本地 SSE 挂着，30 秒一次心跳）；审批事件一条一帧（实测单条记录 ≈630 字节，本机约 0.5 次/小时）。断流自动退到 3 秒轮询；窗口最小化时断流，不唤醒渲染进程。 --- ## 已知限制 - **无人值守**：在要放养的那个会话里打开「不与其他会话同步」，再关掉 AI 审查——这一停只作用于该会话，其它会话的 AI 预审照旧。 - 深绑 DSH 内部结构（席位名、右侧栏 API、`--dsh-composer-*` CSS 变量），宿主大版本升级可能要适配； - 客户端是一个约 4100 行的单文件 bundle（没有构建步骤）； - 审批页按会话，没有"所有会话汇总"视图； - 撤销是"投递指令给会话"，需要该会话还有可用 agent； - 写前快照有上限（单文件 256KB / 每会话 64 条），超限只能看元数据。 - **AI 裁决缓存跨会话共享**（键 = 请求方档位 + 参数指纹），默认保留 10 分钟：同一个指纹只要任意会话付过一次模型钱，其它会话直接复用那条裁决（行上记 `aiSource=cache`）。所以「本会话 AI 调用 0 次」不代表 AI 没参与——既可能是档位把它压成了人工，也可能是命中了别人付过钱的缓存；统计页的「审批缓存 N 条」是整个池子，不是本会话的。 --- ## 文档导航 | 文件 | 给谁看 | |---|---| | [README-EN.md](README-EN.md) | 英文读者（人类） | | [README-AI.md](README-AI.md) | **AI 代理**：红线、结构、数据格式、SSE 协议、失败模式 | | [AGENT.md](AGENT.md) | 想自己改的人/AI：改设置、加策略、加席位、加测试的逐条配方 | | [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) | 版本变更 | | [UX.md](UX.md) | 界面取舍记录：每处 UI 为什么长这样，含**被否掉**的方案和原因 | | [RESEARCH.md](RESEARCH.md) | 竞品调研与设计笔记（历史，带采集日期） | | `docs/PLAN.md`、`docs/FEEDBACK.md`、`docs/ISSUES.md` | **仅本地留档，不随仓库 / npm 发布**（含开发过程与私域细节） |

# dsh-superagent

> **Research prototype for reference only, not an official DeepSeek product.** This code grew out of our team's day-to-day development work, with much of the engineering done by coding agents. Treat it as research code, not production-ready software. It may still contain bugs, and its coding style and engineering practices may be inconsistent. Review and adapt it before using it in your own environment.
>
> We have adapted it for publication, so it is not identical to our internal version or the implementation described in *Exploring Super-agent Design: Towards a More Autonomous Agent System*. Some designs discussed in the article are directions for future development and are not implemented in this prototype.

dsh-superagent is a proactive coding agent for one GitHub repository, packaged as a bundle for [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/). It listens to GitHub and, optionally, Feishu. When someone allowed asks the agent for work, it opens a work item, works on it in its own agent session and directory, and answers in the original conversation, for example with a pull request. A web panel shows what needs a person.

It is also a way of working with an agent: **take as little human attention as possible, and give as much value as possible.** An agent that can act for a whole team can also waste a whole team's attention, so it acts only when asked or when a rule the team wrote allows it, and speaks only when someone must act or can use a result. [docs/000-philosophy.md](docs/000-philosophy.md) explains the principle and what it asks of the operator.

## Setup

Setup has many steps, so an agent does it with you. Ask your coding agent:

> Read SETUP.md in this repository and set up dsh-superagent with me.

It asks one short question at a time, shows the full plan once, and then installs and configures everything. [SETUP.md](SETUP.md) is what it follows.

Read the numbered documents in order; each builds only on the ones before it.

- [008 Cookbook](docs/008-cookbook.md): adding a Source

## Development

`pnpm check` runs the typecheck, the tests and the build.

# OPL DSH

**官方 DeepSeek Harness 桌面 + OPL 增强，一次安装即可使用。**

在官方 DSH 中使用 OPL Gateway、免费模型和不同的模型 + Harness 组合，并与 Codex 协作。桌面、Agent 循环、工具和权限由官方 DSH 或所选 Harness 提供，OPL 负责接入、会话关联与安装更新。

## 下载安装

支持 macOS Apple Silicon 和 Windows x64，无需预装 Git、Node.js 或其他 OPL 应用。

### 图形安装器

| 系统                  | 下载                                                                                                                       |
| --------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| macOS · Apple Silicon | [Mac 安装器（DMG）](https://github.com/gaofeng21cn/opl-dsh/releases/latest/download/OPL-DSH-Installer-mac-arm64.dmg)       |
| Windows · x64         | [Windows 安装器（EXE）](https://github.com/gaofeng21cn/opl-dsh/releases/latest/download/OPL-DSH-Installer-windows-x64.exe) |

打开安装器后，按提示选择 OPL Gateway、DeepSeek 官方或稍后登录。安装器会联网下载并校验官方桌面，再安装增强插件和 Codex Skill。OPL 安装器未签名，首次可能需要按系统提示允许打开。

安装或升级前请退出 DeepSeek Harness。已有登录、会话、设置和用户修改过的 Skill 会保留。安装完成后，日常直接打开官方 **DeepSeek Harness**；macOS 默认位于 `~/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app`。

### 终端安装

macOS · Apple Silicon：

```sh
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gaofeng21cn/opl-dsh/main/install.sh)"
```

Windows · x64，在 PowerShell 中运行：

```powershell
& ([scriptblock]::Create((Invoke-RestMethod https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gaofeng21cn/opl-dsh/main/install.ps1)))
```

也可使用 Homebrew：

```sh
brew tap gaofeng21cn/opl-dsh https://github.com/gaofeng21cn/opl-dsh.git
brew install --cask gaofeng21cn/opl-dsh/opl-dsh
```

首次使用见[首次启动与登录](docs/first-run.md)。

## 主要能力

- **OPL Gateway**：应用内登录，管理账户、余额和分组权限；可用模型进入统一选择器，左下角显示登录邮箱。
- **Our Free Model**：保留[上游插件](https://github.com/Ebony-Vinyl/dsh-our-free-model)的渠道、登录、模型发现和更新功能。执行设置提示新模型及适配状态，不自动启用未知路线。见[模型插件](docs/model-plugins.md)。
- **模型 + Harness 组合**：同一个输入框和消息流中使用 DSH、Codex CLI、Claude Code、OpenCode 等执行引擎；在“执行与组合”中按 Harness 批量选择，或手动添加已适配搭配。见[适配与支持范围](docs/harness-adaptation.md)。
- **Codex ↔ DSH 协作**：自动安装 `opl-dsh-official` Skill，支持派发、续作、读取结果与交付验收；主动回传需配置通知桥。见[协作说明](docs/collaboration-implementation.md)。
- **SuperAgent 仓库协作**：继承 DeepSeek SuperAgent 原型的 GitHub／可选飞书接单、授权策略、工单、执行和管理面板。macOS 在“协作与自动化”打开独立窗口后配置。见[SuperAgent](docs/superagent.md)。
- **Auto Review 工具审批**：支持专用 codex-auto-review、独立 reviewer，以及 [BambooNode StartLux](docs/bamboo-startlux-auto-review.md) 和 [Jev](docs/jev-auto-review.md) 决策模型；默认关闭。见[工具审批](docs/auto-review.md)。
- **MiniMax 官方账号**：通过 mcode 登录中国站或国际站，支持登录状态、退出、取消授权与超时处理。见[MiniMax 账号与 mcode](docs/minimax-code.md)。
- **对话体验**：不选工作区也可开始新对话；支持[编辑消息并原地重发](docs/stop-edit.md)，轮次与步数可选当前对话或历史累计；[Todo](docs/todo-status.md)展示真实记录状态；可启用[后台任务系统通知](docs/desktop-notifications.md)。
- **Agent 应用交接**：`inspect_mcp_app_host` 按当前对话检查工具和资源能力；无嵌入式 UI 时保留原 owner 的结构化结果与专业应用入口。见 [MCP Apps 支持范围](docs/mcp-apps.md)。
- **网页搜索**：登录 Gateway 后，原生 `web_search` 统一使用 GPT-6.1 Sol 搜索，无需额外配置。

### 常用执行组合

| 来源与模型                             | Harness                  | 使用前提                                                      |
| -------------------------------------- | ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| OPL DeepSeek V4.1 Flash                | DSH                      | 对应 Gateway 分组可用                                         |
| OPL GPT                                | Codex CLI                | 分组与 CLI 已就绪                                             |
| OPL Claude Opus 5.5                    | Claude Code              | AWS、Kiro 渠道独立选择                                        |
| OPL Grok 4.7                           | Grok Build               | 分组与 CLI 已就绪                                             |
| OPL Gemini 4 Argon、3.8 Flash、3.1 Pro | OpenCode                 | 在执行设置中添加组合，使用 Gateway Gemini 渠道                |
| MiniMax M3.1-Flash、M3                 | mcode                    | 官方账号；仅支持明确授权的完全访问                            |
| OFM 免费模型与虚拟路由                 | 按来源选择已适配 Harness | 见 [OFM 组合](docs/harness-adaptation.md#our-free-model-组合) |

“已适配”表示实现了接入，不保证免费渠道随时可用。不同渠道保留独立身份，失败不会自动换模型或换源；外部 Harness 不支持当前权限时拒绝启动，不会自动提升权限。推理档位按模型与 CLI 实际能力提供。

外部 CLI 可分别设置继承环境、直连或 HTTP/HTTPS 代理，入口为 **设置 → 执行与组合 → 执行引擎与网络代理**。Windows Git Bash 能力因 Harness 而异，见[Windows 验证与限制](docs/windows-local-validation.md)及 [Codex Git Bash 候选版](docs/codex-gitbash-candidate.md)。

图片输入按模型来源与 CLI 实际能力开放，保留官方附件引用、输入顺序及编辑时的原图片；不支持图片的组合会在发送前拒绝。详见[模型与 Harness 架构](docs/model-harness-architecture.md)。

## 更新与数据

官方桌面通过 DeepSeek 自身的机制更新。OPL 增强在启动后异步检查正式 Release，运行期间每 6 小时检查一次；新版本在侧边栏提示，可在「通用设置 → 更新」手动检查或关闭自动检查。点击「下次启动时更新」才下载并校验兼容增强，退出应用后通过套件入口启动时安装；需要升级官方桌面时使用完整安装包。也可重新运行最新安装器更新。Homebrew 用户可运行：

```sh
brew upgrade --cask gaofeng21cn/opl-dsh/opl-dsh
```

增强包和缓存保存在 OPL DSH Suite，官方 profile、登录、会话与设置位于 `~/.dsh`；重新安装保留已有数据。Windows 上的 BambooNode 和 TypeSafe 个人 Key 使用 Windows Credential Manager；MiniMax 账号凭据由官方 mcode 管理。

准确版本、平台与资产摘要见[最新 Release](https://github.com/gaofeng21cn/opl-dsh/releases/latest)。运行中的 profile 不替换，更新校验失败时保留已安装版本。发布流程每日检查主线的未发布改动和官方 DSH 双平台版本变化，通过兼容验收后自动发布新的联合版本，详见[发布约定](docs/release-policy.md)与[发布 SOP](docs/release-sop.md)。

## 开发与文档

- [开发、数据位置与验证](docs/development.md)
- [官方桌面兼容验证](docs/compatibility.md)
- [模型与 Harness 架构](docs/model-harness-architecture.md)
- [官方能力复用检查](docs/dsh-reuse-audit.md)
- [外部 Harness 适配](docs/harness-adaptation.md)
- [Computer Use](docs/computer-use.md)
- [发布记录](https://github.com/gaofeng21cn/opl-dsh/releases)

## 关于

本仓库由 One Person Lab 独立维护，与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属关系。官方桌面与 Harness 来自 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)，本仓库维护增强插件、协作 Skill 和安装更新工具。

采用 [MIT 许可](LICENSE)，来源声明见 [NOTICE](NOTICE)。

# dsh-chat-power

DSH 会话区增强插件：与跑哪种 agent 无关的会话区功能都归这里。

> **开发与排障请先查官方文档**：本插件的宿主契约（客户端模块、Slots、会话投影、对话组装等）
> 以 DeepSeek Harness 官方文档为准。本地镜像见
> [`../docs/official/README.md`](../docs/official/README.md)（含按场景的导航表），
> 线上版本见 <https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/>。
> 排查「功能不见了」「界面整块不生效」「事件不触发」前先查对应章节。

## 装上会发生什么

- **会话区标签工作台**：会话区域顶部是常驻的标签条（工具行 + 标签行），聊天本身是
  其中的「会话」标签。新会话默认带「工作区文件」标签并激活；有历史的旧会话默认
  激活「会话」标签。首次发送后自动生成/切换到「会话」标签，其余标签原样保留、
  随时可切。顶部文件夹按钮改为「打开或激活工作区文件标签」。工具标签激活时只
  收起聊天消息列表，输入框（composer）留在下方。
- **文件树行控件**：工作区文件树的每个文件行前面有多选框——勾选即把 `@路径` 写进
  输入框作为文件引用（取消勾选即移除），勾选状态按会话记忆、发送后清空；行尾有
  悬浮才出现的「编辑」按钮，点击读入整篇文本（5 MB / 20000 行上限）并作为编辑标签
  打开，卡片里可发送到当前会话（空新会话也能直接发）或新建会话发送。
- **文件编辑与发送**：本机文本文件打开后直接进入编辑卡片，支持复制全文、发送到当前
  会话、新建会话发送。工作区文件保留宿主预览能力，文本预览头部增加「复制全文」和
  「编辑并发送」。编辑的是待发送副本，不会覆盖磁盘文件。标签与草稿跨标签切换保留。
  本机文件限制 5 MB；工作区复制/编辑限制 5 MB / 20000 行，超过限制明确报错，不复制残缺正文。
- **链接偏好**：工具栏选择内置 / 外部浏览器，普通 HTTP(S) 超链接统一遵循此设置；
  修饰键点击、下载链接、应用自身导航保持标准行为。浏览器地址栏右端保留宿主的外部打开按钮。
- **短会话 ID + 复制**：仍位于会话标题栏右侧工具行。
- **答案卡片**：一轮的最终回答外面套一层卡片，带编辑 / 复制 / 另存为新会话任务。
  编辑态仿输入框的组合条：取消按钮占住卡片头部的编辑位置（编辑时就是它替换了
  编辑图标），新建会话是描边文字按钮、与发送钮之间留大间距避免误点，发送是一枚
  圆形图标按钮——常态铺品牌色，hover 才转浅，和输入框的发送钮一致。
- **会话尾部文件卡片**：从一轮的输出里认出文件路径，就地展开阅读、编辑、
  发送回会话、用桌面应用打开；超过四个折叠。
- **选区工具栏**：在会话区域选中一段文字，宿主文本交互表面弹出一条工具栏——
  「引用」「发送会话」「编辑」「多选」。**「引用」与官方引用钮
  同位同效**：走宿主 `inputActions.insertQuote`，把选中文字变成输入框里的
  可移除引用卡，发送时序列化成 Markdown 引用块。本包往宿主座位
   `conversation.chat.text-interaction` 注册 `key=quote` 的组件顶替官方引用钮，
  但复用官方交互规则（何时弹、弹在哪、会话是否可写）。「发送会话」直接作为
  新请求发出；「编辑」把选中内容展开成会话区的编辑卡（至少 10 行高，可编辑后
  发送或发去新会话）；「多选」把选中内容加入收藏并保持高亮，同时**会话区域
  顶部浮出独立的浮动条**（宽度为会话区域一半、圆角、条间距 2px）：每条一段预览
  与独立移除按钮，可逐条撤掉；小「编辑 (n)」钮压在最后一条的右下方。收藏与
  浮动条绑定收集时的会话——切换到别的会话时自动隐藏，切回来继续可见。
  **会话历史里的引用卡无需本包做任何事**：官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-message-quotes`
  插件（`dsh-web-app` 自带、必然加载）已无条件注册 `quoteRule`（识别 `> 引用块`）
  与 `QuotedUserText`（用 `QuotePreview` 渲染）。本包「引用」钮产出的
  `> text` 与官方引用钮逐字一致，故历史里自动显示成引用卡。本包不注册同名
  `userText` 规则，不会与官方那条撞名（重复 id 会抛「Duplicate text interaction」）。
  「编辑」与清单底部按钮都把内容送进**占满会话区域的编辑卡**（至少 10 行
  高，可编辑后发送或发去新会话）：单选编辑只含选中文字；多选编辑按原顺序、
  项间空行拼接，发送后连收藏与高亮一起清掉。输入框、编辑框、文件阅读区正文（已有自己的工具条）不弹；Escape
  或点击别处收起。
- **Mermaid 图渲染**：把 Markdown 里的 ` ```mermaid ` 代码块画成 SVG，可切「图表 /
  源码」。运行时 3.5 MB 不内联进客户端包，第一次遇到图时才从宿主路由
  `/chat-power/mermaid.js` 懒加载。
- **轮次折叠与当前轮限高**：会话区按轮次工作。新一轮开始时，此前的轮次自动折叠成
  一行摘要条（轮次号 · 时刻 · 首句摘要），只有当前轮留在主屏；滚上去点摘要条即可展开，
  展开态右侧有「收起」。当前展开的一轮若超过一屏，超出的部分在轮内滚动（输入框与轮首
  始终留在视野里），流式输出时内容保持贴底。
  折叠与限高只动 DOM（给宿主行加标记、插自己的摘要条），不移动宿主节点、不改宿主结构。

### 思考块的折叠由宿主设置控制（本包不接管）

「思考过程要展示、思考结束后自动折叠」是宿主自带的行为，设置路径：
**设置 → 通用 → 工作步骤** →
- **工作步骤收起时机** 选「回答结束后」；
- **收起后显示的回复** 选「仅最终回答」（这样思考内容随工作步骤一起收起）。

两项都在「工作步骤展示」为简洁 / 标准 / 详细时生效；选「完全展开」则永不折叠。

| 功能 | 注册位置 |
| --- | --- |
| 会话区标签工作台 | `shell.overlay` 管理生命周期，React portal 插入会话正文的正常布局（条带在会话内容之前） |
| 文件树行控件 | 私有座位 `chat-power.tools.sidebar.right.pane.tab` 上重注册 FilesBody（优先级 -10），DOM 覆盖层补挂控件 |
| 短会话 ID + 复制 | `conversation.session.header.utilities`（会话作用域 list） |
| 答案卡片 | 包住 `conversation.chat.node` 的 `assistant-step`（优先级 -50） |
| 会话尾部文件卡片 | `conversation.chat.turnTail` |
| Mermaid | DOM 级（扫已渲染的 Markdown）+ 宿主路由 `/chat-power/mermaid.js` |
| 轮次折叠与当前轮限高 | DOM 级（按宿主的 `data-chat-turn` 分组行，加折叠标记、插自己的摘要条） |

## 与 dsh-acp-agent 的关系（两个包都装时）

ACP 的**进程段**（工具调用/思考的过程卡片）是 agent 专属的，仍留在
`@goodjin2/dsh-acp-agent`。两个包通过一个跨包座位接起来：

1. 本包在重注册 `assistant-step` 包装时**声明**座位
   `conversation.chat.node.acp-segment-renderer`（`children` 表，list 类型）。
2. acp-agent 发现座位存在后，把它的 `AcpProcessBlock` 注册进来。
3. 本包的包装在渲染时按座位取名：带 `acpProcessSegment` 的节点交给它，其余步骤
   走答案卡片。

`assistant-step` 的规则是「优先级最低的那条渲染」。本包用 **-50**、acp-agent 的
兜底用 **-40**，所以本包恒在外层；只装 acp-agent 时它那层生效，ACP 段照样完整。
改优先级必须两个包一起改——`tests/wrap-priority.spec.ts` 钉住了这个先后关系。

## 安装与挂载

```sh
npm install @goodjin2/dsh-chat-power
```

在 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里加上 `@goodjin2/dsh-chat-power` 即可。本包自带
`cordis.patch.yml`（`dsh.bundle.patch`），里面包含：

- `chat-power-client`：以**裸包名**挂载本包，浏览器半边靠它被扫进
  `window.__DSH_BOOT__`。这一行不是可有可无的：DSH 不按 `package.json` 的
  `dsh.client` 自动装载浏览器包，只看 Loader 的行名是否恰好等于包名
  （`ClientModuleRegistry.resolveMeta` 经 `locatePkgJson` 解析；带子路径的名字
  一律不算客户端行）。少了它，插件装上也什么都不发生，宿主日志里一个字都没有。
- `chat-power-mermaid-asset`：宿主侧 `/chat-power/mermaid.js` 这条 exact 路由，
  供浏览器半边懒加载 mermaid 运行时。

## 迁移说明（0.3.0）

mermaid 渲染、答案卡片、会话尾部文件卡片在 0.3.0 从 `@goodjin2/dsh-acp-agent`
迁到本包（agent 无关的通用会话区功能归本包，ACP 专属留在那边）。对应的旧行
`@goodjin2/dsh-acp-agent/mermaid-asset` 在 acp-agent 0.3.0 已删除；从旧版本升上来
时，把 profile 里这条旧行换成 `@goodjin2/dsh-chat-power/mermaid-asset`（或直接删掉，
由本包的 bundle patch 提供）。

## 开发

```sh
npm run typecheck   # tsc --noEmit
npm test            # vitest（含产物的装载冒烟测试）
npm run build       # tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsdown → lib/client.js
```

`tests/bundle.spec.ts` 会把 `lib/client.js` 按页面的方式执行一遍（模拟
`window.__ModuleLoader__`、用页面给的 `require` 取 react / primitives、调 `apply`）：
产物格式或 id 写错时，这里会先红，而不是等页面在装配审计里判失败。

构建是**可复现**的：同一份源码连建两次产物字节相同（CSS module 哈希按基名算），
所以 `lib/client.js` 入库后，重建不会平白弄脏工作区，也不会触发无意义的页面热替换。

## Requirements

- DSH >= 0.2.0-rc.2
- 会话工具需要宿主自带的文件、浏览器、终端、文档预览客户端模块（已声明 `dsh.client.external`）。
- 以 DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 验证；这些模块的工厂和座位接口变化时需运行浏览器验收。

## License

MIT

## 会话工具实现与迁移

`conversation-tools.tsx` 负责入口、标签条和正文视图；`tools-state.ts` 管理每会话独立的
标签（含「会话」标签）与 AbortSignal；`tools-adapter.tsx` 在私有服务和 `chat-power.tools.*`
座位中装配宿主功能工厂。文件树行控件（多选框 + 悬浮编辑）由 `file-tree-augment.tsx`
在私有座位上重注册宿主 FilesBody 后以 DOM 覆盖层补挂；勾选引用的落地在
`composer-references.ts`（优先宿主输入外壳，退回 execCommand）；发送侦测在
`send-watch.ts`（聊天流新增用户消息 → 切到会话标签）。浏览器持久化使用独立作用域，
终端关闭调用资源清理，不与原右侧栏共享导航状态。
为支持 Web profile，bundle patch 启用宿主浏览器模块（Web 使用 iframe，网页可能拒绝嵌入，
这时可以使用外部打开按钮）。

`dsh-rightbar-overlay` 已退役，应从 profile 的 dependencies / bundles 和 node_modules
链接中移除。不得与本方案一起用来改写会话布局。浏览器中的旧 localStorage 开关键不再读取。

验收：新会话默认工作区文件标签、旧会话默认会话标签、首次发送自动切到会话标签、
标签间来回切换保留状态、文件行勾选引用进输入框且取消勾选移除、文件行悬浮编辑打开
编辑标签、文本文件编辑保留、工作区预览/复制/编辑、浏览器内外打开、终端启动/关闭；
检查宿主右侧栏未受影响。构建产物随源码提交，桌面 App 重启后加载。


## Version anchor tags

This repo participates in the container's DSH version-correspondence mechanism: every
plugin repo carries tags named `dsh-<dsh版本>` (e.g. `dsh-0.2.2-rc.1`), each an annotated
tag recording the dsh version it was verified against, the check result, and the date.
The tag is the immutable "known-good coordinate" of that dsh version — a snapshot of
`main` taken the moment the whole-plugin row check went green on every installed host.

- **Why tags instead of releases**: the desktop app reads this checkout by path and the
  web install pulls `repo#ref` — a git tag is already the furthest installable form, so
  no npm publish or GitHub Release is needed.
- **Rollback**: `scripts/pin-to-dsh.sh 0.2.2-rc.1` (from the container) checks out the
  tag in every repo at once; `scripts/check-host-rows.mjs --report` shows which repos are
  on the anchor for the running dsh version.
- **Do not move or delete a `dsh-*` tag**; it is a rollback coordinate. A follow-up fix on
  the same dsh version adds a `-p2` (then `-p3`) suffixed tag instead.
- New tags are cut after each dsh upgrade, as step 4 of the upgrade runbook — see the
  container's `AGENTS.md` for the full flow.

# dsh-plugin-gpt-image

为 DeepSeek Harness 增加 **GPT 生图与改图**：两个工具 + 一个设置页。

- `image_generate`：文生图，走任意 OpenAI 兼容的 `POST /v1/images/generations`
- `image_edit`：图生图，走 multipart `POST /v1/images/edits`
- 设置页：填自己的 API 地址与密钥、测试连接、拉取模型列表、选画质/背景、看最近生成的图

默认中转 `https://ai.stjapi.com`，默认模型 `gpt-image-2.6-flare`。生成的图片写进工作区
`gpt-images/`，当前模型支持图片输入时会一并附到对话里。

- 包名：`dsh-plugin-gpt-image`　版本：`1.3.8`
- 适配：DSH `>=0.2.1-0 <0.3.0`（`engines.dsh`，不满足时安装会被明确拒绝）
- 运行时零第三方依赖，只需要 Node 内置能力

## 安装

三选一，对应「插件 → 添加插件」的输入框：

| 方式 | 填什么 |
|---|---|
| npm（已发布） | `dsh-plugin-gpt-image` |
| GitHub | `git+https://github.com/hanlinwangluo/dsh-plugin-gpt-image.git` |
| Gitee | `git+https://gitee.com/yuhanlin2026/dsh-plugin-gpt-image.git` |
| 本地目录 | 解压后该目录的绝对路径，例如 `D:\plugins\dsh-plugin-gpt-image` |

仓库：[GitHub](https://github.com/hanlinwangluo/dsh-plugin-gpt-image) ·
[Gitee](https://gitee.com/yuhanlin2026/dsh-plugin-gpt-image)

装好即生效；打开 **设置 → GPT 生图** 填自己的密钥即可。安装需要会话具备
`danger-full-access` 或一次明确批准（插件代码在 Host 进程、工作区沙箱之外执行）。

> 升级提示：若同一包名在本机跑过不带 `dsh.client` 的旧版本，Host 会缓存该包名元数据直到
> 重启，设置页不会出现；换包名安装或重启 DSH 一次即可。

## 配置

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| API 地址 | `https://ai.stjapi.com` | 任意 OpenAI 兼容网关 |
| API 密钥 | 空 | 只写进本机 `<profile>/gpt-image.options.json`，界面只回显后四位 |
| 模型 | `gpt-image-2.6-flare` | 可点「获取模型列表」从 `/v1/models` 拉取后选择 |
| 默认尺寸 | `1024x1024` | `1536x1024` / `1024x1536` / `auto` |
| 画质 | `auto` | `low` / `medium` / `high`，非 auto 时才发给接口 |
| 背景 | `auto` | `transparent` / `opaque`，非 auto 时才发给接口 |
| 输出目录 | `gpt-images` | 相对工作区 |

设置页另外提供：

- **测试连接**：用保存的密钥请求 `/v1/models`，返回成功或失败原因与耗时，不消耗生图额度
- **获取模型列表**：填充模型输入框的候选
- **侧边栏「最近生成」**：左侧边栏新增一个图库入口（`sidebar.panellist` + `main`），点开是当前工作区
  `gpt-images/` 的缩略图网格，点图看原图，面板内可刷新

配置优先级：设置页/工具保存的值 → `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `config` → 环境变量
`GPT_IMAGE_API_KEY` → 内置默认值。同一个操作也能让 Agent 用 `image_configure` 改。

## 使用

- 「画一张深夜拉面店的招牌，霓虹灯，电影感」
- 「做一个 1536x1024 的极简产品横幅，主体是黑色耳机」
- 「把这张图里的纸鹤改成深蓝色」——附上图片路径，走 `image_edit`

工具参数：`prompt`（必填）、`image`（仅 `image_edit`）、`size`、`model`、`quality`、
`background`、`n`（1–4）。

## 稳定性

- 插件会向系统提示注册一条规则：只要任务是生成或修改图片，就调用 `image_generate` / `image_edit`，不要用代码逐像素绘制（PIL、numpy、ffmpeg、canvas、手写 SVG）；只有用户明确要求程序化批处理或像素级精确操作时才允许写代码
- 429 与 5xx 自动重试两次，遵守 `Retry-After`，退避 1s/2s
- 单次调用受 `timeoutMs`（默认 240s）约束，取消会立即中断
- 输出目录不存在时自动创建

## 已知限制

- 不导出 `Config` schema（路径软链接安装取不到 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`），
  所以插件详情页没有自动生成的配置表单；配置在设置页与 patch 里。
- 设置页通过本机回环路由 `/gpt-image-api/*` 读写；响应不含明文密钥，写操作要求
  JSON 请求体，跨站表单无法直接利用。
- 只有当前模型路由声明支持图片输入时，图片才会作为图像块进入对话。
- 不做局部重绘遮罩（mask）与多图参考，只支持单张源图编辑。

## 传输方式

默认向接口要 **`b64_json`**（内联图片数据），整个传输只经过 API 主机一跳，适合中转与
CDN 分离、或 CDN 在部分网络下会卡住的情况。

如果想让响应体积更小（约 500 字节，再单独下载图片），把 bundle 的 `config` 或
`gpt-image.options.json` 里 `responseFormat` 设为 `"url"`：此时插件会再用独立超时
（120 秒，重试 2 次）去 CDN 取图。

## 文件清单

```
gpt-image/
├── package.json        # 包声明：dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client
├── cordis.patch.yml    # 插入插件行并给出默认配置（key 留空）
├── index.js            # Host：两个图像工具、配置工具、5 条设置路由
├── lib/client.js       # Client：设置页（settings.section）
├── icon.svg            # 插件图标（自绘）
├── locale/{en,zh}.json # 插件列表标题与描述
├── README.md
├── RELEASING.md        # 发布到 npm / Gitee / GitHub 与市场索引
└── LICENSE             # MIT
```

## 许可

MIT
