# DSH 皮肤市场 English 一个嵌入 DSH 设置页的社区皮肤市场：浏览、搜索、安装、使用、停用、常驻、更新和卸载 DSH 皮肤。

## 在线预览 [打开在线皮肤市场](https://kingofsoysauce.github.io/dsh-skin-market/) ### 近期收录 - **2026-11-09**：[柠檬水工厂 · 昼夜双模](https://github.com/Ririko2/lllj-dsh-skin)（Ririko2）——《ライムライト・レモネードジャム》主题：纸白/深蓝昼夜双模，六位角色按会话分配，官方 SD 头像与贴纸、游戏原文台词完成卡，四套随机分割线。详见[收录日志](./docs/recently-added.md#recent-2026-11-09-ririko2-lllj-dsh-skin)。 ## 安装、更新 > 更新失败时，可先卸载 `dsh-skin-market`，再按上面的安装方法重装；如果卸载或重装仍失败，再查看错误提示并复制诊断日志。 ### 方法 1：命令 终端执行： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add "dsh-skin-market@latest" ``` ### 方法 2：应用内 左上角「插件 → 添加插件」，输入： ```text dsh-skin-market@latest ``` ### 方法 3：插件内更新 皮肤市场内点击「更新」按钮 ### 方法 4： Agent 帮忙 复制下面的提示词给你的 DSH Agent。它会先判断当前是 Web 还是官方 Desktop。Web 由 Agent 执行命令；官方 Desktop 如果当前 DSH 提供插件管理工具（plugin_manager），Agent 可以在你确认精确目标和 profile 后直接安装/启用；工具不可用或需要应用内确认时，Agent 指导你在「插件 → 添加插件」操作。重启仍由你完成。
点击展开提示词 **安装提示词** ```text 请帮我安装 dsh-skin-market。先只读确认当前是 Web 版还是官方 Desktop，以及当前宿主和实际 profile。Web 查看 dsh --version；官方 Desktop 以应用“关于”中的版本为准，不把系统终端的 npm dsh 版本当作桌面版本。无法读取应用信息时，请让我提供该版本；无法判断宿主就先问我。 - Web 版：执行 dsh plugin --profile web add "dsh-skin-market@latest"，然后核对同一 web profile 中的依赖和 bundle。 - 官方 Desktop：先只读确认当前 profile 和已安装版本。如果当前宿主提供插件管理工具（plugin_manager）且你能确认当前 profile，先告诉我准备安装/更新的精确目标和会修改的 profile，我确认后由你安装并启用；安装后核对实际版本、启用状态和是否需要重启。工具不可用、宿主拒绝或需要我在应用内确认时，再指导我打开「插件 → 添加插件」，输入 dsh-skin-market@latest，由我点击安装并按应用提示启用。不要执行 dsh plugin --profile desktop，不要用 npm/pnpm 直接写 Desktop profile，也不要手改 profile。重启由我完成。每次只给一个操作，等我反馈再继续。 这次只安装皮肤市场，不做其他皮肤的冲突检查，也不要求停用它们。不要替我安装其他皮肤。安装后告诉我从哪里打开「皮肤市场」；Desktop 以插件页状态和我的实际操作反馈核对结果，没有核实就不要声称安装或启用成功。不要读取 .env、凭据或聊天记录。 ``` **更新提示词** ```text 请更新已安装的 dsh-skin-market。先判断当前宿主和实际 profile：Web 查看 dsh --version；官方 Desktop 查看应用“关于”中的版本，不用系统终端的 npm dsh 版本替代。无法判断就先问我。 - Web 版：只读确认 web profile 已安装 dsh-skin-market，再执行 dsh plugin --profile web add "dsh-skin-market@latest"。 - 官方 Desktop：先只读核对版本和插件状态。如果当前宿主提供插件管理工具（plugin_manager）且你能确认 profile，先告诉我准备更新的精确目标和会修改的 profile，我确认后由你更新并启用；更新后核对实际版本、启用状态和是否需要重启。工具不可用、宿主拒绝或需要我在应用内确认时，再指导我在「插件 → 添加插件」中输入 dsh-skin-market@latest、确认更新结果并按提示启用。不要执行 dsh plugin --profile desktop，不要用 npm/pnpm 直接写 Desktop profile，也不要手改 profile。重启由我完成。 Web 更新后验证同一宿主的 dsh-skin-market 依赖和 bundle；Desktop 根据插件页状态和我的实际反馈核对结果，没有核实就不要声称成功。告诉我更新前后版本及需要重启哪个宿主。不要替我更新或卸载其他皮肤。 ```
## 使用皮肤 打开「设置 → 皮肤市场」或 「插件 → dsh-skin-market」 ### 从市场安装具体皮肤 可直接安装的 npm 皮肤会使用「安装」或「安装并使用」流程。官方 Desktop 默认先安装，再进入使用确认；取消使用确认时，皮肤包会保留，但不会启用。 标为「需手动安装」的皮肤，需要把市场提供的完整固定目标交给 Agent。有已发布 npm 包时用 `name@version`（预构建）；没有 npm 包时才用 GitHub 完整 commit 和 `&path:/子目录`。不要用未构建的 GitHub 源码代替 npm 包，也不要把 commit 或子目录改成 `latest`、仓库主分支或另一个包名。
点击展开手动皮肤安装流程 Agent 先只读确认当前 Desktop 版本和其他已启用的皮肤；发现冲突时列出名称，指导你在应用中停用，并核对停用结果后再继续。拿不到启用状态时，应请你提供插件列表或界面状态，不能把“无法确认”当成“没有冲突”。 安装目标使用面板给出的完整固定 spec。有 npm 包的皮肤优先 `name@version`；没有 npm 包时用 GitHub 完整 commit，monorepo 子包还要保留 `&path:/子目录`，例如 `github:owner/repo#<完整 commit>&path:/packages/skin`。不要把该目标换成 `latest` 或仓库主分支。 如果当前宿主提供插件管理工具（plugin_manager），Agent 把最终精确目标和会修改的 profile 发给你确认后，可直接安装（默认不启用）；需要启用时先查冲突并再次确认。工具不可用、宿主拒绝或需要你在应用内处理构建授权时，Agent 指导你打开「插件 → 添加插件」、粘贴完整目标、确认安装结果、按提示启用，最后按当前版本要求完全退出并重新打开应用。Agent 不执行 `dsh plugin --profile desktop`，不手改 profile；构建授权只按宿主返回的精确项逐项确认；重启由你完成。界面不支持该目标或安装失败时，先核对原始报错和维护者说明，再决定下一步；依赖伴生包的皮肤须核对完整安装要求。 这些说明不改变市场的 npm 一键安装流程，也不代表所有 GitHub 或子目录皮肤都已完成官方 Desktop 实机验收。
## 常见问题与故障处理 先按市场弹窗或横幅中的具体原因处理。不要因为“已安装”就重复安装，也不要因为某次启用失败就直接卸载整个 profile。 | 情况 | 先做什么 | | --- | --- | | 网络或下载超时 | 重试一次；持续失败时复制市场诊断日志，检查 DSH 实际使用的网络和安装源 | | 已安装但没有生效 | 进入皮肤详情点击「使用」，检查是否显示「待重启」或「未生效」及其原因 | | 启用/停用被其他配置覆盖 | 按弹窗指出的组件处理；不要反复重装。市场能安全定位覆盖时，会给出明确的修复入口 | | 安装被新包保护阻止 | 只允许报错中明确指出的那个精确版本，或等待保护期结束；不要关闭全局保护 | | 操作结果正在确认 | 等待市场核对宿主结果，不要再次点击安装、启用或卸载 | | 安装/更新/卸载被另一个已安装插件的失效仓库挡住 | 按失败弹窗里默认折叠的三步处理：手动去掉该依赖、退出 DSH 后执行修复命令，或把提示词交给当前 DSH 以外的 Agent。不要在市场里卸载那个失效插件 | | 页面因皮肤冲突无法操作 | 停止对应的 DSH Web 进程后，使用下面的 Web 重置命令 | ### 安装被新包保护阻止 市场会尽量合并当前 profile 中重复的精确版本例外。仍被阻止时，只有在确认包名和版本来自本次报错后，才允许这一版本继续；也可以等待 pnpm 的保护期结束。市场不会为整个包或所有未来版本关闭保护。
需要 Agent 帮忙处理新包保护错误？ ```text 请处理这次 DSH Desktop 的新包保护错误。先确认 Desktop 实际使用的 profile 名称和目录，并从本次 ERR_PNPM_MINIMUM_RELEASE_AGE_VIOLATION 诊断中确认被阻止的精确包名和版本；不要把正在安装的皮肤直接当成被阻止的包。 仅处理这个 profile 的 pnpm-workspace.yaml 中 minimumReleaseAgeExclude 字段。先合并同名规则中已经允许的版本，保留其他规则、注释和全局年龄策略。如果报错中的精确版本确实没有例外，先向我展示包名、版本和来源，由我确认后才添加这个精确版本。不要设置 minimumReleaseAge=0，不要允许整个包的未来版本，不要读取 .env、凭据或其他存放秘密的配置。混合配置可能含秘密时，先取得指定字段的限定读取授权。 如果你正运行在这个 DSH 中，不要修改自己的活动组合配置、重启或安装当前宿主；先准备可重复执行的 apply 与 rollback 方案，交给外部终端或独立 Agent 执行。Desktop 包操作由我在官方页面重试。最后核对实际安装版本和组件状态，报告具体结果。 ```
### 安装被已安装插件的失效来源阻塞 报错形如 `ERR_PNPM_FETCH_404`，URL 指向 `codeload.github.com/...`，而该仓库属于你**之前安装过**的插件，并不是这次要装的皮肤。pnpm 每次安装都会重新解析 profile 里全部 Git 依赖；只要其中一个上游仓库或 commit 被删除，安装、更新、卸载和更新皮肤市场本身都会失败。 失败弹窗里有同样的三步，默认折叠。市场不能在运行中的 DSH 里替你修改依赖，需要先**完全退出 DSH**（不是只关页面），再从外部终端执行下面的命令。修复命令随市场包发布，通过 `npx` 取用最新版，不需要先更新当前 profile 里的市场，也不会对运行中的 DSH 执行 `pnpm add`。 ```bash # 只读诊断：列出失效来源、锁文件漂移和计划移除的包 npx -y -p dsh-skin-market@latest dsh-skin-market-repair --profile web # 完全退出 DSH 后执行修复；用 --keep <包名> 可保留某个失效插件 npx -y -p dsh-skin-market@latest dsh-skin-market-repair --profile web --apply --yes --i-have-stopped-dsh # 需要时回滚 npx -y -p dsh-skin-market@latest dsh-skin-market-repair --profile web --rollback ~/.dsh/profiles/web/.dsh-skin-market/backups/repair-<时间戳> --yes --i-have-stopped-dsh ``` 修复会先把 `package.json` 和 `pnpm-lock.yaml` 备份到 profile 内，只移除诊断确认 404 的依赖，然后用该 profile 同一代际的 pnpm 执行一次 `install --no-frozen-lockfile`；完成后校验剩余依赖、锁文件一致性和皮肤市场版本。过程中可能需要网络（pnpm 会重新拉取其余 Git 依赖），不要关闭完整性校验，也不要删除整个锁文件。如果目录维护者已经把同名皮肤改到新仓库或 npm 源，并给出完整固定目标，可以用 `--migrate 包名=完整目标` 保留皮肤而不是删除（例如 `--migrate dsh-dream-skin=dsh-dream-skin@11.7.0`）。迁移目标必须由维护者确认；没有确认目标的失效依赖仍按默认方式移除。修复后启动 DSH，核对页面版本和保存的启用/停用选择，再重试原安装。诊断和修复都需要 `pnpm` 可用；如果 PATH 中没有 pnpm，用 `--pnpm <可执行文件>` 指向该 profile 使用的同一版本。
需要 Agent 帮忙修复 profile 依赖？ ```text 这次 DSH 皮肤安装/更新失败在 pnpm 依赖解析阶段：报错指向 codeload.github.com 上某个我已安装插件的上游仓库 404，而不是我要装的皮肤。请先只读诊断，不要重试安装或卸载。 1. 确认当前 DSH 的 home、profile 和 profile 目录，不要假设默认路径；确认这个 DSH 正在使用该 profile。 2. 只读核对 profile 的 package.json、pnpm-lock.yaml 和 node_modules，找出：哪些已安装依赖的上游仓库/commit 已不可达、package.json 与锁文件有哪些不一致、哪些包实际已物化。不要读取 .env、凭据或可能含秘密的配置。 3. 先给我看诊断结果、计划移除的精确包名、备份目录和修复命令；我确认后，由我在外部终端或由独立 Agent 在完全退出 DSH 后执行修复。你如果正运行在这个 DSH 中，不要修改自己的活动 profile、安装或卸载当前 DSH、停止或重启自己。 4. 修复前保留备份；只移除确认不可达的依赖，不关闭完整性校验、不放宽 allowBuild、不删除整个锁文件、不改其他皮肤。 5. 修复后核对实际安装版本、锁定文件一致性与启用/停用选择；未读到运行状态时请我提供官方页面结果，并注明尚未验证。最后核对失败原因是否已消除，再按原操作重试。 ```
### Web 页面异常时重置皮肤 如果皮肤冲突导致 DSH Web 页面无法操作，先停止当前 DSH Web 进程，再执行： ```bash ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/.bin/dsh-skin-market-reset --profile web ``` 这个命令会关闭皮肤市场管理的皮肤并恢复默认外观，但保留已安装的皮肤包和皮肤市场。随后重新启动 DSH Web。官方 Desktop 不要执行这个 Web profile 命令，请在应用插件管理器或市场中停用冲突皮肤。 ## 给开发者 维护 DSH 皮肤时，把下面的提示词交给 Agent，准备收录或更新展示字段。市场不会代替你登录 GitHub，也不会静默创建 PR。 新收录只写薄条目：`url`、`subpath`、`name`、`author`、`description`、`screenshots`。`name` 如果写，必须同时有 `zh` 和 `en`。package、loader id、commit、许可证和兼容范围由 CI 从皮肤仓库读取，不要写进 YAML。社区 PR 只改一个 `registry/skins/__.yml`，不要改 `data/catalog.json` 或 `data/catalog-copy.json`。 皮肤仓库需要能被 CI 读到：公开 GitHub 仓库或 monorepo 子目录；`package.json` 有 name、version、license 和 `dsh.client`；`cordis.patch.yml` 有对应 loader。预览图用仓库内的 png、jpg、webp 或 gif。建议 README 声明 DSH Web 版本范围和一条 `dsh plugin add` 安装命令，并为仓库加上 `dsh-plugin` Topic。 已收录皮肤只能改展示字段：`name.zh`、`name.en`、`author`、`description`、`screenshots`。不要改 id、安装目标、commit、package 或 rowId。固定版本刷新不由这次 PR 改写。收录不等于安全认证。 本地验收步骤见 [TESTING.md](./TESTING.md)。
点击展开收录皮肤提示词 复制以下整段提示词给你的 Agent： ```text 请把我的 DSH 皮肤提交到 DSH 皮肤市场。 皮肤仓库：<你的皮肤仓库地址> 目标目录仓库：https://github.com/kingOfSoySauce/dsh-skin-market 目录路径：registry/skins 请按以下步骤完成： 1. 只用只读方式确认皮肤仓库是公开的 GitHub 仓库（或 monorepo 子目录），且确实是可安装的 DSH Web 皮肤。不要读取 .env、凭据或聊天记录。 2. 确认 CI 能从该仓库读到这些材料；缺了就先告诉我，不要编造： - package.json 有 name、version、license，以及 dsh.client - cordis.patch.yml 有与 package 名对应的 loader 行 - 描述在薄条目 description 或 package.json description - 预览图是仓库内的 png、jpg、webp 或 gif，来自 screenshots.json 相对路径、README 仓库图片，或薄条目 screenshots - 建议 README 声明 DSH Web 版本范围，并包含一条 dsh plugin add 安装命令；建议仓库加上 dsh-plugin Topic 3. fork 或 clone 目标目录仓库并新建分支。在 registry/skins 下只新增一个 YAML，文件名用 owner__repo.yml（子包用 owner__repo--path.yml）。不要覆盖已有条目，不要修改 data/catalog.json 或 data/catalog-copy.json。 4. YAML 必须写成薄条目。只允许这些字段，一个都不能多：url、subpath、name、author、description、screenshots。多写 package、rowId、category、tags、modes、compatibility、install、commit 或任何其他键，CI 会按完整 schema 校验并失败。内容只能是： url: https://github.com// # subpath: packages/my-skin # 仅 monorepo 子包需要 # name: # 可选；如果写，必须同时有 zh 和 en # zh: 中文名 # en: English name # author: owner # 可选；未填写时使用 GitHub owner # description: 一句用户能看到的外观或行为说明 # screenshots: # 可选；只写仓库内图片相对路径 # - screenshots/home.png 5. 不要写完整 schema，不要编造 commit SHA、rowId 或许可证。若 npm run registry:check 报缺少 id/install，先删掉薄条目以外的字段再跑，不要靠补全 schema 过 CI。 6. 在目标目录仓库根目录运行 npm run registry:check。不得安装到我的真实 DSH profile。 7. git diff --name-only 应只有 registry/skins/<条目文件>.yml。提交并创建 PR，标题 feat(registry): add <皮肤名>。 8. 返回 PR 链接；没有 GitHub 权限时只准备好分支和可复制的 PR 内容。 收录不等于安全认证。不要声称该皮肤已被 DSH 官方、安全团队或市场背书。 ```
点击展开更新展示字段提示词 只改名称、作者、描述或预览图时，复制这段。把要改的字段和内容填进提示词。 ```text 请帮我更新 DSH 皮肤市场里已收录皮肤的展示字段。 皮肤仓库：<你的皮肤仓库地址> 目标目录仓库：https://github.com/kingOfSoySauce/dsh-skin-market 目录路径：registry/skins 要改的字段： 请按以下步骤完成： 1. 只用只读方式确认这个仓库已经在 registry/skins 里有条目，并且仓库 remote 与条目的 repo 一致。找不到就停下来问我，不要新建条目。不要读取 .env、凭据或聊天记录。 2. 只修改这一条已有 YAML。社区 PR 只能改一个 registry/skins/<条目>.yml，不要改其他条目、data/catalog.json 或 data/catalog-copy.json。 3. 只允许改这些展示字段：name.zh、name.en、author、description、screenshots。name 必须同时保留 zh 和 en。description 写用户能看到的外观或行为。screenshots 只能使用当前已固定 commit 下的仓库内 png、jpg、webp 或 gif，不要换成更新的 commit、SVG、data URI 或第三方图床。 4. 不要改 id、repo、subpath、package、rowId、category、tags、modes、install、compatibility、review、health、license、featuredRank、star 计数或任何时间字段。固定版本刷新不由这次 PR 改写；如果需要更新固定版本，只在 PR 正文说明，不要编造 install.target。 5. 在目标目录仓库根目录运行 npm run registry:check。不得安装到我的真实 DSH profile。 6. git diff --name-only 应只有这一条 YAML。提交并创建 PR，标题 feat(registry): update <皮肤名> display fields。 7. 返回 PR 链接；没有 GitHub 权限时只准备好分支和可复制的 PR 内容。 不要声称字段已经在线上目录生效。合并后由仓库的目录同步写入 catalog。收录不等于安全认证。 ```

# dsh-cad — CAD Plugin for DeepSeek Harness

![dsh-cad banner](docs/img/banner.svg)

[![homepage](https://img.shields.io/badge/homepage-dsh--cad-4D6BFE)](https://lau-mars.github.io/dsh-cad/)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-cad)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-cad)
[![downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-cad)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-cad)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@deepseek-ai%2Fdsh?label=dsh)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D%2022-4D6BFE)](https://nodejs.org/)
[![occt](https://img.shields.io/badge/occt-7.9.3-4D6BFE)](https://github.com/LAU-MARS/opencascade-ts)
[![occt.ts](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/occt.ts?label=occt.ts)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/occt.ts)
[![ansatz](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/ansatz-wasm?label=ansatz)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/ansatz-wasm)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-4D6BFE)](./LICENSE)

English | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

A CAD plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness):
an **embedded 3D/2D CAD viewer** plus a **native parametric modeling tool family**
(OCCT kernel) in the Web UI, letting the agent build and inspect CAD geometry
step by step — "model while you watch".

## Preview

A full modeling session, end to end: the agent builds a parametric assembly
from plain chat — a 120×80×8 base plate with R5 rounded corners, then four
bolt instances placed at the corners — while the resident CAD panel tracks
every step live (parts tree with per-instance colors, ViewCube, "装配体"
assembly tab, 5 instances · 1,740 triangles). The finished assembly exports
as a structured STEP document and the agent verifies it by reading the file
back — 2 solids, 3 products, 2 assembly usages, 1,125.00 mm³:

![dsh-cad assembly session](docs/img/assembly-preview.png)

## Downloads

Cumulative downloads from the npm registry, refreshed daily by CI:

![npm cumulative downloads](docs/img/downloads-cumulative.svg)

## Feature Overview

| Capability | Description |
| --- | --- |
| ⚙️ Kernel chain: cadorange → occt.ts | Modeling goes through **[cadorange](https://github.com/LAU-MARS/cadorange)** (the agent-native CAD runtime wrapping the occt.ts/OCCT WASM; public API + the supported `cadorange/occt` escape hatch for meshing/HLR/wire construction); the direct occt.ts adapter stays as the fallback tier — `DSH_CAD_KERNEL` pins one explicitly (the opencascade.js tier was removed in v0.15.1, −64MB install). The old "no editing after shell" seam is gone — fillet/chamfer/boolean keep working after shelling |
| 🔍 CAD viewing | STL / OBJ / STEP / IGES / BREP / DCPRT (3D), DXF / SVG (2D); interactive viewport in the resident right panel (orbit / zoom / wireframe / pan), with a one-line result row in the conversation |
| 🌗 Dark-mode surfaces | Every rendered surface follows the host theme — viewport slab, DXF/drawing strokes, the Three.js grid / XYZ triad / feature edges / default mesh color / sketch overlays, and the ViewCube plate; a theme flip restyles mounted viewers live. Overrides: `--dsh-cad-bg`, `--dsh-cad-stroke`, `--dsh-cad-paper` |
| 🧭 CAD editor interactions | Onshape-style ViewCube (26-zone click-to-orient), hover/click face & edge picking with live measurement (area mm² / length mm), Faces+Edges / Faces / Wireframe render modes, switchable BRep demo parts (bracket / flange / shaft) |
| 🏗️ Parametric modeling | Primitives, profile extrusion, **loft**, **sweep**, **revolve**, booleans, all-edge fillet/chamfer, **shell**, **draft**, **patterns** (linear/circular), transforms; profiles take **curve segments** (arcs/circles exact BRep; B-splines sampled approximation) — exact OCCT BRep, not a mesh approximation. `cad_loft` sections accept **curves** too: point loops, `{through}` splines or planar `{profile}` chains; `smooth: true` fits a **periodic B-spline** through point loops — one continuous B-spline lateral face instead of planar strips meeting at G0 creases |
| ✏️ Named sketches | Standalone named profiles (Sketch1…) kept in the document (`cad_sketch_new` / `edit` / `list` / `delete`); extrude/revolve/sweep reference them **by name**, and `cad_sketch_edit` rewrites the definition in place + replays the log, rebuilding every dependent feature — the parametric loop. Sketches render as Onshape-style **blue curves + plane frame** in the viewport (refreshing live on edit), listed in a left-side **feature tree** (sketches + features, eye-toggle visibility, click-to-highlight bodies) over the Part tab |
| 🗂️ Codex-style document tabs | The resident display panel gets a tab strip with a "+" menu: **Part** (Part Studio, the default) / **Assembly** (instance insert/move/remove) / **Drawing** (true hidden-line sheets); tabs are closable and keep their state |
| 🔩 Joint-driven assemblies | The build123d joint family (rigid/revolute/linear/cylindrical/ball/planar/polar): `cad_assembly_joint` defines, `cad_assembly_connect` pairs-and-solves (parent fixed, child repositioned onto the joint frames), `cad_assembly_drive` drives motion values with cascading re-solve (motion studies), `cad_assembly_explode` for exploded views; the assembly-tree panel gains a JOINTS section (kind/current value/pairing link). Pure main-thread placement algebra — kernel-independent, replays from the op log |
| 📥 STEP assembly import | `cad_step_import` imports a STEP document as an assembly: names, nesting and instance placements survive, identical geometry dedupes into one body referenced by N instances (a bolt pattern is one body); files cache as content-addressed workspace assets so op-log replay stays self-contained (cadorange kernel) |
| 📁 Multi-document file space | Named documents per workspace (`.dsh-cad/docs/`), each session bound to its own active document — new sessions start empty instead of inheriting leftovers; a folder button in the panel lists every document (preview / delete), and `cad_doc_new` / `cad_doc_open` manage the modeling target from chat |
| 📐 Engineering drawings | GB first-angle layout: front / top / left views + isometric, true OCCT hidden-line removal via the **occt.ts** kernel (an npm dependency, dashed); sheet frame, title block, overall dimensions, standard scale series; exports SVG / DXF |
| 🔗 Constraint solving & motion | **Ansatz** geometric constraint solver (**one command: `npm install ansatz-wasm`** — a wasm dependency, no Rust toolchain, no native binary): entity/constraint modeling (assembly instances ↔ rigid3 poses mapped automatically), solve-with-writeback, full DOF/residual/redundancy/suggestion diagnostics (LLM-oriented), and parametric kinematic sweeps (`cad_constraint` / `cad_solve` / `cad_motion`) |
| 📐 Geometry measurement | Exact volume (mm³), bounding box, triangle counts, DXF layers |
| 📤 On-demand export | STEP (parametric) / STL (mesh); files are written only when the user asks |
| 🖥️ Resident CAD panel | A permanent panel right of the conversation: Codex-style tabs (Part / Assembly / Drawing), tracking the latest model in real time while modeling. A host-independent liveness poll (`GET /dsh-cad/docs` → per-document op count) keeps the viewport following modeling ops even when the conversation meta pipeline goes stale, and auto-returns from a file preview |
| ⚡ Zero-copy render pipeline | worker mesh → in-memory binary → three.js typed arrays; zero base64 / zero intermediate files / zero per-step disk writes |
| 💾 Modeling document persistence | Operation log (JSON) + debounced disk mirror; automatically replayed to restore state after a process restart |
| 🖼️ Image → profile | PNG sketch/screenshot → Otsu binarization → contour tracing → extrusion-ready polygon (`cad_image_profile`) |
| 🔌 FreeCAD executor | Run the same op family on an external FreeCAD console (STEP in/out); requires a local FreeCAD install |
| ☁️ Onshape executor | Run the same op family on **Onshape** over its signed REST API — zero local install; every op compiles to a **standard Onshape feature** pushed into the target Part Studio (no Feature Studio setup). Readback is three-tier: cheap per-part STL by default, `readback: "step"` for exact-BRep-derived named meshes via a server-side STEP translation, or `readback: "none"` — build only and return the document link (~3 calls, quota-friendliest). Exports `.stl` / `.step` / `.x_t` (Parasolid). Quota-aware errors distinguish credential problems from free-plan cooldowns; the Onshape document URL is always surfaced |

## Installation

The plugin is published to npm — one line:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cad
```

The installer applies the bundled `cordis.patch.yml` (declared in the `dsh.bundle` manifest) automatically, so there is nothing to configure by hand.

### Version requirements

- **Node.js** and **dsh CLI** (`@deepseek-ai/dsh`): minimum versions live in
  the badge row above and the `engines` field of `package.json` — kept out of
  the prose so they never go stale

### Install from source (dev mode)

```sh
git clone https://github.com/LAU-MARS/dsh-cad.git
cd dsh-cad
npm install && npm run build && npm test   # deps include occt.ts (true-HLR drawing kernel, ~20MB wasm)

npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh pnpm
dsh web                                  # let the first launch init the profile, then Ctrl-C

dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-cad

dsh web
```

The patch insert ships as `cordis.patch.yml` in the package root and is applied by the installer via the same `dsh.bundle` manifest.

Set `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` and you are ready — for example:

- “open bracket.stl” → `cad_view`
- “model a 100×60×5 plate, punch a ⌀20 hole in the middle, R2 fillets on the four
  corners, add a ⌀16 boss 20 tall, export plate.step”
  → `cad_create_prim` + `cad_boolean` + `cad_fillet` + `cad_export`, with the 3D tab
  updating live at every step
- “build a snowman” → spheres + a cone nose + a cylinder hat (precise `at`/`axis` placement)
- “add two more b1, one rotated 90 degrees” → `cad_assembly_insert` + `cad_assembly_move`, the Assembly tab updates live
- “make an A3 drawing of b1 and export dxf” → `cad_drawing` (three views + iso + dashed hidden lines + dimensions) → `cad_export` `.dxf`

## Modeling Tool Family

| Tool | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cad_view` | Open a CAD file and render it in the viewer (resident panel) |
| `cad_info` | Read-only geometry metadata (format / counts / bounding box / units / layers) |
| `cad_create_prim` | Primitives (mm, Z-up); `at` for placement, `axis` for orientation (exact axis-angle rotation) |
| `cad_sketch_new` | Create a named sketch (Sketch1…): {start, segments} / {circle} / flat points loop — referenced by name from the profile features |
| `cad_sketch_edit` | Redefine a sketch (回改): the definition op is rewritten in place and the log replayed — every referencing feature rebuilds |
| `cad_sketch_list` | List the document's sketches (name / form / size) |
| `cad_sketch_delete` | Delete a sketch (refused while features still reference it) |
| `cad_extrude_profile` | Extrude a closed XY-plane profile along +Z into a solid — inline points/segments/circle or a named sketch (`sketch`) |
| `cad_loft` | Loft: skin a solid through successive closed sections (each a [x,y,z,…] loop in its own plane, or a curve/`profile` section); sections may differ in shape and point count; `smooth` fits a periodic B-spline through point loops for a **crease-free** skin; `ruled` for straight sides |
| `cad_revolve` | Solid of revolution: revolve a closed profile around an axis (profile coords = (radius, height); curve segments supported — rounded rims exact); optional `angle`; accepts a named sketch |
| `cad_chamfer` | Chamfer: bevel every sharp edge with one equal distance (mm) |
| `cad_pattern` | Pattern: linear (`delta` spacing) or circular (principal axis + `at` point + sweep angle); creates copy bodies, fuse afterwards for one body |
| `cad_shell` | Shell: hollow to a wall thickness (inward, outer skin preserved); `open` lists outward normals of the faces to open (empty = sealed). Runs on the occt.ts kernel; the result is a HOSTED body |
| `cad_draft` | Draft: tilt the walls `angle` degrees about a neutral plane (mold release); `direction` is the pull direction, walls auto-selected by default. Runs on the occt.ts kernel; the result is a HOSTED body |
| `cad_sweep` | Sweep: pipe a closed 2D profile along a 3D [x,y,z,…] path; the profile is auto-placed on the start plane, so no manual orientation; accepts a named sketch |
| `cad_boolean` | fuse / cut / common (classic hole punching: plate cut cylinder) |
| `cad_fillet` | Constant-radius fillet on all sharp edges |
| `cad_transform` | Translate / Euler rotate / mirror |
| `cad_volume` | Exact BRep volume (mm³) |
| `cad_drawing` | Engineering drawing: front/top/left + isometric views, dashed hidden lines, frame, title block, overall dimensions, standard scale, A4/A3 |
| `cad_assembly_insert` | Insert a body into the assembly as a placed instance (`at` position, `rotate` orientation) |
| `cad_assembly_move` | Set an instance's absolute placement |
| `cad_assembly_remove` | Remove an instance from the assembly (the body stays) |
| `cad_assembly_joint` | Define a joint on an instance (build123d family: rigid/revolute/linear/cylindrical/ball/planar/polar), frame in the instance's local coordinates |
| `cad_assembly_connect` | Pair joints to place a child: the parent stays fixed, the child is repositioned so both joint frames coincide (optional connect-time drive value) |
| `cad_assembly_drive` | Drive a joint's motion value and re-solve every pairing (one motion-study step; ranges enforced) |
| `cad_assembly_solve` | Re-solve all pairings at current joint values (after moving a parent manually) |
| `cad_assembly_explode` | Exploded-view factor (instances push radially from the assembly center; view-state only, exports/drawings stay assembled) |
| `cad_assembly_info` | Read the assembly state: placements + joint labels/types/values + pairings + explode factor |
| `cad_step_import` | Structured STEP import: names, part structure and placements survive; identical geometry dedupes into one body referenced by N instances |
| `cad_constraint` | Declare the constraint model: entities (assembly-instance bindings) + constraints (distance/angle/mate/coaxial…), persisted in the op log |
| `cad_solve` | Solve with Ansatz and write poses back; returns DOF/residual/redundancy/suggestion diagnostics |
| `cad_motion` | Kinematic sweep: drive one constraint value from `from` to `to`, solve frame by frame, apply the last pose, return the motion table |
| `cad_export` | Export STEP / STL / DCPRT (the native replayable part document) to a workspace path; `target: "assembly"` writes the assembly STEP, `target: "drawing"` writes the sheet as SVG / DXF |
| `cad_delete` | Delete a body |
| `cad_docs` | List the workspace's modeling documents (id / name / bodies / updated, active marked) |
| `cad_doc_new` | Create a named document and make it the session's modeling target (start multi-part projects here) |
| `cad_doc_open` | Open an existing document (by id or name) as the session's modeling target — bodies replay exactly |
| `cad_doc_rename` | Rename a document |
| `cad_doc_delete` | Permanently delete a document (requires `confirm: true`) |
| `cad_freecad` | Run an op program on an external FreeCAD executor (optional STEP input / export) |
| `cad_fusion` | Run an op program on an external Fusion 360 executor (GUI bridge; optional export) |
| `cad_onshape` | Run an op program on the Onshape cloud (signed REST API): creates or drives a document, returns its URL; `readback: "step"` for exact BRep meshes; exports `.stl` / `.step` / `.x_t` (Parasolid) |
| `cad_image_profile` | PNG → contours → extrusion-ready polygon points |
| `cad_script` | Deterministic script evaluation for geometry math (profile point arrays, arc coordinates): `js` runs in-process (Node vm — works even when the host shell is unavailable), `py` uses a system Python |

After every modeling step: **the chat result row updates in place** (stable viewId +
versioned URL), and the resident panel's "Part" tab tracks the latest model in real time.

## Connectors (roadmap)

Modeling runs on the **occt.ts kernel** via cadorange (OCCT in the browser —
zero install). The connectors below refer to **external CAD engines** acting as
executors for the same tool family, planned for future support:

| Connector | Suite | Platform | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Built-in kernel** | CAD modeling kernel based on OCCT + WebGL, runs in the browser — zero install | All platforms (WebGL rendering) | ✅ Built-in |
| FreeCAD | open-source parametric suite — natural local executor via its Python API (console + GUI window modes) | Windows / macOS / Linux | ✅ Available (needs local install) |
| Fusion 360 | Autodesk CAD/CAM — resident add-in + spool bridge (no headless; the Fusion window doubles as a viewer) | Windows / macOS | 🧪 Experimental (`cad_fusion`) |
| SolidWorks | Dassault Systèmes industry-standard 3D CAD, COM/.NET automation | Windows only | 🚧 Windows demo scaffold (`scripts/solidworks-bridge/`) |
| Onshape | PTC cloud-native SaaS CAD, fully in the browser — signed REST API (cad.onshape.com or chamber hosts); every op compiles to a standard Onshape feature pushed into the Part Studio, results read back as per-part STL + mass properties, the cloud is the viewer | All platforms (browser) | ✅ Available (`cad_onshape`; set `DSH_ONSHAPE_ACCESS_KEY` / `DSH_ONSHAPE_SECRET_KEY`) |
| ZW3D（中望3D） | ZWSOFT all-in-one CAD/CAM | Windows / Linux | 🚧 Planned |
| GstarCAD 3D（浩辰3D） | Gstarsoft 3D CAD | Windows | 🚧 Planned |

All external engines implement the same **GeometryExecutor contract** (`available()` /
`run(opProgram) → meshes`), so the WebGL display layer never changes — swapping a
backend changes only the quality of the produced geometry.

## Architecture

```
cad_view(path)                        modeling tools (cad_create_prim, …)
  → import worker (occt-import-js)      → modeling worker (occt.ts WASM via cadorange)
  → CadScene JSON (base64-f32)          → exact BRep geometry + meshing
  → GET /dsh-cad/scene/<id>            → in-memory binary scene (f32/u32 packed)
                                        → GET /dsh-cad/bin/<docId>
            ↓ session presentationMeta (viewId + versioned URL) ↓
        browser card + persistent "3D" tab (three.js / SVG, Z-up, XYZ axes)
```

- **Two workers**: import (occt-import-js, read-only STEP/IGES/BREP) and modeling
  (cadorange over the occt.ts wasm) are separate, both lazily started
- **Zero-copy pipeline**: modeling scenes use zero base64 / zero large JSON arrays /
  zero per-step disk writes (disk mirror debounced 1.5s, replayed only on service
  restart); `cad_export` is the only explicit file export
- **Modeling document**: `<workspace>/.dsh-cad/model.json` operation log; all bodies
  are restored by replay after a restart
- **Drawing HLR kernel**: hidden lines run on **occt.ts** (npm dependency,
  `npm i occt.ts`) — true OCCT removal, no fallback engine, a missing kernel is
  a hard error. Kernel APIs: `hiddenLines()` true hidden-line
  removal, byte-level STEP/BRep `readStep`/`readBrep`/`writeStep`/`writeBrep`
  without MEMFS, tessellation with built-in feature-edge extraction, and a
  `hasError()`/`lastError()` error contract. Geometry crosses kernels as STEP
  bytes and the projected segments are remapped into the sheet frame. Kernel
  dist resolution: `DSH_OCCTJS_DIST` env var → Node's own resolution of the
  `occt.ts` dependency (walks up every parent node_modules — npm/yarn flat and
  pnpm symlink layouts all hit) → `<repo>/../opencascade-ts/dist` (sibling
  checkout) → `vendor/` → `node_modules/opencascade-ts`
- **Constraint solving (Ansatz)**: the solver is the npm dependency
  **`ansatz-wasm`** (a wasm-bindgen build, single package ~538KB, zero deps) —
  installing dsh-cad pulls it automatically, and `npm install ansatz-wasm` alone
  upgrades it. **No Rust toolchain, no native binary, platform independent.**
  Resolution: the npm package (node_modules) → a `DSH_ANSATZ_WASM` directory → a
  sibling Ansatz checkout's pkg-node. The solver speaks one JSON envelope
  contract, with tool-layer errors (e.g. `unsupported_constraint`) surfaced
  verbatim for the LLM. Assembly placements (translate + XYZ Euler
  degrees) map bidirectionally to the solver's rigid3 poses (translate +
  exponential-map rotation, radians). Solver capability is staged
  (point-distance-to-origin today) — the plumbing contract is finished and needs
  no changes as it grows
- **Kernel chain**: modeling goes through **cadorange** (agent-native CAD
  runtime; public build123d-style API for prims/curve-segment profiles (TRUE
  B-spline interpolation)/loft/sweep/revolve/booleans (cleaned by default)/
  fillet/chamfer/shell/draft/native mirror/centroid, plus the supported
  `cadorange/occt` escape hatch for viewer tessellation, engineering-drawing
  HLR (zero STEP hops, one wasm session) and wire construction); the direct
  occt.ts adapter stays as the fallback tier (`DSH_CAD_KERNEL` pins one; see
  docs/cadorange-integration.md for the verb-by-verb mapping). Editing after
  shelling is seamless. Assembly STEP export writes a **structured document**
  (cadorange
  `exportStepAssembly`): one root product plus one named, placed child
  per instance — instance separation survives the file (STL stays a single
  fused mesh). Instance separation stays in
  the assembly scene/document for the fuse paths.
  Face selection matches `describe()` plane normals (outermost along ±normal)
- **Client**: esbuild single-file CJS factory (three.js inlined ~560KB, react provided
  by the host module table), Z-up CAD convention, empty scene with XYZ axis labels
  and a ground grid always displayed

## Theming (dark mode)

The viewer follows the host appearance automatically. DSH publishes the theme as
`color-scheme` on `<html>` plus `body[data-ds-dark-theme]`; the plugin resolves
that (falling back to `prefers-color-scheme`) and themes every surface the host
tokens cannot reach:

- the viewport slab behind the transparent WebGL canvas and 2D scenes,
- default 2D entity strokes (DXF / engineering-drawing entities),
- the Three.js ground grid, XYZ axis triad/labels, feature edges, default mesh
  color and sketch overlays,
- the ViewCube face plate (canvas texture).

A theme flip restyles mounted cards and the resident panel live — no reload and
no lost camera. Engineering drawings loaded as SVG keep a white sheet; in dark
mode it is framed as paper on the dark slab instead of filling the viewport.

Hosts can override the surfaces the plugin owns; an explicit definition wins in
either theme:

| CSS variable | Applies to | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--dsh-cad-bg` | viewport background (any CSS `background` value) | light `#f5f6f8→#e9ecf0`, dark `#1b1b1c→#151517` |
| `--dsh-cad-stroke` | default 2D entity stroke | `#4c5561` light / `#c8ced6` dark |
| `--dsh-cad-paper` | drawing paper behind SVG sheets | `#ffffff` |

```css
:root { --dsh-cad-bg: #0b0d10; }          /* flat canvas in both themes */
```

## Tests

```sh
npm test                             # full suite: converters / modeling worker (exact volume assertions) / DCPRT round-trip / FreeCAD + Onshape executors / image profiles / binary pipeline / document persistence
node test/route-check.mjs            # JSON scene routing layer
node test/visual/serve.mjs           # browser card/tab visual verification page (http://127.0.0.1:3987)
```

Representative assertions covered: the boolean-punched volume exactly equals the
analytic value (28429.20 mm³), L-shaped profile extrusion 3000 mm³, volumes and
bounding-box flips of sphere/cone/torus placed with `at`/`axis`, 8-byte alignment
of the binary packing, an STL export round-trip (export → read back by the
phase-1 parser), and a DCPRT document round-trip (serialize → replay on the
OCCT worker → exact bounds).

## Known Limitations

- DWG (closed-source) is unsupported; DXF bulge arcs are approximated by chords;
  glTF/3MF viewing is not implemented (the structure is reserved)
- `cad_fillet` is all-edge constant-radius (per-edge selection is unstable under
  embind); chamfer is not implemented
- Sketch extrusion supports polygon profiles only (arc profiles are constructed by
  boolean combinations of cylinders/tori)
- dsh framework limitation: an already-mounted single slot (the right-side details
  panel itself) does not respond to components registered later, so the persistent
  view is provided as the "3D" view tab (a list slot, the official composition)
- The host reads CAD files via node:fs (the platform fs service supports UTF-8 text
  only and cannot carry binary data)

## Community

| QQ Group (🇨🇳 China) | Feishu (🇨🇳 China) | X / Twitter (🌍 International) | Discord (🌍 International) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `485038246` (join note: dsh-cad) | 🚧 Coming soon | 🚧 Coming soon | 🚧 Coming soon |

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-session-view

DSH Web 的**会话视图**插件：默认接管左侧工作区块，以会话为主行展示置顶 / 活跃 / 最近 / 已完成未读会话，可一键切回原生工作区；主窗口提供完整的会话管理页，偏好设置并入系统「设置」。

版本 0.7.7。

## 功能

### 左侧会话视图（接管模式）

- 不再占用顶部面板菜单：由 footer action 的零尺寸锚点挂载，通过 React Portal 把会话视图插到侧栏 panel nav 之后；默认隐藏原生工作区列表，但**不卸载**它，切回时状态完整保留。侧栏底部不再显示模式切换按钮，入口统一在系统「设置 → 会话视图」。
- **兼容 dsh-ssh**：原生 `.regionArea` 顶部的「远端」SSH 面板保持显示。会话模式下只隐藏原生工作区列表，SSH 面板固定在会话视图上方；切回原生后仍位于工作区列表上方。
- 顶部工具栏：搜索、新建会话、添加工作区、**会话管理**；切换原版工作区统一在系统「设置 → 会话视图」。
- **活跃会话 / 最近会话**分组标题始终显示（无内容时计数为 0），方便随时查看分组状态。
- **动态边框**：设置里为「运行中 / 待处理 / 已完成未读」三种状态分别提供开关与效果选择（跑马灯 / 极光流光 / 呼吸脉冲 / 彩虹流转 / 彗星拖尾 / 扫描线 / 流光虚线），每项都有实时预览，所见即所得；只叠加动画描边，不改变行高，并尊重 `prefers-reduced-motion`。
- **活跃会话**分组：显示运行中 / 待处理 / **完成未读** / 有运行中子会话的顶层会话；会话完成后只要还没有打开查看（completionUnread）就继续留在活跃区，打开后才移出；按 `settings.activeLimit` 限制条数，支持「更多 / 收起」，分组可折叠。
- **置顶**分组：置顶会话排在最前，置顶/取消置顶通过行菜单或右键菜单完成，行尾不再显示图钉图标；分组可折叠。
- **最近会话**分组：按更新时间显示最近的会话（包含活跃、置顶会话），按 `settings.recentLimit` 限制条数，支持「更多 / 收起」，分组可折叠。
- **新建会话草稿**：点击「新会话」后立即关闭看板；只要草稿仍由主视图保留，就以「新会话」为标题同时出现在最近、活跃和所属工作区分组中，创建完成后转为正式标题。
- 活跃 / 置顶 / 最近三个分组都只是快捷入口；同一个会话**仍然保留在所属工作区分组中**。
- 四个分组可分别在系统设置里关闭：`显示活跃会话分组` / `显示置顶会话分组` / `显示最近会话分组` / `显示工作区会话分组`。
- **工作区分组**：放在「工作区会话」分区下，按工作区路径树形嵌套（取最长前缀父目录），每个工作区按 `settings.workspaceLimit` 限制条数；空工作区始终显示其标题，不再渲染「暂无会话」占位行；「工作区会话」分区可折叠。
- **搜索**：本地标题/路径匹配 + 250ms 防抖调用 `sessions.search` 做 Host 内容搜索，本地与内容命中合计最多 20 条，显示命中片段；支持清空与 `Ctrl+K` 聚焦。
- **工作区筛选**：系统「设置 → 会话视图 → 工作区筛选」列出全部工作区（名称 + 路径），可逐个开关左侧是否显示；保存的是隐藏列表，因此新工作区默认显示；隐藏状态持久化，被隐藏工作区的会话不会出现在左侧（也不会落入「全部会话」）。
- **排序与过滤**：最近更新 / 手动排序、归档过滤（隐藏 / 显示 / 仅归档）、显示/隐藏空闲会话、工作区树形嵌套。
- **每工作区水位**：默认显示 5 条；如果前 50 条里存在运行中 / 待处理 / 完成未读 / 有运行中子会话的会话，自动展开到最后一条活跃会话；「展开更多」每次 +5 条，「收起」回到水位。
- **折叠持久化**：活跃 / 置顶 / 最近 / 工作区会话分区的折叠状态写入 localStorage，刷新后保持；手动展开条数只保留在本次页面。
- **专注模式**：可创建多个专注组，每组挑选若干工作区；进入某个专注组后，左侧只展示这些工作区及其会话（工作区分组、已归档分组、内容搜索命中一起收窄），并显示专注条与「进入 / 切换 / 退出专注」。左侧列表新增与「最近会话 / 工作区会话」同级的 **专注组** 分区：列出全部专注组、成员数与使用中标记；**左键组行即展开该组的成员工作区**（再点工作区头展开其会话，右键菜单、新建会话、拖拽排序、「更多」折叠与工作区会话分区完全一致），展开状态记入 `focusExpanded` 并持久化；右键组行弹出「进入 / 切换 / 退出、重命名、编辑成员工作区、删除」菜单（只作用于该组：改名用轻量输入框，成员用单组勾选弹窗，删除需二次确认），分区头始终保留「新建」「管理」两个图标按钮；列表为空时只显示标题行，不再渲染空提示块。弹窗内顶部状态条显示当前是否处于专注，组卡片展示成员工作区与失效成员数量，可直接进入 / 退出某个组、就地改名、增删成员、删除专注组；新建组在弹窗内展开表单。管理弹窗只从分区头的「管理」图标进入（主面板与标题栏的专注入口均已移除）。已失效的成员工作区只在渲染时取交集，不会被静默删除。
- **会话行**：点击打开会话；待处理行用「等待批准 / 等待方案审核 / 等待回答」替换时间；右键菜单支持置顶、重命名、派生、复制会话 ID、归档、移入回收站；子会话默认不显示，只统计父会话的「+N 个运行中」。
- **右键管理**：会话行右键打开「打开 / 置顶 / 重命名 / 分叉 / 复制会话 ID / 归档 / 移到回收站」，工作区标题右键打开「新建会话 / 重命名工作区 / 删除工作区」；原生浏览器右键菜单被替换。
- **已归档 / 回收站**：主面板标签页直接展示对应会话列表，已归档页支持批量恢复、批量移入回收站；回收站中的会话不会再出现在已归档或左侧列表；回收站标题优先使用删除时保存的标题，并按原 `cwd` 恢复所属工作区，行内显示「工作区 · 删除于 …」。
- **失效会话自愈**：归档 / 恢复 / 置顶时如果 Host 返回「会话不存在」「已归档」「未归档」等状态不一致错误，该行会从当前列表移除，并提示「已清理 N 个状态失效的会话」，不再反复报错。
- **快捷键**：`Ctrl+K` 搜索、`Ctrl+Alt+N` 新建会话、`F2` / `Ctrl+Alt+G` 重命名当前聚焦会话、`Ctrl+Alt+F` 派生、`Ctrl+Alt+A` 归档、`Esc` 关闭菜单/弹窗。
- **工作区右键菜单**：重命名、删除工作区（新建会话用标题右侧的 `+`）；新建时可通过 Host 目录选择器选路径，也可手动输入。工作区标题右侧不再有「…」更多操作按钮。
- **手动排序**：`sort=manual` 时可拖动会话行排序，结果按工作区保存在 localStorage；同一模式下也可拖动工作区标题调整工作区顺序。拖动时锁定文本选择，只显示当前拖动行；目标行显示上/下插入指示线，松手按落点位置插入。
- **运行中归档**：归档运行中的会话时弹出「停止并归档」确认，失败信息显示在行内 footer。
- 系统「设置 → 会话视图」通过同一份 `prefs.js` 即时驱动模式与显示选项；侧栏不再有独立的模式切换按钮。

### 与原版工作区的视觉对齐

- 侧栏内容宽度与原生一致（280px 根宽、`padding: 6px 12px`），视图用 `margin-left:-4px` / `margin-right:-12px` 对齐原生 `.regionArea`，切换后不会跳动。
- 头部 36px，标题 14px tertiary，图标按钮 28×28；搜索展开后 30px 高、0.5px 边框。
- 会话行 32px，标题 14px/20px 单行省略，时间 10px/16px 右对齐，状态点槽 16×20；悬停时隐藏时间。会话行右侧不再有「…」按钮，管理操作统一走右键菜单。紧凑模式行高 26px，仍保留 9px 的会话时间，只隐藏子会话标签。
- 工作区标题 34px、标题 14px primary，不带文件夹图标，始终显示展开箭头；分区标题 36px / 15px（半粗）tertiary，计数 13px；行与分组间距 2px。
- 四个分区标题统一使用 12px 图标：活跃会话为活动折线，最近会话为时钟，置顶为图钉，工作区会话为分栏；活跃状态点带扩散脉冲动画（遵循系统的减少动态效果设置）。
- 工作区内存在运行中 / 待处理会话时，工作区标题右侧显示脉冲状态点，折叠状态下同样可见。
- 文字配色对齐原生：会话标题与工作区标题使用 `label-primary`，时间、计数、分区标题使用 `label-tertiary`，字号分别为 14px / 10px / 13px。
- 右键菜单使用系统菜单同款字体与行高（13px / 20px），不再是编辑器式的小号菜单。
- 视图高度跟随侧栏剩余空间，列表在内部滚动，不撑开页面。

### 主窗口会话面板

- 三个标签页：**会话 / 已归档 / 回收站**。
- 工具栏位于标签页下方：搜索、工作区筛选、分组方式和操作按钮；标题行只保留标题、说明与总数。
- **展开全部 / 收起全部** 与 **批量管理** 都下放到工具栏右侧，不再占用标题行。
- 状态分区：`置顶 → 运行中 → 待处理 → 完成未读 → 其他会话`；选中状态 chip 时只显示对应分区。
- 会话行单行展示：标题与工作区/时间同排，行高 34px；支持工作区下拉、状态 chip、标题/工作区/路径搜索组合筛选。
- **置顶**：置顶会话排在所有状态分区之前，并额外出现在左侧视图；切换置顶不弹提示条。
- **归档 / 取消归档**：调用 Host 原生 `workspaceRegistry`，归档后从「会话」页移除，可在「已归档」页取消归档。
- **移入回收站**：普通会话先归档（让 Host 释放会话），已归档会话不会再归档；成功写入回收站索引后自动取消归档，确保已归档列表同步消失。
- **回收站联动**：主面板的移入回收站 / 恢复 / 彻底删除通过共享 `trash-store` 立即推送到左侧会话视图，不需要切回窗口或等焦点刷新；左侧同一会话会同步消失或恢复。
- **恢复**：从回收站恢复到普通会话列表。
- **彻底删除**：真实删除会话目录（`~/.dsh/sessions/<slug>/session-<id>/`），不是仅从列表移除；删除后重建工作区索引。
- **批量管理**：进入管理态后可全选/勾选多条，批量归档、移入回收站、恢复、彻底删除；危险操作有确认对话框。已归档页同样支持批量移入回收站。
- **按工作区管理**：主面板工具栏的「分组方式」默认按工作区展示，会话 / 已归档 / 回收站三个标签页都适用，与左侧会话视图一致；也可切换为按状态。工作区分组标题可点击折叠，工具栏提供「展开全部 / 收起全部」，进入管理态后带「选择本组」，可整组归档、移入回收站或恢复。
- **内部滚动**：内容区独立滚动，页面本身不再滚动（滚轮落在列表区域时只滚动面板内容）。
- **点击打开**：行按钮调用 `ctx.uiWorkspace.openSession(id)`，Host 以 `reveal` 方式替换主视图并自动关闭面板，会话回到主窗口。
- 侧栏与主面板均不显示子会话；顶部工具栏的 **会话管理** 按钮直接打开该面板。
- 专注过滤只作用于左侧会话栏，主面板不再提供专注模式入口；设置页「列表行为」新增 **专注模式** 开关，关闭后隐藏左侧专注组分区、专注条与全部专注入口并停止过滤，已创建的专注组仍会保留。
- 中英文文案；颜色/边框全部使用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题变量。

## 系统设置

系统「设置 → 会话视图」按五个卡片分组：

- **显示**：左侧工作区模式（会话视图 / 原版工作区）、显示子会话、显示空闲会话。
- **分组**：显示最近 / 置顶 / 活跃 / 工作区会话分组；置顶和活跃不会从工作区会话中移除。
- **工作区筛选**：列出全部工作区的名称与路径，逐个开关是否在左侧显示；未勾选（隐藏）的 id 持久化，新建工作区默认显示，「全部显示」可一键恢复。
- **数量与排序**：活跃、最近、每个工作区显示条数（0 表示不限），会话排序，工作区树形嵌套。
- **列表行为**：已归档过滤、显示更新时间、紧凑行高、动态边框。
- 每项都有说明文字；底部提供「恢复默认」与快捷键提示。设置只保存在本机浏览器 localStorage。

## 状态颜色

| 颜色 | 状态 | 判定 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 蓝（呼吸动画） | 运行中 | `status.running ?? summary.running` |
| 琥珀 | 待处理 | `status.pendingInteraction`（等待批准 / 等待方案审核 / 等待回答；未知类型显示「待处理」） |
| 绿 | 完成未读 | `status.completionUnread === true` |
| 灰 | 空闲 | 以上都不满足 |

状态只来自 Host 暴露的 `SessionStatus`（`running` / `pendingInteraction` / `completionUnread`）与 `SessionSummary.running`。列表级接口没有错误态，因此插件不显示红色「错误」状态；某会话的错误详情仍应在打开后的会话内查看。

已归档会话在「已归档」页使用中性色，回收站条目单独展示，不参与状态分区。

## 设置

`src/client/prefs.js` 使用 localStorage 键 `dsh-session-view.prefs.v1`，默认值：

```js
{
  mode: 'session',        // session | native
  activeLimit: 5,         // 0–50，0 表示不限
  recentLimit: 5,         // 0–50，0 表示不限
  workspaceLimit: 5,      // 0–50，0 表示不限
  showIdle: true,
  showSubagents: false,
  showRecent: true,
  showPinned: true,
  showActive: true,
  showWorkspaces: true,
  showTimes: true,
  compact: false,
  glowRunning: 'off',    // off | marquee | aurora | pulse | rainbow | comet | scan | dash
  glowPending: 'off',
  glowDone: 'off',
  archivedFilter: 'hide', // hide | show | only
  sort: 'updated',        // updated | manual
  nestWorkspaces: true,
  manualOrder: {},        // 按分组 key 保存的会话 id 顺序
  collapsedGroups: [],    // 折叠的工作区 id
  focusGroups: [],        // [{ id, name, workspaceIds }]，专注组
  focusGroupId: '',       // 当前进入的专注组 id，空串表示未启用
  focusExpanded: [],      // 已展开的专注组 id（左键展开成员工作区）
  focusEnabled: true,     // 专注模式总开关，关闭后隐藏入口并停止过滤
  hiddenWorkspaceIds: [], // 仅在左侧隐藏的工作区 id；新工作区默认不在列表内
}
```

系统设置分区通过 `subscribePrefs` / `setPrefs` 驱动侧栏，不需要刷新页面；修改模式后侧栏立即切换。

## Host 接口

`lib/index.js` 是 Host 半边（`inject: ['webServer','workspaceRegistry','sessionPersistence','sessions']`），注册以下 exact 路由：

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/session-view/capabilities` | 返回 `{ok, trash, purge}` |
| GET | `/session-view/trash` | 回收站索引 |
| POST | `/session-view/trash/add` | 归档后移入回收站 |
| POST | `/session-view/trash/restore` | 只移除成功恢复的条目 |
| POST | `/session-view/trash/purge` | 物理删除会话目录 |

彻底删除的保护：

- 会话仍被 Host 打开（`sessions.get(id)` 存在）→ 409；
- 会话仍被写者占用（`sessionPersistence.open(id,'write')` 抛 `already owned`）→ 409；
- 目录 basename 与会话 id 不一致、目录不在预期根下 → 拒绝；
- 删除后再次 `stat` 检查，若目录重新出现 → 报错，不谎报成功。

回收站索引默认在 `~/.dsh/session-view-trash.json`，可用环境变量 `DSH_SESSION_VIEW_TRASH` 覆盖；写入使用串行队列 + 临时文件 rename，避免并发写坏索引。

## 安装

本插件是标准 DSH bundle 插件：包内自带 `cordis.patch.yml`（bundle patch）、`lib/index.js`（Host 半边）与 `lib/client.js`（Web 客户端 bundle）。安装统一走 `dsh plugin`——它把参数转发给目标 profile 目录里的 pnpm，并在安装后把 `dsh-session-view` 追加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`。**bundle 只在 DSH 进程启动时加载，安装或更新后必须重启 `dsh web`。**

兼容性由 `engines.dsh` 决定（`>=0.2.1-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`）：该字段存在时 DSH 只用它判定兼容，`peerDependencies` 不再参与。不满足时安装会被拒绝，确认可用后可显式豁免：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web allow-version dsh-session-view@0.7.0 --dsh-version <当前 dsh 版本> --accept-risk
```

### 方式一：npm（发布后可用）

```bash
npm publish                                    # 维护者：首次需先 npm login
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-session-view@0.7.0
```

升级：`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-session-view@latest`。

### 方式二：Git 仓库

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/lidongbei/dsh-session-view.git#<40 位 commit>
```

### 方式三：本地目录（开发调试，推荐脚本）

```bash
npm install && npm run build
npm run install:profile -- --profile web --source link --apply
```

脚本在 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/local-plugins/dsh-session-view` 建立 junction / symlink 指向本仓库，再写入 `link:local-plugins/dsh-session-view` 依赖——Windows 上 pnpm 处理跨盘绝对 `file:` 依赖会拼错路径，因此不要手写绝对路径。省略 `--apply` 时只打印将要执行的命令（dry-run）。

其他来源：`--source tgz`（先 `npm pack` 生成 tgz）、`--source git`（使用当前 HEAD 的 commit）、`--source registry`。

### 方式四：插件市场索引

`market/index.json` 是按 DSH market index format 1 生成的索引，`npm run market:index` 可复现（`--timestamp` / `--git --commit` 控制产物）。把它的 raw URL 填进 Web 插件页或 Discover 的索引地址即可浏览安装；索引当前指向 npm 源，需先完成 `npm publish`。

### 校验、更新与卸载

```bash
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -n "dsh-session-view"   # 确认已注入
npm run uninstall:profile -- --profile web --apply              # 卸载（脚本同样默认 dry-run）
```

排障：

- `not-a-bundle`：包内缺少 `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向的 `cordis.patch.yml`，确认安装的是 ≥0.7.0 的正式包；
- pnpm 报跨盘 `file:` 路径错误：改用 `--source link`，让脚本建立 profile 内 junction；
- 安装成功但界面无变化：重启 `dsh web`，并检查 `dsh.profile.bundles` 是否包含 `dsh-session-view`；
- 完全回退：`npm run uninstall:profile -- --profile web --apply`，删除 `local-plugins/dsh-session-view`，再重启。
- 本地改代码后界面仍是旧行为：确认 `profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-session-view` 是符号链接（不是 pnpm 复制出来的目录）；若是目录，重新执行 `npm run install:profile -- --profile web --source link --apply` 后再重启。

## 开发

```bash
npm install
npm test        # 55 项：会话/工作区逻辑、Host 路由、SSR、构建注册、包契约
npm run build   # esbuild -> lib/client.js（__ModuleLoader__ 包装）
npm run check   # build + test
npm run pack:check      # npm pack --dry-run，检查发布清单
npm run market:index    # 重新生成 market/index.json
```

- `src/client/prefs.js`：localStorage 偏好存储与订阅，纯数据无 React。
- `src/client/logic.js`：纯函数（状态归并、父子分组、分区、活跃分组、工作区树、过滤、计数、相对时间、路径推导），无 React 依赖。
- `src/client/sidebar-workspace.jsx`：接管侧栏的会话视图（分组、水位、搜索、拖拽、右键菜单、快捷键、对话框、会话管理入口）。
- `src/client/sidebar-board.jsx`：零尺寸 footer 锚点 + Portal 定位 `nav.panelList`；检测 `.dsh-ssh-sidebar` 存在时把托管节点移到 SSH 面板之后，只隐藏原生工作区列表，保留 SSH 面板；`stopPropagation` 防止 React Portal 事件冒泡到侧栏 footer 的点击处理。
- `src/client/session-view.jsx`：主面板（标签页、分区、批量管理、确认框、Toast）。
- `src/client/api.js`：回收站路由的 fetch 封装。
- `src/client/index.jsx`：注册 `main`、`sidebar.footer.action`、`settings.section`，注册中英文字典，注入 Host 服务。
- `src/client/styles.js`：组件级 CSS，全部使用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题变量。
- `lib/index.js`：Host 半边，注册回收站/彻底删除路由与工作区索引刷新。
- `lib/client.js`：构建产物，通过 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 暴露 `apply` / `inject`。

## 已知限制

- 会话模式只隐藏原生工作区列表、保留 dsh-ssh 远端面板，依赖原生侧栏 `nav.panelList` / `.regionArea` / `.dsh-ssh-sidebar` 的 DOM 结构；DSH 或 dsh-ssh 若改动该结构，需要同步调整定位逻辑。
- 快捷键只在侧栏获得焦点或搜索框打开时生效，避免覆盖主窗口输入；`sidebar.session.row.hover` 原生行装饰仍未接入。
- 右键菜单替换只作用于会话视图内部的行与工作区标题，原生工作区模式保留浏览器默认菜单。
- 列表级状态不包含 per-session 错误，因此没有红色错误点。
- 彻底删除不可恢复；批量删除前请确认。运行中的会话/X 仍被写者占用时会被拒绝（409），而不是强制删除。
- 内容搜索由 Host `sessions.search` 提供，失败时只保留本地匹配，不阻塞列表。
- 相对时间每 60 秒刷新一次；侧栏宽度 <150px 时接管视图隐藏，原生区域保持隐藏，展开后恢复。
- 会话视图默认过滤子会话；开启「显示子会话」后按父子缩进展示，但原生工作区视图仍隐藏子会话。
- 设置保存在本机浏览器，不写入 DSH 配置。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-plugin-aitelier Use **AItelier** as a subagent from [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): design a pipeline, edit its graph / roles / prompts / tools, run it, and carry it to another machine. The plugin is a Profile Bundle that mounts one `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` row against AItelier's MCP endpoint. The model then sees the surface as native tools under `mcp__aitelier__*`. Compatibility: the patch assumes `dsh-mcp-client`'s config shape as of dsh **0.1.0-rc.2** (`serverName`/`transport`/`url`/`headers`/`toolCallTimeoutMs`); every dsh release through 0.1.2-alpha.1 keeps it. This is deliberately **not** a `peerDependencies` entry: the plugin has no code and imports nothing — dsh resolves the `mcp-client` name from its own installation — and a declared peer would invite pnpm's `auto-install-peers` to pull a second, registry-sourced copy of `dsh-mcp-client` into the profile, which dsh's profile-first module resolution would then shadow the installation's instance with. > ### No `mcp__aitelier__*` tools? Read this first. > > A connection failure here is **silent**. `dsh-mcp-client` has `failOnStartupError: false`, so an unreachable endpoint does not stop `dsh` booting — the tools simply never appear, and nothing says why. An agent in that state can only report "no such tools" and guess; it cannot diagnose it from the inside. Check, in order: > > 1. **Is AItelier running?** `curl -s localhost:4444/health` should answer `{"status":"ok",…}`. If not, start it — see [Prerequisite](#prerequisite-aitelier-itself). > 2. **Is the URL right for where `dsh` runs?** The default is `http://127.0.0.1:4444/mcp` (host). Use `http://aitelier:4444/mcp` **only** if `dsh` is itself a container on the same docker network. > 3. **Does the endpoint answer?** `curl -s -X POST $AITELIER_MCP_URL -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"c","version":"0"}}}'` — a `421` means the Host header is not in AItelier's allow-list (set `AITELIER_MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS` on the AItelier side). > 4. **Is the row actually mounted?** `dsh --profile --dump-config | grep -A3 mcp-aitelier`. ## Prerequisite: AItelier itself This plugin is a *client*. It does not install or start AItelier — you need one running and reachable first. AItelier ships as a container: ```bash git clone https://github.com/linxuhao/AItelier && cd AItelier mkdir -p ~/.aitelier-secrets && chmod 700 ~/.aitelier-secrets printf '%s' "sk-your-deepseek-key" > ~/.aitelier-secrets/DEEPSEEK_API_KEY chmod 600 ~/.aitelier-secrets/DEEPSEEK_API_KEY docker compose up -d # serves the API + MCP endpoint on 127.0.0.1:4444 ``` The LLM key stays on the AItelier side and never travels through this plugin — see [Which API key goes where](#which-api-key-goes-where). ## Install ```bash corepack enable pnpm # `dsh plugin` drives pnpm; on a node-only box it refuses dsh plugin --profile headless add dsh-plugin-aitelier ``` That one command installs the package **and** appends it to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`. Then restart the profile. Configure it in the Harness home's env layer (`~/.dsh/.env`): ```sh AITELIER_MCP_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4444/mcp # the default; set it only to override AITELIER_ADMIN_TOKEN=… # required for writes and private State reads ``` Ordinary workflow reads work with no credentials. Writes and private State reads need the token — see [Authorization](#authorization). Verify the install by asking the agent to call `mcp__aitelier__list_pipelines`; it should come back with the registered pipelines. ## Persistent project State DAG For project goals and acceptance, first call `state_graph_help` and read its `driver_guide` field. It is the tool-only fallback for the MCP prompt `state_graph_driver` and resource `aitelier://state/driver-guide`; use the live schemas instead of assuming this client bundles the latest server contract. If State tools are absent, report the backend capability gap; ordinary pipeline operations can still be used where appropriate. Use one persistent State project per product. Register workflow or external attempts before dispatch, retain exact IDs and frozen context, and wait with `state_graph_read(action="wait_for_state_change", arguments=...)`. Persist `next_after` with its filter scope. Timeout does not stop a worker; completion produces a candidate, not acceptance. Record actual evidence for each criterion before explicit verification. Checkpoint decisions follow existing authorization. Keep a compact private director notebook for decisions, unresolved questions, worker/worktree ownership and cursor handoff. Reference State IDs; do not copy its status tables or event history. No notebook API is assumed. On resume, read current State before acting; notes cannot grant permission or certify results. ## The surface | Tool | Kind | What it is for | |---|---|---| | `list_pipelines` | read | Start here. Names + `input_hint` for every registered pipeline. | | `get_pipeline` | read | One pipeline's graph YAML and step list. | | `edit_pipeline` | write | Replace the graph. Validated before anything is written. | | `list_roles` / `get_role` | read | The agent roles a pipeline's steps use. | | `edit_role` | write | Model, tools, temperature, thinking. | | `list_templates` / `get_template` | read | Each role's prompt. | | `edit_template` | write | Replace a role's prompt — the main way to change behaviour. | | `list_tools` / `get_tool` | read | Host tools; which are generated (editable) vs built-in. | | `edit_tool` | write | Write a generated tool. The source must import and define its own name. | | `export_pipeline` | read | The whole closure — graph, roles with prompts, custom tools — as one JSON bundle. | | `import_pipeline` | write | Install a bundle, optionally under a new name. | | `generate_pipeline` | write | Write a NEW pipeline from a description (runs AItelier's grounded generator). `edit_target=` re-generates an existing one with a change. | | `archive_pipeline` | write | Retire a generated pipeline. Deleting its files alone leaves a runnable zombie. | | `run_pipeline` | write | Start a run; returns a `run_id` immediately. | | `wait_for_run` | read | Block until the run pauses at a checkpoint or finishes. Use this, not a poll loop. | | `answer_checkpoint` | write | Approve or reject a paused run. Rejecting sends work back with feedback. | | `stop_pipeline` | write | Cancel a run that is going nowhere. | | `get_run_status` | read | A single non-blocking look. | | `get_run_summary` | read | What the run did: per-step status, the FIRST failure with its error, final outputs. Inside a loop each entry names the **item** it ran for. | | `get_step_output` | read | The files ONE step produced. Each is capped at 20000 chars; a file that was cut says so in the text and in a `truncated` map, and `file=` reads one file at a 200000-char cap. | | `novel_ledger_query` | read | A novel project's per-chapter history from its append-only ledger (by entity / chapter range / field / entry type). Current state is in the chapter context pack; this is for history only. Private read. See docs/novel-ledger.md. | | `list_runs` | read | Recent runs, newest first — the entry point when you hold no id. | | `trace_list` / `trace_search` / `trace_read` | read | The durable trace: find where it broke, then read the actual prompt / response / tool result. | | `driver_whoami` | read | Resolve this credential to its driver/owner identity, memberships and capabilities. | | `declare_driver_presence` | write | Declare THIS credential offline or back online. There is no driver argument — the token decides. While you are offline (declared and not waiting, or unseen past the stale bound) another member of the project may take over your live claims; any `wait_for_*`, `claim_node`, `heartbeat` or external-attempt call ends the declaration. | | `observe_deployment_quiescence` | write | Record an actual deployment-quiescence observation; does not authorize a deployment. | | `state_graph_help` | read | The typed operation contracts of the persistent State DAG, plus `driver_guide`. Read it before any other `state_graph_*` call. | | `state_graph_read` | read | Persistent State projects, node context, dependency frontier, attempts, evidence — and `wait_for_state_change`. A PRIVATE read: needs the token. | | `state_graph_write` | write | Manage State DAG goals and attempts. Starts only ready nodes; workflow completion is never verification. | | `get_available_models` | read | The INTERNAL model names this deployment serves (`flash`, `pro`, …), their ordered endpoint candidates, and whether each can serve right now. Roles reference these names, never a `provider/model` string — start here before `edit_role`. | | `list_providers` | read | Registered endpoints: base URL, the NAME of the secret each reads, and which models it serves. | | `add_provider` / `update_provider` / `delete_provider` | write | Manage endpoints. `api_key_env` is the NAME of a secret file, never the key. Deleting one a model still uses is refused. | | `add_model` / `delete_model` | write | Create or remove an internal model name. **Order is policy**: calls bind to the first candidate and the rest are failover, so put a pay-as-you-go endpoint LAST. Deleting one something references is refused. | | `map_model` / `unmap_model` | write | Point an internal model at one more endpoint, or take one away. Removing the last candidate is refused — a model resolving to nothing fails at its first call. | | `skillflow_docs_list` / `skillflow_docs_search` / `skillflow_docs_read` | read | Skillflow's own spec for the graph YAML `edit_pipeline` accepts. Read it before inventing a field. | Every run-taking tool names its argument `run_id` and accepts either a run id or a project id (the newest run of that project is used, and the reply names which one). Before 2026-08-26 four of them called it `run` and only some accepted a project id — a call written against the old shape fails validation with the key it wanted, so it is a retry, not a wrong answer. ### Editing needs something to edit Only **generated** (`gen_*`) pipelines are editable and exportable — a built-in config lives in the AItelier repo and travels with it. **A fresh AItelier has no generated pipelines at all**, so on a new install every `edit_*` and `export_pipeline` call correctly refuses, and `list_pipelines` shows only built-ins. Make one with `generate_pipeline`. ## The skill The package ships one skill, `aitelier-pipelines`, at `skills/aitelier-pipelines/SKILL.md`. It teaches the loop below, which tool answers which question when a drive fails, and the failure shapes that pass all three of AItelier's structural gates and only show up on a real run. Install it into a skill root DSH already scans: ```bash mkdir -p ~/.dsh/skills cp -r ~/.dsh/profiles/*/node_modules/dsh-plugin-aitelier/skills/aitelier-pipelines ~/.dsh/skills/ ``` `~/.dsh/skills` (`$DSH_HOME/skills`) is the `user-dsh` root — scanned for every project, no git root required. **The package lives in the PROFILE's `node_modules`, not your project's**: `dsh plugin add` installs into `$DSH_HOME/profiles/`, so a `cp` run from a project directory finds nothing. For one project only, `/.agents/skills/` works too — the project root being the nearest ancestor with a `.git`. **Why this is a copy and not automatic.** A Cordis patch targets a row by id and replaces its *whole* config. Mounting the skill by patching the shared `skill-filesystem` row would therefore overwrite whatever skill roots, watch settings and custom directories you already had. Inserting an isolated provider row instead would need this patch to resolve its own installed directory, and this bundle ships no code to do that with. One `cp` you can see beats a config edit that silently drops your other skills. ## The loop: generate → drive → observe → fix The whole point of the surface. AItelier's own three structural gates check that a generated pipeline is *shaped* right; only running it shows whether it *works*, and that is a judgment loop, not a fixed DAG: 1. **`generate_pipeline("…")`** → a `run_id`. The generator is scheduler-driven, so AItelier advances it; you do not step it. 2. **`wait_for_run`** → it pauses at a design review. Read it, then **`answer_checkpoint`** — approve, or reject with feedback and it revises. On completion the pipeline appears in `list_pipelines` as `gen_`. 3. **`run_pipeline(gen_, seed_text=…)`** — a test drive. Checkpoints are answered for you by default (see below). 4. **`wait_for_run`** → **`get_run_summary`**. A step failed, or the outputs are wrong? **`trace_list(run_id, errors_only=true)`** finds where, **`trace_read(seq)`** shows the actual prompt and response, **`get_step_output`** shows what a middle step wrote. Inside a fan-out, `get_run_summary` names the loop **item** each instance ran for (`{step: t_impl, status: failed, item: health_bar}`) — a loop body runs once per item, plus retries, so without it a failure names a step that ran nine times and you are guessing which task broke. 5. **Fix and go again.** `edit_template` for a prompt (usually the answer), `edit_pipeline` for the graph — consult `skillflow_docs_search` for the schema rather than guessing — `edit_tool` for a tool's code. Or `generate_pipeline(edit_target=gen_, description="the change")` for a surgical regeneration. Then back to 3. 6. **`stop_pipeline`** any drive that is going nowhere, and **`archive_pipeline`** the attempts you abandon. Nothing in that loop steps the pipeline by hand: AItelier's scheduler runs it, and the agent decides at checkpoints and between runs. ## Runs do not block, but waiting does An AItelier run is long and may pause for human approval, so `run_pipeline` returns a `run_id` and nothing else. Then call **`wait_for_run`**: it is push-based and returns the instant the run settles — at a checkpoint OR at a failure, because a watcher that matches only the happy ending sits silently through a crash. It waits at most `timeout_seconds` (default 45) and then returns `status: "waiting"`, `timed_out: true`. That is not a failure — call it again. **The ceiling is your client's, not ours.** A wait longer than `toolCallTimeoutMs` does not wait longer: the client hangs up first and the model sees a transport error instead of "still running". This plugin therefore raises `toolCallTimeoutMs` to 10 minutes (override with `AITELIER_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS`), well above `wait_for_run`'s own default, so the two cannot fight. Use `timeout_seconds: 0` for one look with no wait. A `paused` run is waiting to be answered — **`answer_checkpoint(run_id, decision, feedback)`**, right here. The UI is the other way in, not the only one. (This line used to say DSH could not approve, while the table above listed `answer_checkpoint`; the tool always worked.) An approval carries **no** feedback channel: AItelier refuses `decision: "approve"` with non-empty `feedback` rather than accept text it cannot deliver. To make a demand stick, reject with it — that sends the step back to redo the work against it. ## Authorization Ordinary workflow reads are open. Writes and private State reads require authorization, checked per tool by AItelier itself. This client sends `AITELIER_ADMIN_TOKEN` for direct, off-tunnel connections. The reason it is per tool rather than per path: MCP posts every call, read or write, to the same URL, so AItelier's normal method-based write gate cannot tell them apart. Exempting the path would have left `edit_pipeline` unauthenticated. See `api/mcp_router.py`. Without the token, write tools answer `denied: …` and change nothing. That is a legitimate read-only installation. ## Which API key goes where Two different credentials, two different owners. They do not mix: - **AItelier's LLM key** (`DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`) belongs to AItelier and never leaves it. Its agents run inside its own container and call the model themselves; DSH is only telling them what to do. AItelier reads it from a mounted secret file, deliberately not from the environment, so subprocesses cannot inherit it. - **The credential in THIS plugin's config** is only for reaching AItelier: `AITELIER_ADMIN_TOKEN`. That is the one DSH owns. Both sides follow the same rule — configuration carries a *reference* to a secret, never the secret. `cordis.patch.yml` holds `process.env.AITELIER_ADMIN_TOKEN`, not a token. ## Not included A native `SubagentProvider` (the seat `subagent-codex` and `subagent-claude-code` occupy) is not part of this version. It would let `ctx.subagents.start('aitelier', …)` delegate a whole task and make DSH's own `tool-subagent-control` / `-report` work against it. The blocker is not effort but contract: a one-shot subagent is request → result, while an AItelier run stops at human checkpoints. DSH's *continuable* children (`prepareContinuable` + `followup`) are the right shape for that, and it is worth doing separately.
# AItelier **Structured-but-dynamic subagent workflows for AI agents — your agent delegates work to deterministic, fully-audited pipelines it can generate, run, and edit over MCP.** ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.12%2B-3776AB) [![Engine: SkillFlow](https://img.shields.io/badge/engine-SkillFlow%20(MIT)-F59E0B)](https://github.com/linxuhao/SkillFlow)
AItelier makes multi-agent AI pipelines **deterministic and fully auditable** — define a pipeline (or have your agent generate one), run it, and inspect *why* it did everything it did. The whole surface is exposed over **MCP**, so any MCP-speaking agent can use AItelier as its workflow engine: delegate bulk work to cheap, deterministic pipelines and only decide at checkpoints (see [Use AItelier from another agent](#use-aitelier-from-another-agent-mcp)). Under it all is an open engine ([SkillFlow](https://github.com/linxuhao/SkillFlow), MIT, on PyPI as `skillflow-py`) plus a flagship software-delivery pipeline; the broader no-code **workflow platform** is on the [roadmap](#roadmap). ## Persistent project state, separate from workflow execution AItelier also provides a **State DAG** for long-lived goals, revisioned acceptance contracts, dependencies and evidence. SkillFlow continues to own workflow steps, loops, retries and checkpoints; the driver chooses a ready goal and a workflow. **A completed workflow produces a candidate, not a verified product capability.** The MCP/internal-driver tools `state_graph_help`, `state_graph_read` and `state_graph_write` expose the same typed contracts as `/api/state`. State data reads require writer authorization. Existing DPE pipelines and task/project UI remain compatible; legacy tasks are imported only explicitly and never inherit verified status. See [architecture, usage, trust boundaries and rollout](docs/state-graph.md) and the [offline real-engine demonstration](examples/state_graph_demo.py). The authenticated `send_director_message`, `list_director_messages`, `acknowledge_director_message`, and `resolve_director_message` State actions provide project inboxes with durable delivery events; REST exposes the same closed v2 contract at `/api/state/director-messages/`. The v2 lifecycle distinguishes explicit-inbox `transient` deliveries from `standing` guidance that remains in a bounded, redacted PostCompact recovery projection until resolved. Existing v1 rows migrate as transient without losing their message, delivery, event or idempotency audit. The [State Project frontend and migration preparation guide](docs/state-project-ui-migration.md) covers project DAG browsing, exact-run graph versions, protected historical references and held shadow migration rehearsal. The [project-first dashboard guide](docs/project-dashboard-ux.md) covers the default State DAG workspace, separate Runs/Pipelines navigation, readable node badges and actual run history. ### Wait for state changes and onboard another agent Use `state_graph_read(action="wait_for_state_change", arguments={"project_id": "my-project", "after": 0, "timeout_seconds": 30})` and persist the returned `next_after` cursor. Matching durable events return immediately; unchanged state waits without repeated model-driven queries. Workflow stops and pauses are reconciled into State observations, with bounded recovery for missed notifications. A timeout does not stop a worker, and completion never verifies a goal. Agents can load the MCP prompt `state_graph_driver`, the resource `aitelier://state/driver-guide`, or `driver_guide` from `state_graph_help`. Each State project also has a driver notebook made only of entries: `write_driver_note_entry` / `supersede_driver_note_entry` / `delist_driver_note_entry` write it (every entry is a rule; in-flight state goes to the State DAG - attempts, node holds, issues, node priority - and `force="informational"` is refused), `get_driver_note` returns the index of current entries (`include_superseded=true` adds retired ones), `search_driver_note_entries` searches entry assertions and bodies, and bounded/redacted `search_driver_note_history` plus `driver_note_history` keep the retired free-text sections readable, so different directors manage projects in parallel without sharing notes or event cursors. `wait_for_state_change` keeps its single-project compatibility defaults and adds `filter_mode="any"` for OR-style waits; `note_after_revision` is retired and refused, because the notebook revision no longer advances. See the [agent driver guide](docs/state-agent-driver.md) for external evidence, cursor scope, ownership and handoff rules. The [2.0 release checklist](docs/release-2.0.md) separates implemented features from distribution checks still required before a public release. ### Use State DAG without workflows Your own director, subagents, CI or proof-checking harness can register an external attempt, submit a scoped artifact/report and per-criterion evidence, and verify a node without creating a SkillFlow Run. Workflow and external attempts share the same acceptance and invalidation rules. External completion is still only a candidate. A dedicated authenticated, headless State HTTP/MCP server starts with `python -m api.state_only --db /absolute/private/state.sqlite` and a configured `AITELIER_STATE_TOKEN`; it does not import or start SkillFlow, a scheduler, workspace manager or model registry. The package's install dependencies are not yet split into a separate minimal wheel. See [the integration/standalone guide](docs/state-external-harness.md) and [the real own-harness example](examples/external_harness_demo.py). Design authors can use [lightweight design search and impact](docs/design-search-impact.md) to find exact-version candidates, record direct conflicts and inspect affected bindings. These read-only helpers reuse State revisions/baselines; they do not introduce a solver, vector database or automatic acceptance. Callers of the native UI text observation option can follow the [native UI text facts guide](docs/ui-text-facts.md) for a normal example and its evidence limits. ## Why AItelier Most "AI agent" tooling is built for demos, not trust. The tools that build software or automate a workflow for you are non-deterministic black boxes: you can't reproduce a run, audit *why* the agent did what it did, or insert a human approval where it matters. That's exactly the wall that stops agents from being deployed in anything serious — regulated industries, enterprise, anywhere "it usually works" isn't good enough. AItelier is built on the opposite premise — that an autonomous pipeline should be **trustworthy by construction**: - **Deterministic execution rules** — workflow graphs are traversed by the engine, not control flow improvised by an LLM. Their conditional outcomes may differ and their retry paths may contain cycles; they are not necessarily DAGs. Loops, gates, retries, and recovery are the engine's job. The separate project-state dependency graph is acyclic. - **Minimal LLM surface (least privilege)** — each agent sees only the context it declares, and the [SkillFlow](https://github.com/linxuhao/SkillFlow) engine generates a constrained **write tool per declared output** (and gates reads to declared context) — so an agent *cannot* read or write a file outside its contract. Concretely in the software pipeline: the Researcher can only search the web; every other role can write only its own declared output (a design doc, a plan, a review verdict, or the project README) — and *only* the Implementer's outputs are code. The model makes the judgment calls; the framework and its generated tools do everything deterministic — *brain to brain, tools to tools*. It's also why cheap models suffice: small, focused, role-scoped context. - **Fully traceable** — every run keeps an append-only audit trace that is *never deleted*: each step, prompt, model response, and tool call. "Why did this run do that?" is one query, not forensic archaeology. - **Human-in-the-loop** — approval/reject checkpoints are first-class between stages; review and send work back with feedback at any point. - **Adversarial quality** — every step is produced by a Green (Maker) agent and reviewed by a Red (Checker) agent before it advances. - **Config-agnostic** — a pipeline can be *anything*. Nothing about the engine is hardcoded to one workflow; SkillFlow can even generate a new pipeline from a plain-language description. **Where this sits.** Classic workflow engines are structured but *static* — a human authors the graph, and changing it is a deploy. Autonomous agent swarms are dynamic but *unstructured* — improvised control flow that can't be reproduced or audited. AItelier is deliberately the missing quadrant: **structured but dynamic**. *During* a run the graph is fixed and engine-traversed — gates, retries, and the trace are mechanical. *Between* runs, an agent can generate a new pipeline from a description, drive it, read the trace of what broke, and edit it — all over MCP. Your agent stays the brain; AItelier is the factory floor it can re-tool. ## What you can build > **The vision** (see [Project status](#project-status) for exactly what's built today vs. what's planned). AItelier is meant to be used three ways — the first is the center of gravity: 1. **Give your agent a workflow engine (MCP)** — ✅ *works today.* Point any MCP-speaking agent at the `/mcp` endpoint and it gets the whole surface as native tools: the full **generate → run → observe → fix** loop, checkpoint answering, the trace, model routing, and pipeline export/import. Your agent delegates the bulk work to deterministic pipelines on cheap models and only decides at the checkpoints (see [Use AItelier from another agent](#use-aitelier-from-another-agent-mcp)). 2. **Build your own auditable workflow — just describe it** — ✅ *works today.* Pipelines aren't limited to software. **Describe a workflow in chat** (or over MCP) and AItelier's grounded generator turns it into a real SkillFlow pipeline — provisioning any missing tools, wiring and gating the graph, and registering it to run by name (see [Generate a workflow from a description](#generate-a-workflow-from-a-description)). You can still hand-author YAML directly; a no-code *visual* builder and managed workspaces are on the [roadmap](#roadmap). 3. **Run the flagship software pipeline (DPE) standalone** — ✅ *works today.* Describe a project; it researches, architects, plans, implements, and verifies it end-to-end, with human checkpoints and a complete trace. (That's [See it in action](#see-it-in-action) below — and the proof that the engine holds up under the hardest workload.) **Why software-delivery is the wedge _and_ the keystone.** We lead with autonomous software-building because it's the hardest possible proof the engine works — and because **an AI workflow *is* software** (a pipeline is a graph plus tools plus templates). The same deterministic factory that builds software is what will let you *trust a workflow you build on AItelier* — building a new auditable workflow is itself a software-engineering task. A trusted software pipeline builds trusted workflows. **Open source.** [SkillFlow](https://github.com/linxuhao/SkillFlow) is the engine and is embeddable in *any* agent system; AItelier is the host application around it. Both are MIT (see [License](#license)); a managed multi-tenant platform is on the [roadmap](#roadmap). ## Project status Honest, current state — so nothing here reads as more finished than it is. **Legend:** ✅ Available today (built & tested) · 🚧 Roadmap (designed, not built) · 🔭 Long-term vision | Capability | Status | | --- | --- | | Flagship **DPE software pipeline** — research → architect → plan → implement → verify | ✅ Available today | | **MCP endpoint + DeepSeek Harness plugin** — drive AItelier from any MCP-speaking agent: list / edit / run / export / import pipelines as native tools | ✅ Available today | | Green/Red adversarial review · human approve/reject-with-feedback checkpoints · autonomous goal-loop | ✅ Available today | | Append-only trace + trace API · Git event-sourcing · Rich CLI/TUI | ✅ Available today | | Runs on the [SkillFlow](https://github.com/linxuhao/SkillFlow) engine (durable workflow-graph execution, tools, checkpoints, trace) | ✅ Available today | | Persistent **State DAG** — revisioned goals, dependencies, attempts, evidence, acceptance and driver/API access | ✅ Implemented and tested; private project DAG viewer, no automatic legacy migration | | **Generate a pipeline from a plain-language description** — grounded generator provisions missing tools, wires + gates the graph, registers it to
