# verify-exports-no-dot

A fixture whose `main` names a working module but whose `exports` map has no
`"."` entry, so importing the installed package by its bare name fails with
`ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED`.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.0`

# dsh-plugin-toolkit

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-toolkit)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-toolkit)
[![downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dw/dsh-plugin-toolkit)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-toolkit)
[![CI](https://github.com/WJDdidi-1/dsh-plugin-toolkit/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/WJDdidi-1/dsh-plugin-toolkit/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-plugin-toolkit)](LICENSE)


![dsh-plugin-toolkit](docs/card.png)

English · [中文](./README.zh.md)

Everything a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin needs between `init` and a version the market index accepts: scaffolding, a test harness for the client bundle, a way to see a change without restarting the app, and a release that does not depend on remembering fourteen steps.

```sh
npx dsh-plugin-toolkit@latest init ./my-panel --name my-panel   # a plugin that already passes the checks
npx dsh-plugin-toolkit@latest verify .                          # pack it, install the tarball, mount the panel
npx dsh-plugin-toolkit@latest release --pr --merge              # tag, wait for npm, update the index, open and merge the PR
```

## The panel

![The Plugin doctor tab, on a plugin that fails two checks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WJDdidi-1/dsh-plugin-toolkit/main/docs/panel.png)

The same checks, in the right sidebar: type a folder, an `owner/repo`, or a GitHub link, and it says which one would fail and why. Nothing is installed and nothing is written.

## Three paths

| You are… | Start with | Then |
| --- | --- | --- |
| writing your first plugin | [`init`](#1-write-a-plugin) | `doctor`, `fix`, `verify` |
| changing a panel that is already installed | [`dev`](#2-develop-a-panel) | `mount`, the testkit, `audit` |
| shipping a version | [`verify`](#3-ship-a-version) | `release`, `index` |

It also installs as a plugin. `dsh plugin add dsh-plugin-toolkit` puts a
**插件体检 / Plugin doctor** panel under the conversation and a tab in the right
sidebar. Give it a folder that holds a plugin's `package.json`, or just
`owner/repo` — or a repository name, which it searches GitHub for and lists the
candidates to pick from. It then runs the same checks `verify` runs and says
which one would break the install, with the reason on the line — the same
answers as the CLI, without leaving the app.

```
$ dsh plugin add dsh-plugin-toolkit
```

### 1. Write a plugin

[`init`](#start-from-a-plugin-that-already-passes) writes the files whose absence shows up as a failed first publish — `engines.dsh`, the patch file, a `files` list that ships the code, a client bundle, a test for it, and the CI that runs both. `doctor` then checks the same things without writing anything, and [`verify`](#prove-the-tarball-works-not-just-the-repository) checks the tarball instead of the working copy.

If a plugin already exists, `doctor --fix` turns the failing checks into a
repair plan. It names the file and the edit for every problem, writes nothing
until you add `--write`, and then runs the checks again. `fix --engines` is
still there when the host range is the only thing you need to change.

```sh
npx dsh-plugin-toolkit@latest init ./my-panel --name my-panel
cd my-panel && npm install && npm test && npx dsh-plugin-toolkit@latest doctor .
```

### 2. Develop a panel

A plugin's client code is one file that calls `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({factory})` — there is no module to import, so the usual React test setup does not apply. [`testkit`](#test-a-panel-without-a-browser) supplies the missing half, and [`dev`](#edit-a-plugin-that-is-already-installed) pushes a rebuilt bundle into the running app.

```sh
npx dsh-plugin-toolkit@latest mount ./client.js     # what a user would see, without the app
npx dsh-plugin-toolkit@latest dev . --host http://127.0.0.1:54133
```

### 3. Ship a version

`verify` first (it is the only check that reads the tarball), then `release`, which tags, waits for the registry, writes the index entry with the publish time the registry reports, and — with `--pr --merge` — opens and merges the pull request.

```sh
npx dsh-plugin-toolkit@latest verify .
npx dsh-plugin-toolkit@latest release . --pr --merge
```

## What `verify` actually does

![Five steps, and the failure each one catches](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WJDdidi-1/dsh-plugin-toolkit/main/docs/pipeline.svg)

The order matters. Packing first means the check reads the file list npm will publish, not the folder you have. Installing the tarball means the root is imported by its bare specifier — the package name the loader uses — not by a file path taken from `main` or `exports["."]`. Node ignores `main` once `exports` exists, so a package whose `exports` map has no `"."` entry fails with `ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED` at that step even though the file is present. Mounting means the client bundle is actually executed, in jsdom, with a host that records what it registered.

Each step exists because a plugin once got past the step before it and still installed into nothing.

## Why this exists

Releasing one plugin fifteen times taught me three things the ecosystem's tooling does not cover:

1. **A version is not shipped when npm accepts it.** Registry propagation took two to eight minutes every time. `npm view` answered from a stale local cache, so I repeatedly believed a release had failed when it had not — and once believed it had succeeded when the market still could not see it.
2. **The market index is a second release, done by hand.** Each version needs an entry carrying `publishTimestamp` from the registry and `engines.dsh` from the manifest. Forget the range and the index validator rejects the PR with `Engines mismatch` — after the tag is already public.
3. **Reading a manifest is not the same as checking it.** A plugin can have a valid `package.json` and still be uninstallable: `files` that omit the entry the manifest points at, a bundle patch that does not exist, a README that never states the host range it declares.

The five failures behind these checks — a red dot with no panel, a row the host drops, an app that disables every plugin after one unguarded `apply()`, a tab nothing can open, and a checker that was wrong — are written up with their exact error text and how to reproduce each one: [Five plugins that installed and did nothing](https://github.com/WJDdidi-1/dsh-plugin-toolkit/blob/main/docs/why-it-exists.md).

### Four ways a plugin installs and still does nothing

Each of these shipped in a real version of this toolkit before the check below existed. A manifest check passes on all four.

| What you see | What it was | Caught by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| The tab is a red dot and the panel never opens | `exports["."]` pointed at the CLI, so the loader's row had no plugin to apply | `root export` |
| The plugin is installed, the app never serves it | `dsh.client` declared, `exports["./client"]` missing — the host drops the row | `client declaration` |
| The app says the third-party plugin is unsupported and disables all of them | `apply()` read `ctx.webServer` without declaring it; cordis throws instead of returning `undefined` | `verify` (calls `apply` on a context that has no services) |
| The tab registers, and nothing in the UI opens it | `sidebarRightTabs.register()` registers a *type*; the sidebar lists what `tabs.guide()` returns | a testkit test, not `doctor` |

The first three are static: `doctor` and `verify` catch them without the app running. The fourth is a UI contract, so it needs the panel mounted and the registration inspected — that is what [`testkit`](#test-a-panel-without-a-browser) is for.

## Requirements

- Node.js 18 or newer (the registry is read with `fetch`; no runtime dependencies)
- Git and `gh` on `PATH` for the steps that touch GitHub
- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.0` — the version whose market index carries `engines.dsh`, which is what makes the range check meaningful
- For `testkit`: `jsdom`, `react` and `react-dom` as dev dependencies (`npm install --save-dev jsdom react react-dom`)

## Start from a plugin that already passes

```sh
$ npx dsh-plugin-toolkit@latest init ./my-panel --name my-panel --title "My panel"
created 8 file(s) in /Users/you/my-panel
  .github/workflows/ci.yml
  .gitignore
  README.md
  client.js
  cordis.patch.yml
  index.js
  package.json
  test/panel.test.mjs

next: npm install && npm test && npm run doctor
```

What you get is not a snippet: it is a plugin whose `doctor` already passes (`engines.dsh`, the patch file, the `files` list), with a client bundle that registers a sidebar tab, a testkit test for it, and a CI workflow that runs both. `init` refuses a directory that is not empty unless you pass `--force`, and refuses a name npm would refuse — those are the two mistakes that cost the most time later.

Every command that takes a path expands a leading `~` before touching the filesystem. The tool, not the shell, expands `~` for these arguments: `cmd` and PowerShell pass `"~/my-panel"` through literally, while a POSIX shell usually expands it first. `init '~/my-panel' --name my-panel` writes into your home directory (the same files `init ~/my-panel` writes on a POSIX shell), and `doctor '~/my-panel'` reads it back. The Windows spelling `~\my-panel` works too; a directory literally named `~` is never created.

## Where it lives

The checker is docked **under the conversation**, above the input bar: a single
row, collapsed by default. Open it and it carries the whole guide — who it is
for, how to use it, what each check means, and what it cannot tell you — plus
the folder field and the results. The same panel is also a **Plugin doctor** tab
in the right sidebar, for when the conversation is busy.

The panel speaks both languages and opens in Chinese; the 中文 / EN switch sits
in the dock's header row (and in the sidebar tab) and the choice is remembered.

Look at it without the app:

```sh
node scripts/preview.mjs /tmp/panel.html   # collapsed, open, with a result, and the tab
```

## Test a panel without a browser

A plugin's client code is one file that calls `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({factory})` — there is no module to import, so the usual React test setup does not apply. `testkit` supplies the missing half: a DOM, the real React, and a host context that records what the panel registers.

```sh
npm install --save-dev jsdom react react-dom
```

```js
import { mountClient, createFetch } from 'dsh-plugin-toolkit/testkit';

const panel = await mountClient({
  file: 'client.js',
  copy: { 'my-plugin': { title: 'My panel' } },
  fetch: createFetch({
    '/my-plugin/report': { body: { score: 71, noise: 3 } },
    '/my-plugin/apply': () => ({ status: 201, body: { score: 92 } }),
  }),
});

await panel.click('[data-testid="optimize"]');
console.assert(panel.text().includes('92'), 'the score on screen did not move');
console.assert(panel.must('[role="status"]').textContent.includes('92'));
await panel.unmount();
```

`unmount()` is async: it lets React finish the work its own unmount schedules before the DOM goes away. Skipping the `await` surfaces as `ReferenceError: window is not defined` *after* the test has already passed, which is a confusing way to learn it.

What you get back: `text()`, `html()`, `query(selector)`, `must(selector)` (throws with the rendered HTML when it misses), `click(selector)`, `type(selector, value)`, `press(selector, key)`, `focus`, `attributes(selector)`, `snapshot(dir, name)` for a normalised DOM baseline, and `host` for assertions about what the bundle registered.

### Keep a visual baseline

The DOM is the baseline: normalising class order and whitespace gives a file that fails for the reasons a screenshot would — a lost label, a control that stopped rendering — and can be reviewed in a diff instead of by eye.

```js
import { expectSnapshot } from 'dsh-plugin-toolkit/testkit';

const panel = await mountClient({ file: 'client.js' });
expectSnapshot(panel.html(), '__snapshots__', 'panel');   // throws with the element that moved
await panel.unmount();
```

First run writes nothing: it tells you to re-run with `UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1`, so a baseline is always a decision, never a side effect. That rerun writes the normalised HTML and returns `{ status: 'written' }`; later runs return `same` or fail with the element that moved.

### Check what assistive tech sees

```js
panel.expectAria('[role="tab"][aria-selected="true"]', { label: 'Protection', selected: 'true' });
assert.match(panel.must('[role="status"]').textContent, /Score moved 71 → 77/);
```

`expectAria()` compares the attributes a screen reader actually reads — `role`,
`label`, `live`, `selected`, `expanded`, `checked`, `pressed`, `disabled` — and
names the one that differs:

```
[aria-live="polite"]: expected aria text to be "9", but it is "0"
```

A missing attribute is reported as `nothing`, not as an empty string, because
those are different bugs. `panel.aria(selector)` returns the same object when you
want to assert on it yourself.

`must()` throws with the rendered markup when the selector misses, which is the difference between "the assertion failed" and "here is what the user actually got".

Every example below is a file in this repository, run by CI, and the output shown is the output it prints:

| Example | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| `node examples/mount-a-bundle.mjs` | mount a real bundle, read the text, click, read it again |
| `node examples/route-stubs.mjs` | answer the routes a panel asks for, and assert on the requests |
| `node examples/baseline.mjs` | a DOM baseline compared on every run |
| `node examples/aria.mjs` | what assistive tech sees |

```sh
$ node examples/mount-a-bundle.mjs
Demo panel Count 0 0
Demo panel Count 1 1
```

```sh
$ node examples/route-stubs.mjs
Score 71
asked for: 1 route(s), undeclared route answers 404
```

To look at a bundle by hand:

```sh
npx dsh-plugin mount ./client.js            # print the text a user would see
npx dsh-plugin mount ./client.js --html     # print the markup
```

That is how the AIignore panel was checked before release: the real bundle, mounted in Node, against a stubbed `/aiignore/*`:

```
$ npx dsh-plugin mount ../ai-context-doctor/plugin/client.js
AIignore No workspace yet Could not read the report …
```

## Put the badge on a plugin that passes

If `verify` passes on your plugin, this badge says so and links back here:

```md
[![checked with dsh-plugin-toolkit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WJDdidi-1/dsh-plugin-toolkit/main/docs/badge.svg)](https://github.com/WJDdidi-1/dsh-plugin-toolkit)
```

It is a claim, not a decoration: add it only when `dsh-plugin verify .` exits 0.

## Start from the example

[`dsh-plugin-example`](https://github.com/WJDdidi-1/dsh-plugin-example) is a ~70-line plugin: one sidebar tab, two languages, one behaviour test, CI that runs `verify` through the composite action. It is the shape this toolkit expects, so it is also the fastest way to see whether the toolkit fits your plugin. It is a GitHub template too: **Use this template** starts you on a plugin whose first publish already passes.

```sh
dsh plugin add dsh-plugin-example
```

## See what is installed, and what the app loaded

`doctor` checks one folder you name. The question that actually gets asked is
"why is my plugin not in the sidebar?", and the answer needs three things at once:
what is installed, whether each installed copy is valid, and which of them the
running app actually loaded.

```sh
$ dsh-plugin audit --host http://127.0.0.1:54133
dsh-aiignore           0.37.1    loaded       ok
demo-panel             0.3.0     not loaded   ok  — dsh.profile.bundles in /Users/me/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json does not list it, and the loader mounts only listed bundles
                                            fix: add "demo-panel" to dsh.profile.bundles in /Users/me/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json (or run `dsh plugin add demo-panel`), then restart the app

1 installed plugin(s) are not in the running app:
```

"Not loaded" has three different causes, and `audit` names the one that applies
instead of offering a blanket restart:

- **Not in `dsh.profile.bundles`.** `pnpm add` (or `npm install`) installs the
  package but does not tell the loader to mount it. Add the package name to
  `dsh.profile.bundles` in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json`, or run
  `dsh plugin add <name>`, then restart the app.
- **No `dsh.bundle`.** The package declares `dsh` but no patch file to mount.
  Add `dsh.bundle.patch` to its `package.json` and ship the patch file, then
  reinstall.
- **Listed, but the app predates the install.** The profile is already correct;
  restart the app once to read the new list.

Advisories (`engines.dsh`, README Requirements) are counted apart from problems:
the market index needs them, the loader does not, so they should not bury a plugin
that is actually broken.

`audit` exits `1` when an installed plugin has a hard failure **or** when the
running app did not load at least one installed plugin, so CI can gate on a
profile where the app silently skipped a plugin. It exits `0` when every
installed plugin is loaded and valid. If no graph was read (`--host` omitted),
the loaded column is `?` and only hard failures change the exit code.

Without `--host` the loaded column is `?`, because guessing would be worse than
saying nothing. Only packages that declare a `dsh` field are audited — the rest of
`node_modules` is ordinary dependencies, and auditing those is noise.

An installed package whose `package.json` cannot be read is the exception: the
`dsh` field that would mark it as a plugin is in the file that failed to parse.
If its name is still in `dsh.profile.bundles`, `audit` reports a `manifest`
failure naming the unreadable `package.json` and exits `1` instead of treating
the folder as an ordinary dependency. A truncated manifest from an interrupted
install therefore cannot make the plugin disappear from the report, and a valid
sibling plugin is still listed on the same run. The exception stays narrow: a
damaged `package.json` in a package that is neither in `dsh.profile.bundles` nor
readable enough to expose a `dsh` field is still an ordinary dependency and is
skipped, so one broken transitive install does not fail every audit.

A declared bundle can also be missing entirely. If a name stays in
`dsh.profile.bundles` after its `node_modules/<name>` folder is removed (an
interrupted install, or a package deleted by hand), `audit` prints a `missing`
row with an `install` failure naming the absent folder and exits `1`, while
still listing the healthy plugins on the same run. An absent package that the
profile never declared is not an install record, so it is not invented in the
report; a regression test removes the name from the profile and requires the
shipped CLI to exit `0` without printing it.

## Edit a plugin that is already installed

The host already swaps a rebuilt bundle without a page reload: it watches each plugin's entry artifact and reports a `rebuilt` frame on `/plugins/events`. `dev` puts the new file where the host is looking, then **proves** the frame arrived instead of asking you to check by eye.

```sh
npx dsh-plugin dev . --host http://127.0.0.1:54133
```

![dsh-plugin dev printing the revision the app reported](docs/dev.gif)

*Recorded from a real run against the running app: the last line is the revision the app sent back on `/plugins/events`, not a message the tool printed on faith.*

```
demo-aiignore: /work/plugin/client.js -> ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-aiignore/client.js
initial: copied 163647 bytes at 1:18:43 AM
reloaded dsh-aiignore (rev e0c0230c4fc9)
watching /work/plugin
```

That last line is the whole point: the revision came back from the app's own event stream, so "it reloaded" is a fact, not a hope.

A plugin the running app never loaded cannot be reloaded, and the app says so by leaving it out of the graph it sends first. `dev` reads that graph, so a freshly installed plugin gets the sentence that fixes it instead of a timeout:

```
copied, but not confirmed: the running app has not loaded demo-panel, so it will not report a reload; restart the app once after installing it
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--dest <dir>` | write into this installed copy instead of searching `~/.dsh/profiles/*/node_modules/<name>` |
| `--entry <file>` | copy this file instead of `dsh.client.entry`, `client.js`, `lib/client.js` |
| `--build <command>` | run this before each copy (a failed build copies nothing) |
| `--host <url>` | confirm the reload against the app at this URL; without it the copy still happens and the tool says it is unconfirmed |
| `--once` | copy once and exit, for scripts |

Two things it does not do, because the host does not: React state inside the reloaded plugin is lost, and a failed swap does not roll back to the previous bundle.

## Use it in CI

The same checks run as a GitHub Action, so a tag cannot go out on a plugin that would not install:

```yaml
- uses: actions/checkout@v4
- uses: WJDdidi-1/dsh-plugin-toolkit@v1
  with:
    dir: plugin        # the folder holding the plugin's package.json
    command: verify    # pack it, install the tarball, mount the panel
```

`verify` is the default because it is the only check that reads what a user
actually installs: `doctor` reads the working copy, so a `files` list that
forgets `client.js` passes it and fails only after `npm i`.

`command: doctor` stops at the manifest checks (fast, no install), and
`command: index` audits `market/index.json` instead, failing on any version whose
`engines.dsh` is missing or is not a semver range (a malformed value such as
`>=banana`, or a single pinned version such as `0.2.0`, both fail). Pin
`version:` if you would rather not track the latest release.

## Check a plugin you have not cloned

The panel takes three kinds of input: a folder, `owner/repo`, or a GitHub URL.
A bare name is a search, not a guess — it asks GitHub, lists the matches with
their stars, and checks the one you pick. A repository is downloaded once as a
tarball into a temp folder, so nothing is cloned into your workspace and
nothing is installed.

The CLI reads a repository straight from the GitHub API:

```bash
dsh-plugin doctor --remote V1ki/dsh-plugin-subscriptions
```

```text
dsh-plugin doctor: 1 problem(s) in V1ki/dsh-plugin-subscriptions
  ⨯ engines.dsh: engines.dsh is missing, so a host that enforces the range rejects the install as "incompatible with dsh"; declare the range you support, e.g. "engines": { "dsh": ">=0.2.0" }
```

That is the whole reason this mode exists: the plugin hub files failed installs
back into plugin repositories, and the report is a sentence — `plugin install
failed`, `plugin does not support the DSH version in use` — that never names a
file. Reading `package.json` over the API is enough to name it.

What it can see, and what it cannot:

- Manifest checks (`engines.dsh`, `dsh field`, `files`, `dsh.client`,
  `exports`) run on the real `package.json`.
- README checks (`readme`) run on the text GitHub serves: the README must have
  a `Requirements` heading and must state the host range `package.json`
  declares. A repository whose checkout fails `readme` fails the remote check
  too, with the same sentence.
- File checks (does `exports["./client"]` point at a file that exists, does the
  root export `apply`) need the tree. A package that runs `prepack`,
  `prepublishOnly`, `prepare` or `build` publishes files it does not commit, so
  those checks are **skipped with a note** instead of calling a working plugin
  broken.
- Public repositories work anonymously, but GitHub allows 60 requests an hour.
  Export `GH_TOKEN` (or `GITHUB_TOKEN`) to audit more than one or two.

To check a whole list in one pass, put one `owner/repo` per line in a file and
pass it with `--from` (`-` reads standard input):

```sh
$ dsh-plugin audit --remote --from repos.txt
```

Repositories are read four at a time by default. `--jobs N` changes that width;
values above `8` are capped at `8`, and `--jobs 1` walks the list one repository
at a time, the timing the command had before batching. The output — and the
`--json` array — still follows the input list, and every verdict is the one the
sequential run produced, so a diff between two runs compares repositories rather
than scheduling.

When GitHub answers `403` or `429`, the shared quota is gone, so the batch stops
starting new repositories and marks every entry it could not read as
`rate-limited` instead of `clean` or `unreadable`. If the response carries
`x-ratelimit-reset` (or `retry-after`), the reset time is printed with the
verdict, and the remaining entries are reported without another request.

### Will this plugin install on my DSH?

The eight compatibility reports, from four repositories, all end with the same
question. Add `--host <version>` to a remote audit and it answers that question
for one repository. This is the output for `L3n3L/dsh-resume`, a real plugin
whose declared range stops before DSH 0.2.0, checked against the
`0.2.2-alpha.3` canary from the reports. The checked-in sample is a frozen 0.1.3
snapshot, so the line stays true as the upstream repository changes:

```sh
$ dsh-plugin audit --remote L3n3L/dsh-resume --host 0.2.2-alpha.3
incompatible  L3n3L/dsh-resume  0.1.3 (host >=0.1.0-rc.6 <0.2.0-0) [incompatible with dsh 0.2.2-alpha.3; declares ">=0.1.0-rc.6 <0.2.0-0"]

summary: 1 repository — 0 clean, 1 failing (1 problem), 0 unreadable, 0 rate-limited
```

The verdict comes first: `incompatible` means the range in `package.json` does
not accept the host, so the installer rejects the plugin before it unpacks it.
This run exits `1`. The same answer is reproducible without a GitHub request:
the checked-in snapshot under `examples/compatibility-sample/` keeps the 0.1.3
manifest fields that decide compatibility, and its `## Requirements` heading
isolates the host-range answer. This command feeds that snapshot through the
real CLI path:

```sh
$ node scripts/compatibility-sample.mjs
```

(`npm run compatibility` runs the same script.) The test suite runs that
command and compares its output with the block above, so the sample cannot
drift from the formatter or from the README. Running
`dsh-plugin audit --remote L3n3L/dsh-resume --host 0.2.2-alpha.3` without the
sample audits the repository's current default branch instead; a README or
manifest change since 0.1.3 can add another `readme` or manifest failure to the
same row.

The line carries the range `package.json` declares and one of `compatible`,
`incompatible`, or `unknown` against that host version. `unknown` is the honest
answer for a missing or malformed range — there is nothing to compare — while a
range that excludes the host is `incompatible`, counted as failing, and exits
`1`. npm's pre-release rule is part of the answer: `>=0.2.0` does not accept
`0.2.2-alpha.3`, because a range only opts into a pre-release when it names one
of the same `major.minor.patch`. A canary host can therefore be `incompatible`
with a range that will accept the final release. The same flag works in the
batch mode, so one `--from` run answers the whole list:

```sh
$ dsh-plugin audit --remote --from repos.txt --host 0.2.2-alpha.3
```

The compatibility flags are `--remote <owner/repo>` for one repository,
`--from <file>` for a list (`-` reads standard input), `--host <version>` for
the DSH version to compare against, and `--json` for the machine-readable
finding. `--jobs <n>` sets the batch width, and `--patch-dir <dir>` writes the
host-targeted repair for each repository that needs one. The help text lists
the same flags; a test fails if this section names a flag the CLI does not have.

`--host` still names the running app URL for a local `audit`; on `--remote` it
is the DSH version to compare against. With `--json`, each finding gains
`host` and `compatibility` beside `hostRange`.

Each repository gets one line with its verdict — `clean`, `failing`,
`unreadable`, or `rate-limited` — and the run ends with a counted summary:

```text
clean         demo/plugin  1.2.3 (host >=0.2.0)
failing       demo/broken  — engines.dsh: engines.dsh is missing, so a host that enforces the range rejects the install as "incompatible with dsh"
rate-limited  demo/blocked — GitHub rate-limited this request (403) for package.json; set GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN to raise the limit; the limit resets at 2026-11-04T20:00:00.000Z
rate-limited  demo/next    — GitHub rate-limited the batch before this repository was read, so it was not requested; the limit resets at 2026-11-04T20:00:00.000Z

summary: 4 repositories — 1 clean, 1 failing (1 problem), 0 unreadable, 2 rate-limited
```

The parenthesised count is the number of failed checks, not the number of failing
repositories: one repository that fails both `engines.dsh` and its client
declaration prints `1 failing (2 problems)`. A repository whose `package.json`
has an empty `dsh` field and no `dsh.bundle.patch` is `failing` here too: the
batch runs the same `dsh field` check as `doctor`, and the `--json` finding
carries that failure even though no patch path was declared to check. A README
with no `Requirements` heading is treated the same way: the batch asks the same
`readme` question as a checkout, so the row is `failing`, the `--json` finding
names `readme`, and the run exits `1` instead of reporting the repository clean.

The command exits `1` when any repository is failing, unreadable, or
rate-limited, and `0` only when every repository in the list is clean. `--from`
also accepts the JSON evidence shape (an array, or an object with `rows`) that
the old shell loop printed, s

English · 简体中文

## Project overview Next steps is a plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). When a turn finishes, it reads the conversation, asks the session's own model what you would plausibly send next, and offers up to three prompts you can accept with one click. It costs one short model call per qualifying turn. It never sends anything on your behalf. **Who it's for.** DSH users on the web client — the desktop app or `dsh web` — who have just read an answer and still face an empty composer; and anyone who works in `/skill` prompts, since a suggestion can be a real invocation to edit rather than one to write from scratch. **The problem.** Every finished turn restarts from a blank composer with no natural continuation point; standing up a second provider just for suggestions is not worth another API key or bill; and generic suggestions are worse than typing, so a suggestion has to have actually read the conversation. **Main features.** - **Chips above the composer.** Three numbered prompts, one click away. Hover or keyboard-focus a chip to read its full prompt in a tooltip; clicking one writes it into the composer as a draft — edit it, then press Enter yourself. Regenerate the row in place for a fresh set, or dismiss it when it is not what you wanted. - **Suggestions that know the session.** The model sees the last ten human and model messages, and — when enabled — the session's skill catalog, so a suggestion can be a real `/skill` prompt rather than generic advice. Prompts come back in the language you were already using. - **No provider to set up.** Suggestions run on whatever model route the session already uses, so there is no second API key and no extra bill to reconcile. ## What it looks like

The moment a turn ends: three numbered prompts, right where you type. Press one and it lands in the input box as a draft; nothing is sent until you press Enter yourself. The row also carries a regenerate control, so a set that missed the mark can be replaced without waiting for another turn. ## Install Requires DSH with the web client — the desktop app, or `dsh web` — and `pnpm` on your `PATH`. **Desktop app.** Clone the repository, then install the bundle from **Settings → Plugins** and point it at the cloned folder. The installer accepts an absolute local path, an npm package (for example `@zongcn/dsh-next-steps`), a git URL or a tarball. **`dsh web`.** Install the published package: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @zongcn/dsh-next-steps ``` Or install from a clone, which links the checkout: ```sh git clone https://github.com/WURONZON/dsh-next-steps.git dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD/dsh-next-steps" ``` `dsh plugin` runs pnpm inside the profile directory; because this package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, the manager also records it in that profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`. The npm install pins a published version; a clone installs as a local link, so pulling or editing the checkout is enough before the next reload. The desktop profile belongs to the app and refuses the standalone CLI, which is why it takes the settings path. **Reload.** A newly added bundle is applied by the profile's HMR; replacing an installed copy needs a restart. Suggestions regenerate on a session's next completed turn. **Uninstall.** Remove the bundle in **Settings → Plugins**, or run `dsh plugin --profile web remove @zongcn/dsh-next-steps`, then restart. **Re-installing a renamed or re-linked package.** Toggling the plugin off and on in **Settings → Plugins** only flips its entry in `dsh.profile.bundles`; it does not re-run pnpm, so the dependency keeps the key it was installed under. After renaming the package, or after pointing the desktop app at a different checkout, remove the plugin and install it again — the installer keys the dependency to the target's `package.json` name, and a `link:` dependency keeps the name it had at install time. A stale key fails the next boot with `: import failed (see console for the import error)`, and the browser half then reports `client-modules: duplicate factory registration`.
Installing by hand A profile is a `package.json` under `$DSH_HOME/profiles/`, and a bundle loads only when it is both a dependency and listed in `dsh.profile.bundles`. ```json { "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["…", "@zongcn/dsh-next-steps"] } }, "dependencies": { "@zongcn/dsh-next-steps": "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-next-steps" } } ``` Add both fields, run `pnpm install` in that directory, restart.
## Configure it Options live in `cordis.patch.yml`, under the bundle row's `config`: ```yaml - insert: - id: dsh-next-steps name: '@zongcn/dsh-next-steps' config: maxSuggestions: 3 minAnswerChars: 80 ``` | Option | Default | What it does | | --- | --- | --- | | `enabled` | `true` | Turn suggestion generation off entirely. | | `maxSuggestions` | `3` | Upper bound on suggestions per turn. | | `minAnswerChars` | `80` | Skip turns whose answer is shorter than this (measured on the last assistant message, after cleaning, capped at 1,800 characters). | | `suggestSkills` | `true` | Tell the suggester which skills the session has, so a suggestion can be a `/skill arguments` prompt. | | `maxInputChars` | `12000` | Skip a turn whose transcript exceeds this many characters. | | `timeoutMs` | `30000` | Cancel one suggestion call after this long. | | `maxOutputTokens` | `1600` | Output budget of the suggestion call. A reply that hits the budget still keeps every suggestion that closed before the cut. | Values are shallow-merged over the defaults and are not type-checked, so write numbers as numbers and booleans as booleans. ## How it works

Two halves ship as one bundle: - **Host half** (`index.js`). Listens for a `turn/end` event with a `completed` reason, builds a digest of the last ten human and model messages, and calls the route recorded for the session — falling back to the newest logged request header, then the process default. The reply is parsed as JSON, cleaned, and kept in memory, keyed by session. - **Browser half** (`client.js`). Registers the band above the composer, polls `POST /api/next-steps/state` every 2 s for the current session, and renders with the host's theme tokens and locale service. Aborted, blocked, errored and interrupted turns are ignored, as are subagent sessions. The plugin appends nothing to the session log: suggestions are a derived, in-memory cache that disappears when the plugin unloads, and a hot reload starts empty. ## Safety Model output is treated as untrusted. Before anything reaches the screen or the prompt box, terminal escape sequences, control, format, private-use and unassigned characters, variation selectors and Unicode tag characters are stripped, whitespace is folded, combining-mark runs are capped, and every label and prompt is length-limited by code point. A suggestion is sanitised text, never markup. The plugin serves only the two local state routes it needs, and it never submits a prompt. ## Limits - Every qualifying turn costs one model call, and so does each press of Regenerate. Raise `minAnswerChars` or `maxInputChars` to spend fewer. - One conversation at a time: suggestions live in the band, so there is no overview of other sessions. - `/skill` suggestions are not checked against the session's command catalog, so a suggested command that no longer exists has to be edited before it is sent. - Suggestions are per session and per process. They are not shared between windows or restored after a restart. ## Development ```sh npm test # 33 host checks + 13 dock checks, no dependencies, no browser node scripts/selftest.mjs # host half only node scripts/verify-dock.mjs # browser half: the composer band, driven by a React stub node scripts/verify-ui.mjs # optional Playwright run against a live GUI (see the script header) ``` **Releasing.** The full release checklist — version bump, CI, npm publish, GitHub Release, and clean-profile verification — lives in [English](RELEASING.md) and [简体中文](RELEASING.zh-CN.md). The source is small enough to read in one sitting: ```text index.js host half: turn/end listener, model call, parsing, state routes client.js browser half: composer band, i18n, styles cordis.patch.yml bundle row and its default config locale/ English and Chinese plugin metadata assets/readme/ the SVG sources for the images above scripts/ selftest.mjs, verify-dock.mjs, verify-ui.mjs ``` ## Credits A port of `next-steps` from the [Claude plugins community](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-plugins-community/tree/main/next-steps) (MIT), rebuilt on DSH services as a band above the composer. ## License [MIT](LICENSE)

# @tpcowork/dsh-archives

ZCode-style archive management for TP Cowork. Archived sessions leave the sidebar (tpcowork-ui hides DSH's
"show archived" filters), and **Settings › Data & Statistics › Archive management** lists them by workspace with
search, sort by updated or created time, and a project filter. Each session can be unarchived or deleted, each
workspace group has "Unarchive all" and "Delete all", and the page header deletes everything that matches the
current filters. Deleting asks for confirmation and reports succeeded, failed and skipped counts, as ZCode does.

Above the list, ZCode's auto-archive card has two settings, both stored in this plugin's config (`cordis.patch.yml`)
and read live:

- **Auto-archive old sessions** (`autoArchive`, off by default as in ZCode).
- **Archive retention** (`autoArchiveDays`): 3, 7, 14 or 30 days, default 30. Despite its name, this is the idle time
  before a session is archived. Nothing is ever deleted automatically.

While the switch is on, the Host scans at start, every 5 minutes, and right after either setting changes (the page
calls the `rescan()` Remote). It archives sessions whose last activity is older than the period. It skips pinned,
running, blank and subagent sessions, and also sessions loaded in this run, so a conversation that is open is never
archived out from under the user.

**Workspaces work as ZCode's projects: there is no 未分组.** DSH lists sessions that belong to no workspace under
未分组 (a removed workspace's sessions among them), and adding the same folder again starts an empty workspace. In ZCode a
conversation shows only under its project, a removed project's conversations leave with it, and adding the folder back
shows them again. Nothing is deleted either way.

- `hidden()` on the `archiveManager` Remote returns every session in no workspace, except archived sessions (archive
  management lists them) and subagent sessions. The Client (`src/removed-workspaces.ts`) puts them in a virtual
  sidebar group, which takes them out of 未分组, and draws neither that group, its rows, nor the 未分组 section, in the
  grouped and the flat list. Sessions another plugin's group shows, such as 定时任务, stay in that group.
- The Host watches the Workspace table (`domain/changed`). When a workspace is created, and for every workspace at
  start, the sessions in no workspace whose folder (compared by real path) is the workspace's folder are attached to it
  through DSH's `attachSession`, which checks each session's own stored folder. So adding a removed folder again brings
  its conversations back, including ones removed before this feature existed. Scheduled runs (`automation-…` sessions)
  and subagent sessions are never attached.
- The "删除工作区" confirmation's last sentence, DSH's "其会话将显示在'未分组'下", is replaced with
  "其会话会随工作区一起隐藏，重新添加此文件夹即可恢复".
- Differences from ZCode: DSH asks before every removal, so there is no separate prompt for a workspace with a running
  conversation, and such a conversation keeps running in the background instead of being stopped. A session whose folder
  has never been added as a workspace (for example one created outside TP Cowork) is reachable only by adding its folder.

- **Client** (`src/client.tsx`): reads the Workspace archive set and Session list live, and unarchives through the
  Workspace service.
- **Host** (`src/host.ts`): the `archiveManager` Remote and the auto-archive scan. `list()` returns the archived sessions still stored with
  their creation times; `remove(ids)` deletes each still-archived session and its subagent sessions through
  `sessionPersistence.delete`, then tells clients the session left the list.

DSH keeps an opened session loaded until the app quits, and storage refuses to delete a loaded session. Such a
session is hidden at once and queued in `$DSH_HOME/tpcowork/archives-pending-delete.json`; its files are removed
the next time the app starts, unless it was unarchived meanwhile.

```bash
node build.mjs              # type-check, then bundle lib/host.js and lib/client.js
node build.mjs --typecheck
npm test
```

Expanded archive groups follow the supplied ZCode reference: one light-gray rounded list, inset row separators, a single-line semibold title with an independently spaced timestamp, and right-aligned delete/unarchive actions. Rows have a 70px minimum height; longer titles ellipsize while preserving their full title tooltip. The disclosure button names and controls the list. Preview: `artifacts/archive-settings/expanded-list.png`. The list test covers disclosure, restore, and explicit delete confirmation.

# TP Cowork

基于 DeepSeek Harness 的桌面办公助手。底座由独立 fork 维护，产品能力通过外部插件扩展 DSH 原生会话、任务、权限和凭证功能。

| 插件 | 职责 |
| --- | --- |
| [core](plugins/tpcowork-core/README.md) | 产品身份、助手角色、模型配置 |
| [UI](plugins/tpcowork-ui/README.md) | 品牌、主题、布局、首页 |
| [workbench](plugins/tpcowork-workbench/README.md) | 文件交付与任务收尾 |
| [browser](plugins/tpcowork-browser/README.md) | 内置浏览器与桌面桥接 |
| [toolbox](plugins/tpcowork-toolbox/README.md) | 技能、MCP、团队管理及可选 Step 搜索 |
| [automation](plugins/tpcowork-automation/README.md) | 自动化模板、定时任务和运行记录 |
| [memory](plugins/tpcowork-memory/README.md) | 按工作区保存跨会话记忆，默认关闭 |
| [archives](plugins/tpcowork-archives/README.md) | 设置 › 归档管理：按工作区查看、取消归档和删除已归档会话 |
| [usage](plugins/tpcowork-usage/README.md) | 设置 › 使用统计：按本地会话记录统计 Token、活跃度和模型用量 |
| [computer-use](plugins/tpcowork-computer-use/README.md) | 设置 › 电脑控制：参照 ZCode，让 Agent 按应用授权查看并操作 Windows、macOS 桌面应用（Linux X11 实验） |
| [diagnostics](plugins/tpcowork-diagnostics/README.md) | 脱敏的 Host 与桌面日志文件；设置 › 通用设置 › 诊断信息导出诊断包（参照 DSH Desktop） |
| [experts](plugins/tpcowork-experts/README.md) | 专家协作，复用原生任务与子会话 |

## 本地运行

需要 Node.js 24 或更新版本，并将 `deepseek-harness` 底座仓库放在本仓库的同级目录。在 `tp-coworkdsh` 内执行一条命令即可：

```sh
npm run dev
```

`npm start` 也可启动。`npm run dev` 会根据两个仓库自上次构建以来的 git 改动自动判断：只改了插件就只重建插件，改了底座就连底座一起重建，没有改动就直接复用已有构建启动——日常不需要再区分 `dev:plugins` 和 `dev:rebuild`。首次运行或缺少产物时会自动准备，可能需要联网下载和完整构建。已有桌面程序运行时，先完整退出再启动。

`npm run dev:plugins`、`npm run dev:rebuild` 仍可手动强制重建（分别只重建插件、或完整重建底座和插件），用于绕过自动检测或排查构建问题。两者都不会重新启用已关闭的插件。

默认复用底座的 `apps/desktop/.desktop-build/development/home` 数据目录；`DSH_HOME` 可指定其他目录。初始化复用原生 Desktop 方法，保留已有会话、凭证和个人设置。`npm run dev -- --plan` 可只查看启动步骤。

## Windows 安装包

进入本仓库 **Actions → Build Windows Installer → Run workflow**，使用默认 `standalone` 模式即可构建 Windows x64 独立测试包。构建及安装验证成功后，默认同时上传 Actions Artifacts 并发布 GitHub 预发行版，可下载安装包、SHA-256 和构建记录；取消 `publish_release` 则只上传 Artifacts。

详细设置、构建模式及本地命令见 [Windows 云端打包操作](docs/windows-github-actions.md)。

## Linux 安装包

进入 **Actions → Build Linux Packages → Run workflow**，由 Ubuntu 22.04 x64 Runner 构建并校验 AppImage 和 DEB，生成 SHA-256 和构建来源记录。默认同时上传 Actions Artifacts 并发布 GitHub 预发行版；取消 `publish_release` 则只上传 Artifacts。操作、参数和麒麟实机验证范围见 [Linux 云端打包](docs/kylin-linux-github-actions.md)。

麒麟上排查启动问题时，选择 `variant=basic` 构建 **TP Cowork Basic**：排除全部 TP Cowork 产品插件，保留底座默认界面，使用独立的应用数据目录，并验证 AppImage 和 DEB 的真实图形窗口启动。基础版发布在 `linux-basic-packages-<version>`，附带启动诊断脚本。

Linux 默认选择 `variant=standard` 构建 **TP Cowork Linux**：在已验证基础版上恢复其余 10 个产品插件，排除浏览器和 Computer Use 的自动化实现，单独保留界面缩放与诊断导出所需的通用桌面能力。工具箱保留自己的 Chromium 和离线 Python 依赖。该版本使用独立数据目录，发布在 `linux-standard-packages-<version>`，并验证真实窗口、产品界面、记忆、归档、统计和工具箱页面；`full` 仍可构建全部 12 个插件。

安装包、登录欢迎页、系统菜单、关于窗口和应用图标统一使用 TP Cowork 品牌；Windows 构建和本地启动自动准备品牌资源，品牌图片使用 `plugins/tpcowork-ui/icon.png`。

Windows 顶栏“应用”菜单不显示“检查更新”和“管理 dsh 命令”。

## 源码目录

两个仓库放在同一个父目录下：

```text
项目父目录/
  tp-cowork/          本仓库，本地目录名可以是 tp-coworkdsh
  deepseek-harness/   https://github.com/wyx2014/deepseek-harness
```

产品代码推送到本仓库 `main`；底座改动推送到 fork 的 `feat/tpcowork-workbench-ui`。Actions 同时检出两个仓库，安装包内记录各自的 commit。

`npm run dev:rebuild` 统一完成底座和插件构建。单独管理已初始化桌面的插件可使用 `node scripts/desktop-plugin.mjs install all`。检查源码和依赖链接使用 `node scripts/check-worktree.mjs`。

运行所需模型和 MCP 凭证由应用内的 DSH 凭证服务管理；本地凭证、会话、缓存及编译产物不提交到 GitHub。

# TP Cowork Automation

外置 Cordis 插件 `@tpcowork/dsh-automation`。提供 Host 管理、持久化、唯一调度器、任务页/编辑器、六个模板、独立 AgentLoop 执行、运行会话清理和全局通知。完整安装组合支持显式、可恢复的原生调度移交；首次安装、更新、禁用、卸载与离线 kit 见 [OFFLINE.md](OFFLINE.md)。原生系统通知的真实投递与可信点击仍须按交付记录单独核验。

## DSH 界面与桌面接入

自动化的功能和交互参考 `nanobot-gui/src/components/schedule`，视觉遵循当前 DSH：复用主题颜色、字体、圆角和控件尺寸，页头与插件页使用相同的标题层级及内容边距，任务与模板采用 Zcode 风格的双列卡片，包含两行指令摘要、调度及下次运行标签、运行次数；卡片不显示时区，整张任务卡可进入编辑，悬停或键盘聚焦时显示操作。顶部为任务和运行记录双页签，任务卡显示执行规则、下次运行和运行次数，项目通过首页同款菜单选择，已有技能/MCP 绑定在编辑后保留。未读按钮定位到该任务最新的未读运行，提醒仍须明确确认；侧栏显示未读圆点。六个模板仅填写草稿。新建/编辑页参考 Zcode：面包屑、设置/历史页签、单栏任务标题/调度/指令，指令框上方使用首页同款项目选择按钮和弹出菜单，底栏选择权限、模型和思考强度；不提供“更多设置”，已有描述、执行方式、工作目录、技能和 MCP 配置继续保留。“添加计划”先选频率，再在同一行修改时间、星期或月日，时区自动采用本地设置，页面无需手填，编辑页的历史只显示当前任务，切换页签保留草稿。界面适配中英文、深浅主题和窄窗口，调度与执行均由既有 Host 服务负责。

桌面初始化后，完整退出应用，在工作区根目录执行下列命令，再打开桌面，即可从侧栏“自动化”进入：

```sh
node plugins/tpcowork-automation/build.mjs
node scripts/desktop-plugin.mjs install automation
```

新建任务支持助手执行和纯提醒，频率支持一次、每小时、每天、每周、每月、工作日、自定义 Cron/间隔及手动。聊天创建的简单五字段 Cron 在卡片和编辑页回显为对应频率与时间（例如 `0 9 * * *` 显示为每天 09:00）；仅修改标题、指令等内容会保留原始 Cron，明确修改调度时才保存表单中的新规则。复杂 Cron、秒/年份字段和间隔仍使用自定义编辑器。助手任务每次创建独立 DSH 会话，结果从运行记录打开；纯提醒不调用模型。任务只在应用运行且电脑保持唤醒时执行。安装不更改模型配置或导入源 GUI 数据；发现已有原生提醒时，页面要求明确确认移交后才启用新调度器。

未选择项目且执行目录留空时，助手任务使用 DSH 的默认工作目录；已有任务中保存的空目录同样适用。无项目的运行会话在侧栏「定时任务」虚拟分组中显示，绑定项目的会话保留原项目归属。分组从 Session 中既有的运行所有权记录投影，不依赖任务保留的最近20条运行，也不创建占位项目；升级后只读补齐旧运行的投影，重启后仍可识别。聊天区域直接显示原始任务指令，右上标注时钟及「由定时任务发送」，不再显示通用执行请求折叠条。

底栏通过既有 `session.modelCatalog` 和 `permissionPresets.catalog` 读取运行选项，`modelSelection`（含可选思考强度）和 `permissionPreset` 随任务保存，每次运行时应用到新建的会话。未选择时沿用现有默认行为；选择“跟随默认”会清空任务覆盖值。不会修改 DSH 的全局默认模型或权限。

## 状态同步与结果通知（子任务08）

`src/changes.ts` 定义只读 `automationChanges/watch(signal)`，经既有 Typert Gateway 流载体输出 `{type:'ready'}` 和 `{type:'changed',change:{revision,taskId,runId?,reason}}`。订阅在 ready 前建立；多次失效可以合并，客户端每次重新读取 Host 目录，不把事件或 revision 当作运行结果。revision 仅属于一次 Host 激活，重启归零仍能重新读取。`src/remote.ts` 同时注册 Host 和 Client 描述符与取消参数，包含十个 automation 管理方法；bindings、任务数据及持久化版本不变。接收者由 Host 插件自身 Context 持有，Client 断开或 Host 停用均结束订阅。

`src/run-monitor.ts` 与 `src/ui.tsx` 在插件生命周期内共用一个 `AutomationCatalog`，不依赖任务页挂载。Host 推送、Connection reset 和两秒刷新共同同步状态；异常结束的只读流会重新建立。刷新期间的失效会丢弃旧响应并补读，写入期间的失效等待写入后补读，已知 viewedAt 只取较大值，不恢复 Host 已移除的行。编辑器草稿保持独立。

首次成功目录只建立终态基线，不弹历史通知。后续按 runId 去重 completed/error，running/run_bound 不通知，已读终态不再通知；重连、Host revision 重置、离页及临时移除不清空去重集合。结果只以系统通知告知，不在页面内绘制 Toast；通知点击选择 schedules 下的指定 task/run 详情，不创建 Session。none 详情等待明确确认；once reminder 的确认移除任务和记录，循环提醒保留已读历史。目标已不在最近20条记录中时显示记录已移除。

桌面应用中经 `dshDesktop.notifications` 由主进程显示原生系统通知（参照 ZCode：任一应用窗口聚焦时不显示，同一运行三秒内去重，点击先恢复并聚焦窗口再打开详情）；Windows 安装版以安装器快捷方式的 AppUserModelID 投递。普通浏览器中回退到 Web Notification，仅在现有权限为 granted 时尝试，不请求或修改系统权限。设置 › 通用中的“任务通知”开关同时控制自动化结果与会话通知。Client 卸载清除刷新定时器、订阅、通知点击订阅及原生处理器；Host 停用也会唤醒并结束等待中的订阅。数据仍由 Host 保留。

`tests/run-monitor.spec.ts` 和 `tests/transport.spec.ts` 覆盖终态去重、初次失败后基线、旧读/推送/写入竞争、已读单调、两秒离页刷新、晚响应、真实 Gateway 流与双端卸载。`tests/sync-browser-smoke.mjs` 验证构建产物的真实 Host/Client Gateway、JSON 存储、HTTP 流、跨页系统通知（页面内以桥接桩记录）、第二客户端已读/删除、断线和 Host 重开；外层 layout 是夹具。`--electron` 额外要求真实原生 show 事件；`--native-click` 还要求120秒内发生可信系统点击，并验证窗口由失焦转为聚焦及准确的 task/run 详情（同一任务含多条运行），none 仍须显式确认。本机 Electron 43 主进程仍返回 `Notifications are not allowed for this application`。成员已授权开启 Electron 通知，但 macOS 拒绝 osascript 辅助访问，无法操作系统开关及横幅；历史08交付曾因该缺口 blocked；当前状态与复验结果以 TPCO-10-delivery.md 为准。需人工开启通知并点击，或取得辅助功能访问后复验；未更改系统权限。

```sh
node plugins/tpcowork-automation/tests/sync-browser-smoke.mjs
node plugins/tpcowork-automation/tests/sync-browser-smoke.mjs --electron
node plugins/tpcowork-automation/tests/dsh-regression.mjs
```

## 构建和验证

在工作区根目录执行。需要已经构建过的 `deepseek-harness`、Node 22.19+ 或 24，以及该工程已有的 TypeScript、esbuild、Vitest 和 Zod。

```sh
npm ci --prefix plugins/tpcowork-automation --ignore-scripts --legacy-peer-deps --no-audit --no-fund
node plugins/tpcowork-automation/build.mjs
node plugins/tpcowork-automation/build.mjs --typecheck
node deepseek-harness/node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config plugins/tpcowork-automation/vitest.config.ts
node plugins/tpcowork-automation/tests/artifact-smoke.mjs
```

构建输出 `lib/host.js`、`lib/client.js`、`lib/types.js`、`lib/schemas.js`、`lib/remote.js` 和 `lib/types/*.d.ts`。Host 为 ESM；Client 为 DSH `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` 工厂，不在 Node 中直接导入。根 tsconfig 只组合 Host/Client 两个编译面。Zod 和 Croniter 兼容实现随构建内联，许可证放在 `lib/licenses`；DSH 服务使用宿主已有实例。运行时不依赖 Python、cron-parser、Luxon 或 sibling 源工程。

## 服务与持久化

加载包根入口后提供 `ctx.automation`，依赖 `storageDomain` 和 `typert`。`cordis.patch.yml` 只插入本插件。Host 组合等待现有 agents、agentLoop、sessions、sessionPersistence、sessionQuery、workingDirectory、workspaceRegistry、agentDefaultModel 和 tools 服务就绪后自动注册 DshAutomationExecutor；服务不足时仍可管理定义，但 enabled=false。域名为 `tpcowork_automation`，版本为 1，表名为 `tasks`；存储位置由宿主的 storage-domain 路由决定，例如 JSON 后端下的 `tpcowork_automation.json`，不按客户端目录另建数据库。

每次变更串行执行，校验整个任务记录，等待后端持久化后再更新可读状态并发出通知。读取返回独立快照；写入失败保持旧状态且不发出成功通知。JSON 语法、版本、记录类型、任务键、运行归属、重复运行、状态、会话关联或结果可用性有误时，加载失败并返回 `automation/invalid_persistence`，保留原数据。采用 storage-domain 默认的拒绝策略，不使用 backup-and-skip，不把损坏记录替换成空库。

卸载停止新请求和计时器，撤销 Gateway 接口，向执行器发出 AbortSignal，等待已准入操作、执行器、已排队写入和通知结束，然后关闭域句柄；定义及运行历史不删除。Host 退出后不执行任务。重新加载读取原数据及已读时间。完整 patch 以 `nativeTakeover:true` 启用原生移交；直接挂载管理服务不进行移交。两者均不修改模型、凭证、默认模型或用户配置。

## 共享入口与接口

共享定义由 `src/types.ts` 拥有，消费者导入包的 `./types`；JSON 校验导入 `./schemas`。后续任务增加模块而不另建一份任务类型。共享入口、Host/Client 入口及协议变更由主任务协调者统一整合。

Host 和 Client 都提供 `AutomationServiceApi`。所有成功调用返回 `{ tasks, status: { enabled, jobs, next_wake_at_ms } }`。任务列表按创建时间降序，运行列表按实际写入顺序最新优先。`enabled` 表示唯一 Host 调度器及真实执行器已就绪；执行器缺失、恢复中或正在撤销时为 false。此时仍可保存定义和计算 nextRunAt，但没有执行计时器，`runNow` 返回 `automation/runtime_unavailable`。`next_wake_at_ms` 是持久化计划的最早目标，不代表未就绪服务会执行任务。客户端不计算执行计划。

| 方法 | 参数 | 源 `src/core/api.ts` 行为对应 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `list()` | 无 | `fetchScheduleTasks`，全量定义与历史 |
| `create(request)` | `AutomationCreateRequest` | `createScheduleTask`，返回完整目录；新增 ID 可通过返回目录比较取得 |
| `update({ id, data })` | `AutomationUpdateRequest['data']` | 完整表单字段；projectId/modelSelection/permissionPreset 省略保留、null 明确清空、具体值替换；非 manual 编辑后启用，manual 编辑后暂停 |
| `delete({ id })` | 任务 ID | `deleteScheduleTask`，删除定义和历史，不删除已有 Session；运行中拒绝 |
| `pause({ id })` | 任务 ID | `pauseScheduleTask`，撤销后续计划；当前运行继续，已完成的一次性任务保持 completed |
| `resume({ id })` | 任务 ID | `resumeScheduleTask`，Host 重新计算下一时间；manual 无自动目标，过去的 once 不补跑 |
| `runNow({ id })` | 任务 ID | `runScheduleTaskNow`，允许手动执行暂停任务；返回准入后目录，不等完整执行结束 |
| `markRunViewed({ taskId, runId })` | 精确运行 ID | `markScheduleRunViewed`，终态记录的已读时间只设置一次；一次性纯提醒确认后删除整个任务，与源网关一致 |
| `stopRun({ taskId, runId })` | 精确运行 ID | 将运行记录结算为 `run_interrupted`，再请求取消并释放调度；即使 Agent 忽略取消，任务仍可重新执行或删除，晚到结果不改写已结算记录 |
| `deleteRun({ taskId, runId })` | 精确运行 ID | `deleteScheduleRun`，运行中拒绝；先清理显式专属 Session，再删历史；清理失败保留记录供重试 |

两个客户端字段 `runId` 与 `id` 对新运行始终相同。不导入 nanobot-gui 的旧任务、会话或设置，也不隐式读取原生 Schedule 的历史。`totalRuns` 与源 API 相同，是当前保留的记录数，最多 20，删除记录后递减。

项目清空使用更新请求专属的 `projectId:null`，可穿过 JSON/Client Gateway/Host Gateway；Host 在写入前转为无绑定。`AutomationUpdateRequest.data` 在完整草稿基础上允许 projectId、modelSelection、permissionPreset 使用更新专属的 null 清空标记，共享 updateSchema、Host 和 Client 校验一致。省略 projectId 保留旧绑定（包括当前不可用的项目），显式 ID 替换；直连 Host 显式传 undefined 的旧清空行为保留。创建输入、ScheduleTaskDraft、ScheduledTask 和持久化 schema 仍为可选 WorkspaceId，不接受 null，存储版本不变。客户端完整编辑表单在选择“无项目”后发送 null；其他消费者更新项目时须遵守上述三态语义，不能依赖 JSON 保留 undefined。workspacePath 是独立表单字段，清空项目不会清空用户显式目录。

## 聊天工具与纯提醒

默认 Host 组合在 tools、agents、workingDirectory、workspaceRegistry 就绪后注册唯一 `cron` 工具及当前 Turn 监听，卸载时撤销。它直接调用同一个 `AutomationServiceApi`，不注册调度器或执行器。参数根保持普通对象，仅 action 必填，各动作条件由工具检查。

- `add`：message 和 mode 必填，mode 为 reminder 或 task；at、every_seconds、cron_expr 恰好一项。名称默认 message 前 30 字，description 可选。原始 Cron 五/六/七字段及宏直接传给共享服务，不变成每日。
- `at` 为一次日期；无偏移时按 Host 本地时区，DST 折叠/缺口沿源 ZoneInfo 默认 fold=0 解析；带偏移按绝对时间保存。重复须由用户明确要求，并额外设置 `repeat:true`；一次日期拒绝 repeat=true，Cron/间隔缺少 repeat=true 则拒绝。tz 只用于 Cron，省略为 Host 时区。
- `list` 返回同一用户目录的 ID、模式、规则、状态、下次执行及公开绑定；不调用原生 Schedule，也不列出其内部任务。`remove` 使用 list 返回的 job_id，经同一删除接口处理。
- 继承真实创建 Session、原始项目及当前有效目录；现有任务模型是单一 skillName，因此绑定最近一次仍可用的用户技能调用。MCP 从当前 Agent 可见的工具公开命名空间提取，最多 8 个；不读取配置、凭证或任务说明中的绑定。DSH 当前工具 schema 没有结构化 server identity，含多个 `__` 分界的歧义命名拒绝创建，并提示通过表单明确绑定，避免猜错连接器。
- 防递归仅覆盖当前未结束的自动 Turn，依据该 Turn 内真实的 `tpcowork-automation` 消息来源。分支只有在继承切点对应父 Agent 当前未结束的自动执行上下文时才继承限制；Turn 开始时捕获该上下文，持续到分支自己的 Turn 结束，即使父 Turn 先完成也不能中途递归创建。Turn 结束后，用户正常后续消息、恢复聊天及完成历史的分支均可创建明确授权的任务。持久化归属/来源记录保留供终态恢复与安全清理，不作为永久限制；准备失败、从未启动自动 Turn 的会话也不会仅因归属记录而限制首次用户 Turn。子 Agent 原有禁止创建边界继续保留。任务名称和提示词不影响判断，list/remove 沿源工具保持可用。
- reminder 沿用现有执行器直接结束为 `resultType=none`、`conversationAvailable=false`，不调用模型、不创建 Session。通知入口为持久化后的 `automation/changed(reason=run_finished)`，通知模块读取共享目录确认终态；原生投递验收仍受系统应用权限限制。
- 界面在 none 结果上调用 markRunViewed 确认，不打开聊天；一次提醒删除任务，循环提醒只写 viewedAt。Client facade 串行本端写入；list 等待已发起的写入，并在等待期间有新写入时重新读取，防止确认前的过期响应恢复任务/未读。此屏障与只读变更订阅互补，所有最终状态仍取自 Host。

```json
{"action":"add","message":"提醒喝水","mode":"reminder","at":"2030-01-02T09:30:00+08:00"}
{"action":"add","message":"研究项目变更并生成报告","mode":"task","cron_expr":"*/15 9-17 * * MON-FRI","tz":"Asia/Shanghai","repeat":true}
```

## 源字段对照

基线为 nanobot-gui `0873ca240ac72ed7678341e360cc96855227f646` 的 `src/types/schedule.ts`、`src/stores/scheduleStore.ts` 和 `src/core/api.ts`。运行与确认/删除语义同时核对了对应 nanobot 网关的 schedule_routes 和 CronService。

| 源字段 | 本插件定义及验证 |
| --- | --- |
| `ScheduleFrequency` | once/hourly/daily/weekly/monthly/weekdays/custom/manual 八项保持一致 |
| `ScheduleConfig` | frequency/at/time/dayOfWeek/dayOfMonth/timezone/cronExpression/everyMs 保留；源 API 顶层 timezone 优先，归一化存入 schedule.timezone；once 创建/编辑须为未来 ISO 时间；custom 只能提供一个选择器 |
| 预设默认值 | hourly 只使用 minute，hour=0；其余默认 09:00；weekly 默认周一；monthly 默认 1 日；省略时区在 Host 保存时明确解析成本机时区 |
| 自定义规则 | 按源 Croniter 6.2.4 默认选项验证和计算五/六/七字段：分、时、月日、月、周日、秒、年；年范围 1970–2099；支持范围、步进、名称、L、l5、#、W、?、随机 R、宏及月日/周日 OR；无 hash_id 的 H 与源相同返回错误。正整数 everyMs 按当前时间锚定 |
| `name/description/prompt` | 名称和指令 trim 后不能为空；描述可为空；表单编辑未提供描述时清空 |
| `skillName/workspacePath/mcpPresets` | 保留技能、目录和最多 8 个唯一连接器的公开元信息；表单编辑省略这些源字段时清空，凭证字段不在 schema 内 |
| `status` | 任务 active/paused/completed；manual 新建为 paused；once 执行结束后 completed |
| 时间及历史 | createdAt/updatedAt/lastRunAt/nextRunAt/runs/totalRuns 保留，时间为 epoch 毫秒；最多一个 running，保留最新 20 条 |
| `ScheduledTaskRun` | id/runId/scheduledTaskId/conversationId/sessionKey/startedAt/completedAt/status/error/viewedAt 保留；新增显式 sessionId/turnId/ownsSession/trigger/scheduledAt/executionMode/errorCode/skippedReason |
| `resultType/conversationAvailable/unavailableReason` | 新运行必填前两项；SessionId 本身不代表结果可打开。会话可用时 Session 别名一致；纯提醒只返回 none；无结果原因保留 legacy/missing |
| 项目与来源扩展 | projectId 使用 DSH WorkspaceId；originSessionId 为不可变创建会话，运行 Session 独立；表单与工具共享同一服务 |
| 内部 skipped | 持久化 skippedReason，公开 status 映射为 completed；不丢失跳过原因 |

类型保留源字段，新增记录使用更严格的显式 ID/可用性约束。Cron 表达式保留原文，不移动秒字段或改写宏；宏包括 @midnight/@hourly/@daily/@weekly/@monthly/@yearly/@annually。随机 R 在每次重新计算时重新选值，与源行为一致；校验本身不消耗随机数。完整范围和 DOM/DOW 特例也按源实现处理，例如六/七字段的数字周日 7 会被当前源版本拒绝，不能用另一个解析器默认规则替代。

`src/cron.ts` 将源日历搜索及 DST 定位转为 TypeScript，`src/recurrence.ts` 是所有频率的唯一下一时间计算入口。月度 31 日跳过短月，闰日遵循日历；DST 不存在时间及重复时间遵循源行为。求不到下一项（年份耗尽、50 年搜索上限或日历无解）返回无目标，与源 `_compute_next_run` 的 None 一致；语法或时区无效返回明确错误。IANA 时区数据来自宿主 Intl，若宿主与参考 Python 的 tzdata 版本不同，历史或新修订时区规则可能存在平台差异。

## Host 执行适配器

包根默认入口现为组合插件：加载命名导出的 `AutomationService`，再通过 Cordis inject 加载 `AutomationScheduler`。仅调度器调用 `attachRuntime`，子任务03不得再注册第二个 Runtime。独立管理服务仍可用于单元测试。九个 Gateway/Client 方法、任务持久化版本及表名均保持不变。

`src/executor.ts` 的 DshAutomationExecutor 已由组合插件自动注册，先完成证据恢复再启用调度；自定义精简组合可单独使用命名导出的 AutomationService 和 AutomationScheduler，自行在 Cordis effect 内注册唯一执行器。接口示意：

```ts
ctx.effect(async () => ctx.automation.attachExecutor({
  async execute({ task, run, signal, bind }) {
    // 分配独立 DSH Session；启动前 await bind({ sessionId, turnId, ownsSession: true })。
    // Session flush 并可查询后，再 await bind({ sessionId, turnId, ownsSession: true, conversationAvailable: true })。
    // 复用当前有效模型、权限和 Agent。监听 signal，中断后必须停止工作并结束此 Promise。
    // 等待真实 turn/end 与 Session flush，再返回显式结果：
    return { status: 'completed', resultType: 'conversation', conversationAvailable: true }
  },
  async recover({ task, run, signal }) {
    // 根据 run.sessionId / run.turnId 查询持久化终态，找到则返回 AutomationRunOutcome。
    // 查询成功但没有终态时返回 undefined；查询失败应 throw，不能当作“没有终态”。
    return undefined
  },
  async dispose() { /* 释放执行器自身的监听和资源 */ },
}))
```

上例是接口示意，必须由真实 DSH 实现替换后才注册，不能直接返回成功。新增 Host 类型为 `AutomationExecutor`、`AutomationExecution`、`AutomationRecovery`、`AutomationRunOutcome` 和 `AutomationClock`。执行器只负责执行及证据查询，调度器独占准入、历史结算和下一时间计算。运行配置使用准入后的独立快照，executionMode 固定为开始记录的模式；结算读取任务最新规则。未知抛出错误使用安全的 execution_failed 文案，不将上游原始异常或凭证写入历史；受控错误可在 outcome 中返回脱敏说明。

执行器注册先查询未结算记录并重新计算后续目标，再启用计时器。interval 按当前时间重新锚定，过去 once 不补跑；不追补停机的全部周期。醒来处理当前到期项，按 nextRunAt 升序串行等待执行完成；每次准入都在持久化队列内重新核对到期目标，暂停、删除或编辑已排队任务不会误启动。手动触发独立准入，不等待另一任务的完整执行；同任务的并发准入只成功一次。失败执行结束后计算正常下一周期，不立即重试。最长休眠五分钟以应对系统唤醒；客户端计时器仅刷新状态。

调度器的 `runNow` 先调用 `beginRun` 持久化开始记录，再安排执行并尽快返回；暂停任务也可手动运行。`beginRun({ taskId, trigger, scheduledAt? })` 原子拒绝重入；scheduled 触发现在必须携带当前且已到期的 scheduledAt。分配独立 DSH Session 后，通过 execution.bind 持久化关联；其内部仍调用既有 `bindRun`。首次绑定默认仍为 resultType=none，不能根据 ID 推断会话；只有显式 conversationAvailable=true 才原子发布 conversation、conversationId/sessionKey/sessionId 一致的可用结果，执行中也可打开和跟随。纯提醒禁止发布会话，已绑定的 Turn 不可更换。turnId 是该 Session 的 `turn/start.data.turn` 数字，不是 Session ID 或消息 ID。不得声称拥有创建会话或其他已关联运行的 Session。

真实终态确认后，执行器返回 outcome，调度器调用既有 `finishRun`。`status` 接受 completed/error/skipped，skipped 必须有 skippedReason。`completedAt?` 用于恢复时保留原 turn/end 的时间；resultType/conversationAvailable 始终显式提供。服务在串行结算内按当前规则计算 nextRunAt，覆盖过期快照；暂停任务和 manual 不会被重新启动。旧 `finishRun.nextRunAt?` 只在未装入 Runtime 的测试/兼容场景下作兜底。结束调用幂等，不覆盖已结算记录及已读状态。单纯消息投递、followup 或 Agent 一次 idle 不能当作执行成功。

DshAutomationExecutor 的 recover 使用 SessionPersistence 只读 handle 查询保存的 sessionId/turnId 及专属归属记录。SessionQuery 的冷查询会在内存补出 interrupted 闭合事件，恢复不把这些合成事件当作持久化终态。调度器优先按证据修复 running；查询成功但没有终态且超过 24 小时，标记 error/errorCode=run_interrupted、resultType=none。较新的未知运行保持 running 并禁止重入，每次唤醒继续查询。证据查询失败时不误报成功或中断。禁止自动重放外部操作。开始写入失败时不调用执行器；结束写入失败时保留 running，等待上述恢复。执行器未确认终态 flush、终态回查、会话可用性发布或释放 Agent 时抛出内部 AutomationEvidencePendingError，调度器同样保留 running，不以未知结果提前结算。

撤销执行器先关闭准入和计时器，再 abort、等待所有执行和恢复调用结束，最后调用 executor.dispose；旧执行器尚未完成清理时拒绝替换。卸载调度器还会释放唯一 Runtime 和监听。正常取消保存 run_interrupted；进程崩溃留下的记录通过 recover 修复。可注入 AutomationClock（包插件选项 `{ clock }` 或 Scheduler 构造参数），持久化时间和计时器使用同一时钟。`recomputeSchedules()` 在服务写入队列内计算，避免启动/恢复与 CRUD 覆盖；`getTask()` 是准入后供执行器获取独立快照的 Host 内部接口。

真实执行每次分配随机唯一 Session，并沿用准入时已有的 runId。先持久化 Session/Turn=1 关联，再通过 ctx.agents.create 创建全新无 seed、无 parentSession 的顶层 Agent；从现有默认 Agent preset 挂载工具和权限，不复制来源会话上下文。Session.header.cwd 保留 task.projectId 对应项目的目录，workspacePath 只通过 workingDirectory.set 改变有效执行目录；显式项目已不存在时直接失败，不回退到其他项目。项目没有绑定时使用任务目录或 DSH 默认工作目录。运行中的会话通过 DSH SessionQuery 和现有 Session-follow 流读取，完成后释放自己的 live Agent，保留 Session 供普通历史查询和继续会话使用。

运行模型来自创建会话当前有效的持久化选择（pending model/selection 优先于最近 request/header，忽略适配器默认的 effort），来源缺失或没有选择时使用 agentDefaultModel.currentSelection()。在新 Agent 的创建期安装固定模型选择并持久化 model/selection；后续默认变化只影响下一次运行。执行器从不调用 saveSelection，也不修改模型来源、凭证或用户默认设置。技能通过当前 Agent scope/cwd 的 skills.get 读取并以 DSH skill-invocation 上下文注入；MCP 名称必须对应当前 Agent 可见的 mcp__<name>__ 工具命名空间，复用现有连接及权限，不从任务元信息创建连接或携带密钥。不可用的技能、MCP 或项目返回受控失败。

成功必须有本次专属记录、准确 turn/start、该 runId 的已入模 user/message 和对应 completed turn/end，并通过 Session flush 与持久化只读回查。其他 Session/Turn、消息仅入队、idle、被拒绝的零步 turn、blocked、max-tokens、模型错误或中断都不算成功。aborted/interrupted/forked 映射 error/run_interrupted，其余非成功终态为 error/execution_failed；历史只保存固定脱敏说明，不复制上游异常文本。纯提醒直接完成为 none，不分配 Session 或调用模型。

专属归属证据为 Session 的 ignorable 记录 plugin:tpcowork-automation/run，保存 version=1、taskId、runId、sessionId、turnId=1、可选 projectId/originSessionId。包根导出 readAutomationOwnership(events) 和 AutomationOwnership，前者只接受唯一且位于首个 turn/start 之前的合法记录。子任务05清理时还必须拒绝 seeded/parent Session，并核对 header.id、任务/运行/会话 ID、来源会话及其他运行关系；ownsSession 单独不是删除授权。缺失、重复或无效的记录须拒绝清理；记录是插件可忽略数据，丢失时不能放宽归属校验。默认 Host 组合同时注册唯一 DshAutomationSessionCleanup；清理不改变归属标记或防递归行为。

会话删除模块通过 `attachSessionCleanup` 注册 `deleteRunSession(task, run)`，返回异步卸载函数。模块可实现 `dispose()` 停止准入并等待已开始操作，旧模块拆卸完成前不允许替换；Host 卸载同样等待清理。Host 先拒绝 running，重新检查所有任务的来源及其他运行引用；只有清理成功才持久化删除历史。共享旧记录（ownsSession=false）仅删除记录。ownsSession=true 仍须读取真实 SessionPersistence header/events，验证唯一合法且早于首个 Turn 的归属记录、taskId/runId/sessionId/turnId、不可变创建来源与可用项目的真实 header.cwd，拒绝 seeded、parent、继承前缀及外来会话。任务编辑后的项目按运行归属记录捕获的项目校验。

通用接口为 `SessionPersistence.delete(id, { expectedRevision, signal? })`。插件先 stat 捕获修订号，再只读检查并关闭句柄；后端在进程内认领和已有内核写锁内核对版本，拒绝活跃/恢复中的 Session 及校验后的并发写入。活跃会话通过 `automation/session_cleanup_failed` 明确提示关闭后重试；其他清理失败同码保留记录，I/O 故障不能当作缺失。真实缺失可幂等完成，已删会话但记录提交失败时可在重启后再次删除。

桌面实际使用的 JSONL 后端同时支持 raw 与 Zstandard：先持久化 session.deleted，再移除所有规范日志代际，保留稳定 session.lock 与删除标记以阻止旧代际恢复和身份复用。清理中断可重试；查询索引在下一次查询时对照持久化删除，冷查询缓存先 stat 校验；`session-persistence/deleted` 等待 Workspace 清除成员、置顶、归档及 header/path 缓存。历史恢复通过写锁打开，已删除 Session 返回缺失。其他继承默认实现的后端明确返回 SessionDeletionUnsupportedError，未宣称支持。删除针对会话日志；独立附件/spill 归其现有服务管理，不递归删除项目目录。

## 通知和错误

每次持久化成功发出 Host `automation/changed`，含本次 Host 激活内递增 revision、taskId、可选 runId 和 reason。理由包含 created/updated/deleted/paused/resumed/run_started/run_bound/run_finished/run_viewed/run_deleted/rearmed。通知不带指令、连接器密钥或凭证；监听失败不会撤销已提交变更或阻止其他监听者。后续通知模块负责将该事件加入 Gateway 转发，客户端启动及重连先 `list`，轮询只刷新状态，并用 store 的变更代数丢弃晚到响应，参照源 scheduleStore。

Host 业务错误是 `RemoteError`，`code` 为 `automation/<错误码>`，details 为空。错误码：invalid_input、invalid_timezone、invalid_rule、invalid_persistence、storage_failure、task_not_found、run_not_found、task_running、run_running、runtime_unavailable、service_stopping、run_interrupted、session_cleanup_failed、execution_failed。Client 参数使用共享 schema；Host Gateway先验证 JSON 安全，再由服务方法验证输入，保证业务错误码不被通用 Gateway 校验错误替代；结果在两端均有 schema。Gateway 连接、撤销和非 JSON 参数错误保留其原有 `gateway/*` 错误码。

## 任务页面与编辑器（子任务06）

`src/ui.tsx` 在宿主 `main` / `sidebar.panellist` 的 `schedules` 位置以 priority=-20 注册自动化页面；TP UI 发现该入口后撤销原生标题适配，保留一个自动化入口。卸载撤销页面、侧栏贡献、字典和样式。浏览器构建从 ModuleLoader 取得宿主 React 和共享 ui-primitives，样式使用 DSH 主题变量，中英文文案由宿主 locale 管理。迁移提示和确认复用此页面，经 `automationMigration/migrate({confirm:true})` 调用 Host；目录 `status.migration` 返回等待、恢复或完成状态及过期一次任务 ID。

`src/AutomationPage.tsx` 提供任务/运行记录双页签、任务卡片、空态、请求失败重试、新建、暂停/恢复、立即运行及任务删除确认，不提供卡片内展开记录树。任务删除说明明确保留已有结果 Session。一次任务仅在 completed 且最新运行成功并已读时从任务页归档；历史页读取全部任务历史。打开结果要求 resultType=conversation、conversationAvailable=true 和明确的 conversationId；none 结果仅确认已读。运行页使用紧凑表格，直接跳转结果会话，并提供确认已读和删除记录。

`src/AutomationEditor.tsx` 使用 Zcode 风格的面包屑、设置/历史页签及单栏表单；编辑时右上角提供保存、立即运行及任务菜单，历史页只保留任务菜单。立即运行先验证并保存当前草稿，成功后执行且保留编辑页；保存失败不执行。任务菜单支持暂停/恢复和删除，暂停/恢复保留未保存输入。项目选择位于指令框上方，使用首页相同的 Menu、文件夹图标、选中标记、主题材质及键盘操作，支持“不绑定项目”；底栏提供权限、模型和思考强度。编辑器不提供“更多设置”，不再请求隐藏选项的 bindings 目录；已有描述、执行方式、技能、MCP 和目录仍随草稿完整保存。只在打开时复制草稿；两秒全局客户端刷新只读取 Host 目录，不执行或重算调度，不覆盖未保存输入。`AutomationCatalog` 合并同一代未结束的读取、丢弃写入前的旧响应及卸载后的响应。项目来自 `ctx.workspaces.list`，项目 ID 和可覆盖的 workspacePath 独立保存；频率支持 once/hourly/daily/weekly/monthly/weekdays/manual/custom，新建空白任务须先添加计划，保留原始 at 精度、custom cronExpression/everyMs 及其他已有 custom 参数。一次日期按任务保存的时区转换为绝对时间，新任务自动使用本机时区，页面不显示时区控件；拒绝 DST 缺口，重叠时间选较早实例；后续触发时间全部交给 Host。选择项目时将执行目录更新为该项目目录，解除项目绑定时保留独立执行目录；不可用项目显示提示并保留原 ID，只有明确选择“不绑定项目”才解除。

`src/automation-templates.ts` 直接迁移参考提交 0873ca240ac72ed7678341e360cc96855227f646 的六个中英文模板及真实提示词；选择模板只填草稿，取消不写 Host，保存才创建。“让助手创建”调用宿主 `uiWorkspace.startSession(undefined,{prompt,clearPreviousDraft:false})`，保留已有聊天草稿，通过现有聊天工具完成创建。

新增只读接口为独立 namespace `automationBindings/list({workspacePath?})`，返回 `{skills:[{name,description}],connectors:[{name}],skillsAvailable}`，不改变 automation 管理方法、任务 schema 或持久化版本。`src/bindings.ts` 在默认 preset 的临时 scope 中读取宿主公开技能注册表和工具 schema，不创建 Agent/Session，不加载技能正文，不读配置或凭证。只列出可人工调用的技能，MCP 按现有工具的无歧义 `mcp__server__tool` 命名提取；有额外 `__` 的名称无法可靠还原 server identity，目录不猜测，已有绑定由任务草稿保留。简化编辑器不请求此接口，工具创建的任务仍可使用这些执行绑定。

验证：`tests/ui.spec.tsx` 使用渲染控件和真实 AutomationService/storage-domain，覆盖双语六模板、保存/重载往返、不可用绑定、原生项目菜单/目录分离、JSON 项目清空、隐藏配置保留、未保存草稿、失败重试、旧响应/卸载、归档、结果可用性、无效时区/规则和 DST；`tests/bindings.spec.ts` 使用真实技能/工具注册表和 Gateway，验证只读目录及卸载撤销。当前完整回归包含13个文件、528个用例；构建包含 Host/Client 类型检查，产物 smoke 验证既有执行/恢复/删除链路。

```sh
node plugins/tpcowork-automation/build.mjs
node deepseek-harness/node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config plugins/tpcowork-automation/vitest.config.ts
node plugins/tpcowork-automation/tests/artifact-smoke.mjs
node plugins/tpcowork-automation/tests/browser-smoke.mjs
node plugins/tpcowork-automation/tests/review-project-clear.mjs
```

Chromium 产物验证使用真实 Cordis、SlotRegistry、LocaleRuntime、宿主 React、Client Gateway、Host Gateway 及 JSON 持久化，覆盖四种语言/主题、12次模板取消、once→monthly→manual→七字段 custom 保存重载、首页同款项目菜单、技能/MCP 等隐藏配置的保存保留、Host 更新期间草稿保留及卸载零残留；报告和截图输出在 `test-results/ui-browser/`。浏览器壳测试提供项目投影和聊天导航观察器，未启动完整 Electron 或真实外部模型/MCP 网络；不能用这些证据代替子任务10的真实桌面及子任务09的离线安装验收。跨客户端事件、全局刷新和桌面通知的实现及验证边界见状态同步章节。未修改或提交 DSH 子仓库，未改用户模型来源/凭证/默认选择，未导入旧数据，未更新现有 tgz 或安装到用户配置；当时工作区根目录不是 Git 仓库，未创建 PR；现使用独立 worktree，当前交付见 TPCO-10-delivery.md。

项目清空回归已整合进 browser-smoke：检查真实请求的 projectId:null、持久化 JSON 不含该字段、Host 重开及页面刷新后无项目且目录保留；普通编辑保留项目，不可用项目提示并往返保留，用户明确清空后才解除。截图为 `project-cleared.png`、`project-unavailable.png`。`review-project-clear.mjs` 作为兼容入口运行同一组回归，输出到 `test-results/ui-browser/`。

## 运行记录中心（子任务07）

`src/AutomationRunCenter.tsx` 复用任务页的 `AutomationCatalog`，聚合全部任务（含已读 once 归档任务）的历史，按 `startedAt` 降序。全局记录和编辑器历史共用 `src/AutomationRunTable.tsx`：列出触发时间、来源、状态、紧凑时长和操作；全局表格增加任务名称、未读标记和“跳到会话”按钮。编辑器按当前任务隔离历史，记录菜单提供跳到会话和删除记录；skipped 原因及执行错误通过状态悬停查看。运行页直接进入结果会话；不再展示卡片、搜索筛选或详情页。客户端两秒计时器仅刷新 Host 状态。打开终态会话时通过 `markRunViewed` 持久化；运行中不标已读，已跟随的会话结束后补记已读。`resultType=none` 仅确认，once reminder 的确认按 Host 规则删除任务及记录，循环提醒保留；旧轮询不能恢复已删除内容。

完整结果仅接受 `resultType=conversation`、`conversationAvailable=true`、明确 `conversationId` 且无 unavailable reason。`src/open-run-session.ts` 在目录尚未发现目标时刷新 DSH Session 目录，通过既有 `sessions.using` 等待历史，以 `openState` 判断读取是否成功；`removed` 也会在执行器释放 Host Agent 时出现，不能据此判定持久化结果丢失。历史读取成功后调用 `uiWorkspace.openSession`，再异步通过 Session.rename 保存标准运行标题；重命名失败只记录警告，不阻止查看结果。导航先取得 mainView 引用，临时 automationResult 引用随后释放；离开记录表格会取消尚未完成的打开请求。缺失、legacy 和读取失败明确显示，不根据 sessionId/sessionKey 猜测，不调用 create/startSession 兜底。会话运行时、模型和凭证沿用 DSH。

冷会话删除通过 `session-persistence/deleted` 转发 `api-session/removed`，同步撤销各客户端侧栏的会话入口；当前客户端删除成功后还会刷新 Session 目录；分组初始化时也刷新目录，清除旧版本或重连时遗留的失效入口。只有确实删除持久化会话才发布移除；共享旧会话仅移除记录。运行删除独立调用 `deleteRun`，确认框支持取消、焦点恢复与 pending 防重，运行中禁删。清理失败保留确认框、历史和错误提示，可重试。不能用任务删除替代运行删除；活跃 Session 必须先由其拥有者释放。单纯关闭客户端视图不保证释放 Host Agent，无法自主释放时可在停止相关 Host 生命周期后重试。

供子任务08/09集成：九个管理接口、持久化和 bindings schema 均未改；页面入口仍为 `registerAutomationUi` 的 schedules slots。`AutomationUiServices.openSession` 改为 `(id, standardTitle, signal) => Promise<void>`，调用方必须等待并处理失败。Client UI 的 `uiDependencies` 增加 `sessions`，包的 `dsh.client.inject` 增加现有 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller`；复用宿主 React，不增加会话运行时。后续打包须包含重建的 `lib/client.js` 与声明及前阶段必要 DSH 产物；仓库现有 tgz 未更新，不可作为本阶段最新交付。08已增加只读变更流，09打包时还须包含更新后的 remote 描述符和 changes 声明。

```sh
node plugins/tpcowork-automation/tests/run-browser-smoke.mjs
```

新增 `tests/run-history.spec.tsx` 覆盖双语紧凑表格、日期排序、归档历史、直接跳转会话、终态已读/写入失败重试、运行中到终态刷新、提醒确认、无结果错误、删除确认/pending/失败重试、旧轮询及打开取消。`run-browser-smoke.mjs` 使用构建后的插件、真实 AgentLoop、Zstandard JSONL/SessionQuery、Host SessionController、ClientSessions 和 UiWorkspace 导航；外部 LLM 使用受控流。Chromium 实际验证中英文与深浅主题、实时首尾消息、冷历史、持久化标题/已读、Host 插件重开、once 归档/提醒移除、legacy/missing/不存在结果及零 session/create、真实活跃归属拒删、注入持久化删除故障、删除后侧栏目录同步、编辑器保存后执行/暂停恢复/删除，以及桌面宽度和 390px 的深浅主题表格截图。报告与截图输出到 `test-results/run-browser/`。外层 workspace/layout、未使用的上传注册及转录展示为夹具，不能代替完整 Electron、外部模型/MCP、操作系统重启、Windows 或最终离线安装验收。

# TP Cowork

基于 DeepSeek Harness 的桌面办公助手。底座由独立 fork 维护，产品能力通过外部插件扩展 DSH 原生会话、任务、权限和凭证功能。

| 插件 | 职责 |
| --- | --- |
| [core](plugins/tpcowork-core/README.md) | 产品身份、助手角色、模型配置 |
| [UI](plugins/tpcowork-ui/README.md) | 品牌、主题、布局、首页 |
| [workbench](plugins/tpcowork-workbench/README.md) | 文件交付与任务收尾 |
| [browser](plugins/tpcowork-browser/README.md) | 内置浏览器与桌面桥接 |
| [toolbox](plugins/tpcowork-toolbox/README.md) | 技能、MCP、团队管理及可选 Step 搜索 |
| [automation](plugins/tpcowork-automation/README.md) | 自动化模板、定时任务和运行记录 |
| [memory](plugins/tpcowork-memory/README.md) | 按工作区保存跨会话记忆，默认关闭 |
| [archives](plugins/tpcowork-archives/README.md) | 设置 › 归档管理：按工作区查看、取消归档和删除已归档会话 |
| [usage](plugins/tpcowork-usage/README.md) | 设置 › 使用统计：按本地会话记录统计 Token、活跃度和模型用量 |
| [computer-use](plugins/tpcowork-computer-use/README.md) | 设置 › 电脑控制：参照 ZCode，让 Agent 按应用授权查看并操作 Windows、macOS 桌面应用（Linux X11 实验） |
| [diagnostics](plugins/tpcowork-diagnostics/README.md) | 脱敏的 Host 与桌面日志文件；设置 › 通用设置 › 诊断信息导出诊断包（参照 DSH Desktop） |
| [experts](plugins/tpcowork-experts/README.md) | 专家协作，复用原生任务与子会话 |

## 本地运行

需要 Node.js 24 或更新版本，并将 `deepseek-harness` 底座仓库放在本仓库的同级目录。在 `tp-coworkdsh` 内执行一条命令即可：

```sh
npm run dev
```

`npm start` 也可启动。`npm run dev` 会根据两个仓库自上次构建以来的 git 改动自动判断：只改了插件就只重建插件，改了底座就连底座一起重建，没有改动就直接复用已有构建启动——日常不需要再区分 `dev:plugins` 和 `dev:rebuild`。首次运行或缺少产物时会自动准备，可能需要联网下载和完整构建。已有桌面程序运行时，先完整退出再启动。

`npm run dev:plugins`、`npm run dev:rebuild` 仍可手动强制重建（分别只重建插件、或完整重建底座和插件），用于绕过自动检测或排查构建问题。两者都不会重新启用已关闭的插件。

默认复用底座的 `apps/desktop/.desktop-build/development/home` 数据目录；`DSH_HOME` 可指定其他目录。初始化复用原生 Desktop 方法，保留已有会话、凭证和个人设置。`npm run dev -- --plan` 可只查看启动步骤。

## Windows 安装包

进入本仓库 **Actions → Build Windows Installer → Run workflow**，使用默认 `standalone` 模式即可构建 Windows x64 独立测试包。构建及安装验证成功后，默认同时上传 Actions Artifacts 并发布 GitHub 预发行版，可下载安装包、SHA-256 和构建记录；取消 `publish_release` 则只上传 Artifacts。

详细设置、构建模式及本地命令见 [Windows 云端打包操作](docs/windows-github-actions.md)。

## Linux 安装包

进入 **Actions → Build Linux Packages → Run workflow**，由 Ubuntu 22.04 x64 Runner 构建并校验 AppImage 和 DEB，生成 SHA-256 和构建来源记录。默认同时上传 Actions Artifacts 并发布 GitHub 预发行版；取消 `publish_release` 则只上传 Artifacts。操作、参数和麒麟实机验证范围见 [Linux 云端打包](docs/kylin-linux-github-actions.md)。

麒麟上排查启动问题时，选择 `variant=basic` 构建 **TP Cowork Basic**：排除全部 TP Cowork 产品插件，保留底座默认界面，使用独立的应用数据目录，并验证 AppImage 和 DEB 的真实图形窗口启动。基础版发布在 `linux-basic-packages-<version>`，附带启动诊断脚本。

Linux 默认选择 `variant=standard` 构建 **TP Cowork Linux**：在已验证基础版上恢复其余 10 个产品插件，排除浏览器和 Computer Use 的自动化实现，单独保留界面缩放与诊断导出所需的通用桌面能力。工具箱保留自己的 Chromium 和离线 Python 依赖。该版本使用独立数据目录，发布在 `linux-standard-packages-<version>`，并验证真实窗口、产品界面、记忆、归档、统计和工具箱页面；`full` 仍可构建全部 12 个插件。

安装包、登录欢迎页、系统菜单、关于窗口和应用图标统一使用 TP Cowork 品牌；Windows 构建和本地启动自动准备品牌资源，品牌图片使用 `plugins/tpcowork-ui/icon.png`。

Windows 顶栏“应用”菜单不显示“检查更新”和“管理 dsh 命令”。

## 源码目录

两个仓库放在同一个父目录下：

```text
项目父目录/
  tp-cowork/          本仓库，本地目录名可以是 tp-coworkdsh
  deepseek-harness/   https://github.com/wyx2014/deepseek-harness
```

产品代码推送到本仓库 `main`；底座改动推送到 fork 的 `feat/tpcowork-workbench-ui`。Actions 同时检出两个仓库，安装包内记录各自的 commit。

`npm run dev:rebuild` 统一完成底座和插件构建。单独管理已初始化桌面的插件可使用 `node scripts/desktop-plugin.mjs install all`。检查源码和依赖链接使用 `node scripts/check-worktree.mjs`。

运行所需模型和 MCP 凭证由应用内的 DSH 凭证服务管理；本地凭证、会话、缓存及编译产物不提交到 GitHub。
